name: Sakiri
description: Unrivaled at Eibon and as scary as she looks.

reaction.name: Hexed
reaction.desc: Deals an additional instance of <bule>follow-up attack DMG</> to the target equal to <NumGreen>20%</> of <bule>Anima or Incantation DMG</> taken within <NumGreen>12s</> after triggering Esper Cycle.

reaction.name: Scorch
reaction.desc: Upon triggering Esper Cycle, inflicts Scorch on the target for <NumGreen>15s</>, dealing DoT.

reaction.name: Discord
reaction.desc: Deducts a percentage of the target's <bule>Break</> when they are simultaneously affected by Nova and Scorch.

fashion.name: Pumpkin Magic
fashion.desc:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"A witch had a pumpkin field with squeaky clean magical pumpkins, and scruffy non-magical pumpkins."

fashion.name: Teddy and the Hungry Ghost
fashion.desc: An outfit that's undeniably adorable… though Sakiri wouldn't admit it. Comes with a hat, bow tie, and teddy bear backpack. But what's inside the bear's belly?

profile.title: Eibon Staff
profile.description:
A white-haired girl with the horn of an oni, accompanied by a one-eyed ghost humming a strange nursery rhyme, often causes clients to doubt her due to her height… For your safety, please avoid mentioning this directly to her. Thank you.
"Kiroumaru! Stop eating random things. Spit it out!"
"Sakiri, you stingy little… ouch!"
profile.introduction: Unrivaled at Eibon and as scary as she looks.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
The main obstacles to Eibon owner Hotori's dreams of getting rich are, aside from the owner's own issues, the unavoidable compensation fees after every commission from the "Eibon Ace Trio (self-proclaimed)," especially for things Sakiri breaks. What Kiroumaru swallows is small stuff, but when Sakiri gets really mad and swings Kiroumaru around, well…
Of course, Sakiri gets a good scolding from Hotori for pulling stunts like that, but judging from Eibon's monthly bills and Adler's furrowed brow, the effect probably isn't great.

Even though Sakiri brings all sorts of trouble to Eibon every time she goes on quests, if you leave her idle in the shop…
One second she's reading "Weekly Fantasy," the next she might grab some scene from the manga and get Nanally to take her out for fun, ahem, building The Coluccis. If she doesn't follow Nanally out to cause trouble, then poor Taygedo gets it instead. And even if Sakiri miraculously stays put in the shop for once, Kiroumaru can still create some accidents…

Trouble seems to follow Sakiri wherever she goes, but unlike Nanally, Sakiri never causes major disasters and can even bail Nanally out when it counts. While it looks like Nanally is the one dragging Sakiri and Edgar around everywhere for The Coluccis, when you really think about it… maybe Sakiri is actually the most reliable one?

Oh, and if you don't want to get hit with Kiroumaru's "Memory Correction Technique," remember this well: don't get curious about the things Sakiri sneakily throws away every day, or else…

profile_detail.name: Colucci Family, Second in Command
profile_detail.desc:
Personally certified by the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, the cornerstone of growing bigger, getting stronger, and reaching new heights!
"Sakiri! Edgar! I just thought of a new plan for the family!"
"Seriously? Again? Should we make a run for it while we can?"
"If we don't listen… Nanally's gonna keep going on about it next time…"
"Give me a break…"
"Come on! This'll be the meeting that decides the Coluccis' fate!"

profile_detail.name: Honest Popping Candy
profile_detail.desc:
"Hehe, Edgar, what exactly did Sakiri say after she ate that Honest Popping Candy last time? Taygedo said I missed quite a show!"
"Um… Sakiri told me not to say…"
"Oh come on, it's fine, Sakiri's not…"
"Dummy! What are you whispering about with Nanally?! Time to get to work, Kiroumaru!"
"No no no no no no! I don't know anything yet!"

profile_detail.name: Kiroumaru
profile_detail.desc:
An Anomaly that seems born just to eat! It eats food, it eats radios, it eats bike wheels, it eats tires, eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat eat!
"Sakiri, can I eat this? Sakiri, can I eat that?"
Anyway, as long as it can stay by Sakiri's side and eat eat eat, it's happy! Always following Sakiri around, eat eat eat!

profile_detail.name: "With everyone now…"
profile_detail.desc:
A melody few have ever heard, Sakiri never hums this nursery rhyme in front of others.
For someone who acts too mature for her age most of the time, this is one of those rare moments when she actually shows her inner child.
Though Sakiri always keeps quiet about it, perhaps we can glimpse something from this song…
From this lonely and eerie nursery rhyme, we might see some hints of her past.

profile_detail.name: "A place that won't abandon me"
profile_detail.desc:
At the end of the "Pawn Moonlight" incident, Otro gave Sakiri a gift: a box containing little bears designed to look like Eibon members.
Sometimes Sakiri hides in her room and takes out the bears to play with them, surrounded by the little figures like she's playing house.
Though she's never said it out loud, she really loves this gift.

melee.name: Kiroumaru Headbutt
desc: Sakiri swings Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Opens its mouth to continuously pull nearby targets within a cone while Hungry. Destroys movable objects in the scene and devours weak enemies.
Takes <NumGreen>180s</> to digest <NumGreen>each</> devoured enemy, with only <NumGreen>1</> target digested at a time.
Becomes Full when the number of enemies being digested reaches the limit, remaining movable but unable to pull or devour enemies.
Release to exit the mode.
Wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

Triggers when using Ram after a Critical Dodge. Leaps high into the air and strikes down hard with Kiroumaru against enemies left vulnerable by their missed attacks. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
desc_short: Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
melee.context: <Italic>According to Mr. T, an oddity who survived the depths of Kiroumaru's belly and lived to tell the tale thanks to Sakiri's timely intervention, hints at an unexpected perk: Amidst the gloom, one might unearth a half-digested game console to while away the hours—a quirky, entertaining twist to an otherwise harrowing wait for rescue.</>

additional_desc.name: Eating Mode
additional_desc.desc: Moves continuously while riding Kiroumaru. Pulls in and devours weak enemies during this time. Takes time to digest each devoured enemy.

skill.name: Devour Whole
desc: Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.

Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against powerful enemies).
desc_short: Pulls and levitates nearby enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
skill.context: <Italic>"Sa… Sakiri, can I eat this?" "Moron, next time ask before you eat!"</>

ultraskill.name: Feast of Gluttony
ultraskill.desc: No escaping this time! Kiroumaru spits out a large amount of Gravity Slurry from above, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Applies strong gravity to hit enemies, pressing them heavily to the ground (not effective against Bosses). Prevents <TextHLT>Suppressed</> enemies from moving for a period. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on Sakiri's Base ATK.
ultraskill.desc_short: <TextHLT>Suppresses</> enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on her ATK.
ultraskill.context: <Italic>No prey escapes before Kiroumaru has its fill.</>

qte.name: Squash!
qte.desc: Let's see which unlucky soul is about to get squashed? Sakiri slams the enlarged Kiroumaru heavily onto the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
qte.context: <Italic>Kiroumaru, stop right there! Hm? Did you just bump into something?</>

passive.name: Can I Eat This?
passive.desc: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Increases DoT taken by the target by 25% for each type of DoT effect while in Scorch state, up to 100%.
passive.context: <Italic>It's not time to start yet! Instead of swallowing whole… wouldn't it be better to add more ingredients? Can't let the fun pass!</>

passive.name: Impish Trick
passive.desc: Reduces enemies' DEF by 10% for 20s after inflicting Airborne or <TextHLT>Suppress</>.
passive.context: <Italic>Those on the naughty list… will be taken by ghosts… or perhaps eaten?</>

desc.desc: <Term>Level 1:</> Sakiri increases dish prices by an additional <Green2>0.12</> Fons.
<Term>Level 2:</> Sakiri reduces ingredient consumption rate by <Green2>1%</>.
<Term>Level 3:</> In Owner's Selection, Kiroumaru actively attacks and drives away Danzaburou.
<Term>Level 4:</> Sakiri reduces ingredient consumption rate by <Green2>1%</>.
<Term>Level 5:</> Sakiri increases dish prices by <Green2>0.3</> Fons when a dish contains 3 identical tags.

awaken.name: Diffusive Haze
awaken.desc: Extends the immovable effect inflicted by Feast of Gluttony to <NumGreen>6s</>.

awaken.name: Dextrous Separation
awaken.desc: Deals extra damage with Feast of Gluttony to airborne enemies, scaling with the target's mass and capped at <NumGreen>600%</> of ATK.

awaken.name: Adhesive Grip
awaken.desc: Increases Devour Whole and Feast of Gluttony damage by <NumGreen>6%</> for <NumGreen>each</> enemy defeated by the Team over the next <NumGreen>15s</>, up to <NumGreen>60%</>. Resets when out of combat.

awaken.name: Wishful Reliance
awaken.desc: Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) by <NumGreen>30%</> of Sakiri's Base ATK for <NumGreen>20s</> after casting Feast of Gluttony.

awaken.name: Sensory Collapse
awaken.desc: Fully restores Feast of Gluttony's Ultimate Energy and resets its cooldown immediately when Devour Whole makes the target airborne.

awaken.name: Gluttonous Dissolution
awaken.desc: Allows Kiroumaru to devour and digest up to <NumGreen>3</> enemies at a time in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</>, with the digestion time for each enemy calculated independently.

additional_desc.name: Eating Mode
additional_desc.desc: Moves continuously while riding Kiroumaru. Pulls in and devours weak enemies during this time. Takes time to digest each devoured enemy.

resonance.name: Insatiable Appetite
resonance.desc: Increases the skill level of Kiroumaru Headbutt, Devour Whole, and Feast of Gluttony by <NumGreen>1</>.

resonance.name: Fog Penetration
resonance.desc: For each negative effect on the target, Sakiri deals <NumGreen>3%</> increased damage to the target, up to <NumGreen>12%</>.

equip_slots.desc: Increases {0} by {1}% for each Type III Module equipped.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc:
(Kiroumaru: Hello, I'm the ever-so-grumpy Sakiri, and this is the invincible Lord Kiroumaru—ouch!) 
So you're the appraiser Hotori picked up? There, be careful around that ugly monster Kiroumaru, don't get too close… If something goes missing, I won't help you find it… No insurance if you get bitten on the butt either!

daily.name: Chat: Gluttony
daily.desc: Kiroumaru! What's that junk you're eating? Spit it out!

daily.name: Chat: Nursery Rhyme
daily.desc:
Snap, snap, where did you go?
Fragile and cute, that glass doll.
Tick-tock, tick-tock, the sun's dipped low.
Safe with the crew, fears all stowed.

daily.name: Chat: Milk
daily.desc: Still sleeping, eh… Glug glug glug… Ugh, I can't stand milk…

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Let's drag Nanally and the dummy out for some… something big!

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Another car splashes me, it's done for!

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I won't dress like an ugly yarn ball… Ah, achoo!

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Little bear popsicle? Please, that's kid stuff…

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: What took you so long?! The sun's been up for hours!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Hey, I've been here for you all day, maybe show some gratitude?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: If you blink at the moment the sun goes down, you'll get—snagged by the shadow ghost!… Haha, just kidding!

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Off to dreamland already? You're so boring… Come earlier tomorrow, okay?

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Seeing Taygedo rage is priceless! Just eat all his snacks from the fridge, or hide his precious sticker cards. After all, he always hides them in the same uncreative places! …How is this not a hobby? It's called "bonding," got it?

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Still not taller after drinking this stuff for a year… Adler's a liar…

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies Honest Popping Candy
daily.desc: Snacks for me? Hmph, I'll reluctantly accept them. …Popping candy? …Who told you about the honest popping candy? Well, no use denying it! Forget it yourself, or shall I have Kiroumaru surgically remove that memory for you?

daily.name: Topic: Disqualified Spawn
daily.desc: It's not a big deal. When a human and an anomaly merge, if the human overcomes the anomaly, they become a Disqualified Spawn. If the anomaly overcomes the human, they become something even more inferior, living miserably… What's with that look?… Just to make it clear, I'm not about to be bested by those bottom-rung beings! So, if you're pitying me, you might as well step back.

daily.name: Topic: Empty Bottles
daily.desc: W…what? Empty milk bottles?! You must be seeing things… That's Kiroumaru's weird taste, not mine, definitely.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc:
How unlucky do you have to be to get stuck with someone like Kiroumaru? Always defiant and noisy! I can't count how many times I've cleaned up its mess because it eats everything! And when it gets an upset stomach, it vomits everywhere!
(Kiroumaru: Everything's on the menu! Gluttony rules!)
Zip—it—! One day I'll sew that mouth shut!

daily.name: About Myself: Wish
daily.desc: Curious, are we? Did those two meddlers say something?… Hmph. Save the guesswork. These lips are sealed.

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: She's a lazy squanderer! Always stirring the pot and acting like a child! I was just showing my kindness to her everyday!

daily.name: About Adler
daily.desc: If Adler wasn't around, Eibon would've gone bankrupt ages ago! Taking care of the flaky bunch is a full-time gig. Why not care for yourself for a change?!

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: Daffodill's got moves, and I respect that. But teaming up with her? It's like a breath-holding contest with a statue. Ha… I bet she'd vibe with that dummy, Edgar!

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: Psst, wanna see Nanally freak out? Put on a horror film, and she'll be hugging her tail in no time. Go on, dare her—but don't say I gave you the idea!

daily.name: About Edgar
daily.desc: Being a brainiac is great and all, but if he's too shy to speak up, what's the point? So yeah, I'm the one who steps up! But let me tell you, don't let that quiet act fool you. When it's go-time, he'll come out swinging and leave everyone's jaws on the floor!

daily.name: About the Coluccis
daily.desc: Ah, Nanally and the dummy, what a pair! One's scatterbrained, the other's tight-lipped. What would they do without me? But guess what? I… don't hate their company…

daily.name: About Taygedo
daily.desc: The dumbest oddity in the entire Bridge Crossings! Never understands the hierarchy! That dumb otter can only be my sidekick, okay? And he cries at the drop of a hat, so embarrassing! Hmm… but you know what, life would be boring without Taygedo… I guess he can stick around!

daily.name: About Mismo
daily.desc: Those self-righteous, high-and-mighty guys, I should have hit 'em harder last time! But I'm all about second chances, especially when they're trying to make things right. So, I'll let bygones be bygones… for now.

daily.name: About Eibon Antique Shop
daily.desc: Humph, I haven't found anywhere else that feels quite satisfying. Plus, Adler's cooking? That's reason enough to stay and lend a hand…

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: It's barely passable.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: At this rate, they'll never catch up with me!

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: How is Kiroumaru's appetite growing?

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: Wow, how did you…? Ahem, I'll remember you tried this hard!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: Did you want Kiroumaru to cover a mistake you made? Just name it! Kiroumaru will deal with it!

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Thanks. I'll make sure Kiroumaru doesn't eat it—Umm, at least before I sleep.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: I'll give you a surprise some day. A legit one!

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: Kiroumaru! Let's get down to business!

battle.name: Containment II
battle.desc: Hmph, decent work! You can have that now.

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Tch, thought there would be more chaos…

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: Hmm… can't figure it out, let's take it back for Nanally and the dummy.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: Oh! Nice find! Nanally's going to react funny!

battle.name: Unexpected Gains IV
battle.desc: You're dead if you eat this! (Kiroumaru: Ugh…)

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: If I give this to Hotori…

battle.name: Heal I
battle.desc: I'm not going away this easily!

battle.name: Glide II
battle.desc: Kiroumaru, stop squirming around! I'm not helping you if you fall!

battle.name: Special Switch - Hotori
battle.desc: Move aside! Let the great Sakiri handle this!

battle.name: Special Switch - Adler
battle.desc: Stop treating me like a child.

battle.name: Special Switch - Zero
battle.desc: Watch out, watch out! It's Kiroumaru!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Hotori
battle.desc: Stay out of this if you're drunk!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Nanally
battle.desc: I'm telling you… You can't just charge forward.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Adler
battle.desc: Don't try too hard, old man.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Daffodill
battle.desc: No way you made a mistake like that…

battle.name: Teammate Down - Zero
battle.desc: Hey, baddies, do you think our Appraiser is a pushover?

name: Lacrimosa
description: Holds the record for most maintenance requests submitted by BAC staff.

reaction.name: Nova
reaction.desc: Inflicts Nova on the target for <NumGreen>5s</> after triggering Esper Cycle. When the effect ends, the target takes massive <bule>Mental Damage</>.

reaction.name: Scorch
reaction.desc: Upon triggering Esper Cycle, inflicts Scorch on the target for <NumGreen>15s</>, dealing DoT.

reaction.name: Discord
reaction.desc: Deducts a percentage of the target's <bule>Break</> when they are simultaneously affected by Nova and Scorch.

fashion.name: New Moon Lullaby
fashion.desc:
Lacrimosa's loungewear. Made of soft, cozy fabric that lets you fall asleep anytime, anywhere.
"One bat… two bats… three… zzz…"

fashion.name: The Tomato Story
fashion.desc: A comfortable handmade dress. Though Lacrimosa stumbles through her days, her landlady grandmother's skilled hands can always restore it to perfect condition.

fashion.name: Yesterday's Melody
fashion.desc:
A decadent, ornate formal dress, perfect for a castle banquet.
"The night sky poured over the garden, soaking its roses in muted darkness. Years later, those flowers still bloom in silence, and the rest of the story has faded into shadow."

fashion.name: Piano Key Sonatina
fashion.desc:
Like night and day, some things in this world are simply black and white: espresso and latte, tuxedo cats and white cats, piano keys, Lacrimosa's everyday outfit, and the white dress she wears only once in a while.
"White dresses are pretty. But… they get dirty so easily."

fashion.name: Gilded Rhapsody
fashion.desc: Things that shine are often heavy. Lacrimosa feels unusually tired flying to work today. Maybe it isn't just her imagination.

fashion.name: Nightingale's Crescendo
fashion.desc: Happiness sometimes arrives without rhyme or reason, like a reckless hard landing. Just as the bat that foretells good fortune flies through the window lattice, it always comes with a crisp crash and shattered glass strewn across the floor.

profile.title: ETD-4, Member
profile.description:
"I've been watching for a while now. That girl from ETD has been standing there motionless for two hours! She must be plotting something that could destroy Hethereau…"
"That's just your prejudice talking. She's young and already risking her life for this city. Standing there quietly is probably part of her duty."
"Last week she threw a truck across half the street and left a huge crater in the ground. You saw it too!"
"Wasn't that to stop a suddenly rampaging Anomaly? C'mon, be reasonable…"
Not far away, Lacrimosa, who had accidentally fallen asleep while standing, let out a big yawn and rubbed her eyes groggily.
The wind today, so noisy… Sigh… miss home.
profile.introduction: Holds the record for most maintenance requests submitted by BAC staff.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Bureau of Anomaly Control Fun Fact #1: A Lacrimosa will regularly spawn on the break room couch.
Other common Lacrimosa spawn points include sun-warmed rooftops, quiet and rarely-visited stairwells, or the inside of a creepy-looking coffin that actually has soft, fluffy padding inside…
There are 24 hours in a day, so sleeping for only 20 hours isn't that much, right?

As ETD-4's adorable little ace, Lacrimosa may not be good at socializing, but her popularity remains sky-high. While her complaint letters are directly proportional to her property damage rate, the thank-you letters and fan mail she receives are equally staggering.
Team relationships? Harmonious. Even when having lunch at Clicky Fast Food, when all the ketchup gets hogged and everyone has to dip their french fries in ice cream instead… it's no big deal.

Perhaps because she's too innocent and pure, Lacrimosa has a unique "eye for discovering beauty."
This manifests as: accidentally bumping into street signs hard enough to hurt her forehead, or taking exhausting routes that take forever to walk despite being quickly reachable by car. In these moments, Lacrimosa reaches the conclusion: Street signs, cars, powerful! Lacrimosa, must learn!
"Actually, controlling Esper Abilities and creating all sorts of complex shapes out of thin air is actually much harder than people imagine. Lacrimosa has put in a lot of effort where no one can see!" —assessment from ETD reserve training staff currently in casts.

What, Lacrimosa's missing again? Did she get lost? Where did she fall asleep this time? Or was she distracted by a roadside tomato jelly vending machine? Well, no worries. Trust that she's still a reliable ETD team member. When the team really needs Lacrimosa, she'll definitely come running.
…Though it'll probably be at the cost of glass doors shattered all along the way.

profile_detail.name: Tomato Enthusiasm 100%
profile_detail.desc:
Perhaps it's the price of her Esper Abilities, but aside from tomato products, Lacrimosa can't taste anything she eats. No matter how delicious food smells, eating it is like chewing soft, chewy, or crispy plain cardboard.
The upside is that even when Mint has a "brilliant idea" and creates something like banana coco pumpkin pie, so long as it doesn't smell too questionable, Lacrimosa can eat it all with a straight face!
Rumor has it that the tomato product brand "Tomato 100" once approached Lacrimosa, hoping to invite her to become their spokesperson. However, the collaboration was temporarily suspended due to negative social impact caused by the "Tomato Devil" Anomaly. Recently though, the brand seems interested in restarting the partnership… but we'll leave that story for another time.

profile_detail.name: Level 1 Aviation Emergency Alert
profile_detail.desc:
Hethereau is just too big, and walking is just too exhausting. One day, Lacrimosa thought to herself: "It'd be great if I didn't have to walk." The next second, she found herself transformed into a little bat, flying through the air. Mm, much easier. Problem solved!
However, now Lacrimosa had new troubles. After all, not every building had glass doors, but glass windows were everywhere. Ever since she learned to fly, situations where Lacrimosa's forehead and glass both get damaged have become increasingly common. To add to her woes, flying takes less effort than walking, so naturally closing her eyes and dozing off is pretty normal, right? If she actually falls asleep, however, she'll forget to flap her wings… and down comes a falling Lacrimosa from the sky.

profile_detail.name: Cult Manga Club
profile_detail.desc:
As a devoted fan of the most famous cult manga "Duke K" in recent years, Lacrimosa naturally hangs out on Bagel, constantly keeping up with the latest news.
Typing is too hard, so Lacrimosa usually just lurks without commenting. She's even too lazy to come up with a username, so she goes online using her real name. Unexpectedly, she was caught by a fellow "Duke K" fanatic called "GeneSectParanormalDeptAce" because of her frequent likes, and somewhat reluctantly gained a friend with shared interests.
Her teammates are quite relieved that Lacrimosa has finally made a friend, but she still can't remember the other person's full username and usually just calls them "Net Friend With A Long Name." On the other hand, the other person apparently still thinks her habit of referring to herself in-person by her online username is rather self-centered…

profile_detail.name: Secret of the Starlight Ring?
profile_detail.desc:
The Bureau of Anomaly Control's employee files contain a photo of Lacrimosa from before she joined the team: sitting on the ruins of a completely flattened convenience store, concentrating intently on drinking tomato jelly.
The files also show that her almost complete inability to control her Esper Abilities improved significantly after she spent some time training with the ETD reserve team. A pair of rings of unknown origin with obvious signs of use, received from a future captain, seemed to provide great help with her practice.
Perhaps after she grows up, she'll be able to sense the true secret contained within those rings… but that's all in the future.

profile_detail.name: Untitled Future
profile_detail.desc:
Just like most people can't remember their earliest days as an infant, Lacrimosa can't recall anything from before she became "Lacrimosa."
Based on a line of text carved on the coffin where she woke up, Lacrimosa decided on her own name. Why don't other people get to decide their own? Don't adults always tell her that she should choose the kind of person she wants to become?
However, names she didn't choose like "Mosa" or "Lacrimosa Senpai" also seem to be calling her. If she had chosen a different name, would she have become a different person? …Lacrimosa can't answer such complex questions yet.
She only knows that her teammates taught her to respond seriously when her name is called. Lacrimosa has kept those words close to her heart.
"That super-strong pretty girl from ETD may always have a blank expression, but she's surprisingly down-to-earth! When I greeted her on the street last time, she even responded! Oh my gosh, so cute!"
Thus, her popularity among citizens rose a bit more.

melee.name: Sweet and Sour
desc:
Swings her Frying Pan, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
The projectile generated by the 2nd attack can be shattered by subsequent attacks, causing an explosion and dealing extra <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Manipulates Red Jelly, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Flavor Variation can be used at any time via the Aim button.
Tosses her Frying Pan and performs a flying kick forward when using Tomato Metal, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to each target hit. Switches her attack module to Tomato Percussion.

profile.title: ETD-4, Lieutenant
profile.description:
Skia's first positive impression of the Bureau occurred when he was updating his resume.
He decided to give the job at the Bureau a try when he was invited to apply, but the formality of a resume was still required. Since leaving his previous job, he hadn't bothered to think of resumes and job applications… Now, he had no choice but to polish up his old resume.
 He uploaded a new ID photo, replacing the original one—he nearly didn't recognize the young man in the portrait anymore—then clicked submit.
 —This is usually where the systems tell him "face not detected, please upload an appropriate portrait" and what not. Strangely, the file was submitted without issue.
 Skia let out a quiet sigh of relief. Although he had long since stopped caring about facing prejudice based on his looks, having to make an extra trip to compensate for system inadequacies and disrupting his established workflow… that would have been truly intolerable.
profile.introduction: Often mistaken for Squad 4's captain, despite being the lieutenant.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Skia's name had once been praised by his old colleagues as having "quite the martial artist's spirit." Skia didn't care much for the supposed depth of his name. But he found quiet satisfaction in the act of writing it—each letter placed with purpose, each curve and line falling into place. It was neat, orderly, and well arranged. Just the way he liked.
However, whenever he signed his name with too much force, that scene would always reappear in his mind… That day when he signed his employment contract at his ex-company.
For that job, he completely embraced all the workplace etiquette his colleagues believed in as "standard practice," never questioning any of it. This included things like specialized signature training to leave clients with an elite impression.
It made perfect sense, really—if all it took to preserve one's dignity was to follow a visible, rigid set of rules, then the cost was laughably low for the rewards.

As for his current signature… the overall form remained rigorous, but a closer look revealed slightly hurried connecting strokes.
Had he stopped caring about these surface details? Had taking too much time off made him sloppy? Or perhaps it was the pressure from too many emergency missions piling up with all the cleanup…

Things weren't done the way he wanted. He felt he was the only one willing to maintain the system. Well… there was nothing he could do about that.
Despite that, he gradually got used to working at the BAC. And… how should he put it? He didn't mind the sincere jokes of his teammates.

On the other hand, there was a new cafeteria lady at the Bureau who was particularly enthusiastic about Skia.
When serving him food, though Skia hadn't said anything, she would ladle several extra bone-in ribs, then casually speak to another female staff member about how her son also likes chewing on those ribs.
The other woman lowered her voice, sounding embarrassed. "He… he's not an Oddity! He's the lieutenant from ETD-4!"
Skia quietly stared at the perfectly balanced, almost strict meal composition, topped with those extra bone-in ribs… then picked up his tray and walked away. In the end, he never asked about the "breed" of the lady's son.

profile_detail.name: Office
profile_detail.desc:
At Leon International, Skia embodied the role of a regular office worker and was naturally suited for that kind of life.
In modern civilized society, the fact that awakening Esper Abilities could change physical appearance was already common knowledge. His transformation was indeed dramatic, and just one look gave him a worse shock than any he'd experienced in five years of work… but once he calmed down, there was nothing he couldn't rationalize. After all, it wasn't a job that depended on looks, so it shouldn't break his routine…
The truth was, his routine wasn't determined by his own mindset.
Back then, he'd stood up in the meeting room, unable to bear it any longer, forcing himself to remain polite as he asked why the projects he'd always handled weren't even going through him for reports anymore.
Sitting among the well-dressed elites around him, someone wrinkled their eyes forcefully. Skia later realized it was the kind of motion… like trying to squeeze out some murky substance that had fallen into their eye.
As the meeting adjourned, Skia raised his gaze, looking past the cracks in his self-imposed mask that he was forced to reexamine, his eyes meeting the massive silhouette in the center of the projection screen that rose with his standing figure.
Does he look like a monster to others?
Well, at least the price of gaining the Esper Ability's wasn't too high. Now he was a regular office worker in every way except appearance.

profile_detail.name: Resignation
profile_detail.desc:
"It's like being a frog slowly boiled alive…"
While drinking, the man on his left complained to the bartender about his predicament. The man was troubled, trapped in a state where every fiber of his being couldn't relax due to workplace pressure. If he wanted to escape, he'd inevitably face brutal consequences. The man was deeply conflicted about this.
"Next time I see you here, I hope you won't be sipping your drink with such restraint… You can only break free if you break down completely for once. You don't cure alcohol by drinking a cure. You simply throw up."
The man sitting on his right, with a menacing aura and face of scars, responded across the space. His deliberate, unhurried way of speaking, which contrasted sharply with his appearance, caught Skia's attention.
Becoming friends with that person marked the beginning of Skia realizing that he had the ability to build a routine wherever he was.
If on that chaotic and dangerous path, there were rules, order, and clear objectives, then perhaps…

profile_detail.name: Canine
profile_detail.desc:
The imposing black hound poked its head out from the hole carved by the lighter's flame, keeping watch. Once it discovered the lighter had been replaced, its ears flattened, showing signs of dejection.
"Did the hound really prefer the original lighter?" Skia wondered. But giving an explanation like "I'm not switching back because that one had my ex-company's logo" seemed foolish, inefficient, and overly formal… Communication with his own Esper Ability should done internally. After all, the ability was a reflection of himself.
The issue was shelved, and the final result was a naturally acceptance of this current form.

profile_detail.name: Caffeine
profile_detail.desc:
A specialty coffee available for order from Ms. Fei.
Compared to the golden ratio morning coffee that Skia's ex-company mandated at 8:00 AM daily, this had… 3 extra sugar cubes, 25 ml extra milk, and… other ingredients that shouldn't appear in coffee. As for the coffee beans' origin… Well, perhaps it's from a different dimension. That was about the best way to describe the drink.
The coffee poured from Ms. Fei's head wasn't exactly brewed. The recipe isn't something one can expect—one had to taste it. But back then, Skia still tried to describe the drink with precise words.
Ms. Fei said she named the coffee after seeing Skia react to coffee she served him after he joined the BAC—it was as if he never had a real cup of coffee before. The look on his face was a mix of surprise and bewilderment, making it impossible to tell whether he was thinking it was absolutely delicious! or utterly awful!
Ms. Fei gave up asking about his preferences, and the long sigh that followed was enough to sum up all his thoughts.

profile_detail.name: Order
profile_detail.desc:
If you ever eavesdrop on JTF members, you'd discover that Skia has quite a high reputation among them for being reliable, competent, and reasonable. They'd say that he has no weird temper and no strange hobbies, as well as other great qualities many of his colleagues lack!
"There are too many difficult people over there, honestly it's pretty scary. But working with Lieutenant Skia is incredibly easy. He's steady and skilled, he knows what documents I need to hand over better than I do. It's like he's been working for twenty years…"
 "Oh man, Skia has it so tough. He's bears burdens alone; he acts as the only pillar of order in group of weirdos; he's the sole boat stubbornly sailing against the current; he struggles to impose procedures amid a raging tide of individualism…"
Their analysis of his role and development prospects in ETD… somehow has a bitter aftertaste.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Lieutenant Skia, Squad 4, Enforcement Tactical Division. Perhaps we might meet at work again in the future.

daily.name: Chat: Work Environment
daily.desc: Whether in studies or work, everyone is deeply influenced by their environment and unconsciously becomes part of it—it goes both ways.

daily.name: Chat: Pace of Life
daily.desc: You came to this city without any prior knowledge or preparation, so I imagine Eibon will shape your life here. What do you think? Is this life for you?

daily.name: Chat: Meeting
daily.desc: If you see Baicang, could you please ask him to reply to my message as soon as possible? I've organized the meeting minutes he missed and sent them to his phone. We need him to GO THROUGH them by today.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: When the sun is directly overhead, it's harder for my shadow to spread from beneath my feet. However… within short distances, the condensed and distinct shadow packs a way stronger punch.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: The humid weather will significantly impact outdoor operations, and it's not just about slippery surfaces. Make sure to watch out for anomalies that adapt their patterns based on weather changes.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I'm not cold… but don't count on me as a heat source.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: This weather makes me irritable, but I'm not a dog—you won't catch me panting to cool down!

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning. Where should we start today?

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: The food at the Bureau's cafeteria is neither good nor bad. The orderly queuing and dining system is certainly efficient, but it's only natural to get tired of eating there every day.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: ETD doesn't have fixed off-duty hours—we're expected to be ready for deployment at any time. Don't hesitate to call me whenever something comes up.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: You've worked hard today. Get some rest.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: It's hard to say I have any particular hobbies. If I had to choose, I suppose I prefer… the feeling of seeing all my tasks progressing steadily toward completion.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Troubles? …With Baicang or Fadia? …Well, it's understandable that Lacrimosa acts out sometimes and causes minor disturbances… But those two are adults slacking off and causing problems. It's hard not to get a headache from it.

daily.name: Topic: Anomaly - Ms. Fei
daily.desc: Ms. Fei's coffee has… a unique flavor, but it keeps you alert. I don't mind it. She gets upset if we brew tea at our desks, so we have to go outside for that.

daily.name: Topic: Anomaly - Agent.LUCK
daily.desc: Agent.LUCK handles all the paperwork nobody else at the Bureau wants to do. Tedious and endless as it may be. It persists in the belief that its master will return home once everything is complete… Watching it work diligently reminds me of that staff member who vanished into the lights and remains missing to this day, and of all the unresolved cases we still haven't found a way to tackle…

daily.name: Topic: Resume
daily.desc: Yes, I worked for quite a while at a company… one you might have heard of. Then I spent some time working with some outlaws, and now I serve in a public institution. Some say my resume is rather unusual, but looking back, perhaps it was all just trial and error in search of where I belong.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: Are you wondering why my shadow seems to have a different temperament from me, even though I'm the one controlling it…? It might be a bit abstract to explain. Let's just say that after awakening my Esper Ability, and as I gained a deeper understanding of my role, I realized I didn't need to maintain a tense facade all the time. That's when my shadow started appearing more energetic than before.

daily.name: About Myself: Animorphic
daily.desc: It's quite common for Esper ability awakenings to come with transfer characteristics, but as you can see, my physical transformation is far more severe than most. That day, I tried my best to stay calm, attempting to maintain my usual routine with rationality and courtesy. But inevitably, I lost my place among the usual "elites"… I suppose that was the "price" I had to pay.

daily.name: About Myself: "Elite"
daily.desc: After that, I did go through a period where it felt like the foundation I'd built my life on had crumbled… But it's fine now—I've long since stopped caring about that job and the standards it set for me.

daily.name: About Alphard
daily.desc: The director is a leader of great resolve. However, she doesn't particularly mind how her subordinates conduct themselves, rather focusing solely on results… Perhaps that's why the ETD can afford to be so lenient with its many free spirits…

daily.name: About Baicang
daily.desc: When Baicang says he's "exhausted", "done for", or "gravely injured"… don't waste your energy on him… If he speaks, he's alive enough. Talking from experience.

daily.name: About Fadia
daily.desc: One time… field duty with Fadia… I ran into an old acquaintance from the past. We chatted for a bit… the guy asked me if "I am working an honest job or not"… Thinking about how colleagues' public image can greatly influence others' perception of the workplace and the job… I'm tired of this…

daily.name: About Lacrimosa
daily.desc: If I don't pick up Lacrimosa or meet her early… she might not even be allowed on site because she doesn't have her ID. Compared to that, oversleeping or getting lost are very minor concerns.

daily.name: About Bureau of Anomaly Control
daily.desc: I used to think the ideal path for me was a stable management position in a large corporation, living a perfectly ordered life. I never imagined I'd get involved with an organization like the bureau that handles emergencies. Life is unpredictable—a series of unexpected turns brought me here, and now this daily routine of handling the unexpected has gradually become my new sense of order…

daily.name: About ETD
daily.desc: In the past, I would have had little tolerance for subordinates who lacked team spirit or were too much of an individual. But now, here… those who can't accept working with such spirits are probably the ones who don't fit in.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Feeling smooth.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Steady and methodical.

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: You can always learn something new on the job.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: A practical, appropriate, and thoughtful gift. Thank you, Appraiser.

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: I've been too busy from work to buy this. I didn't expect you to get it for me…

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: I understand. This is all part of maintaining good relationships. Thanks.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: I'll remember your gift and repay in kind.

battle.name: Ultimate III
battle.desc: Time to take a harder approach.

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: All done. The CSU will take it from here.

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Hmph, not the easiest pill to swallow.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: Let's check if it's safe first.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: I'll hold onto this for now.

battle.name: Glide I
battle.desc: I'll take this chance to look around…

battle.name: Special Switch I - Lacrimosa
battle.desc: Protecting my team is my responsibility.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Baicang
battle.desc: You've done well, Captain… I'll take over from here.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Fadia
battle.desc: Fadia, don't push yourself. I got your back.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Lacrimosa
battle.desc: Lacrimosa, go get some sleep. I'll handle the rest.

description: The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—currently seeking new recruits!

Generates <NumGreen>1</> <bule>Vita Bud</> near the target after triggering Esper Cycle, which blossoms <NumGreen>5</> <bule>Vita Pistils</>.
<bule>Vita Pistils</> then fly toward targets within range, exploding every <NumGreen>2s</> and dealing DMG to an area.
Up to <NumGreen>3</> <bule>Vita Buds</> can exist on the field at once.

fashion.name: Fluffy Flying Tiger
fashion.desc:
Nanally's loungewear. Thoughtful decorations have been added to a simple dress.
"Ever heard of 'adding wings to a tiger'? Tigers and wings are a perfect combo!"

fashion.name: Family Boss
fashion.desc: Typical streetwear with a twist of authority. As the boss of the Colucci family, her appearance sets the tone for the entire clan.

fashion.name: The Popular Kid
fashion.desc:
School uniform style clothing that balances both beauty and comfort. The armband was handmade by Nanally herself, and she's quite satisfied with it.
"Ahem, Colucci has its own standards of discipline!"

fashion.name: Phoenix Kick
fashion.desc:
A fighting outfit with a unique design. Nanally specifically enrolled in a combat training class for this.
"When am I going to attend the training sessions? Uh… Next time for sure!"

fashion.name: Sunny Surf
fashion.desc: The Coluccis are expanding into open waters, and Captain Nanally is ready to set sail! All aboard, for the family!

fashion.name: Reverse Fairy Tale
fashion.desc:
Q³ holiday limited edition pajamas, perfect for listening to bedtime stories with friends.
"Once upon a time, there was a lonely little gray wolf in the forest who donned a velvet red cape, hoping to make friends."

profile.title: Eibon Staff
profile.description:
She looks like a delinquent girl who might pull out a baseball bat at any time, yet she often helps old ladies cross the street, rescues cats stuck in trees in the Bridge Crossings, and assists those trapped by Anomalies. To the "most prestigious family head in the Bridge Crossings," these are just random acts. She's still troubled by the Coluccis' revitalization plan.
"Hey, look up! The Coluccis' Ichi-daime is about to make a grand… OUCH!!!"
"Sorry, sorry, sorry, I'll pay for the broken flowerpot… Can the bill not be sent to Eibon?"
profile.introduction: The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—currently seeking new recruits!

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Nanally, the queen of Bridge Crossings, whose reputation for causing trouble is known far and wide.
Facing the famous Eibon antique shop, it took Nanally just one glorious month to go from challenging them to being held as collateral for debt.
Work hard, Colucci Family Ichi-daime! Make the world bow and tremble before those mighty fists!

When not on quests, Nanally spends most of her time wandering around trying to revive the Colucci Family.
Her top recruitment targets are obviously the Eibon folks. Sure, there's a dummy or two, but they're pretty decent people overall. Well… they can share in the family's glorious revival.

She's picky about food. Mackerel must be crispy, and lamb chops better come smothered in sauce.
For post-meal cleanup, try Fluffy Tail Care Spray, no ads needed, love from Nanally.
Post-meal exercise options include 360° wall parkour, patrolling territory, or picking a fight with someone. The first one's recommended, safe and risk-free.
Nanally's top pick for best scenic spot in Hethereau is… oh no! A family boss can't reveal her whereabouts!
Though Nanally did mention enjoying some view with an important companion before… but who was it… who was it… she can't remember either. That's what happens when important people forget things, right?

Finally, something important must be said three times:
Nanally is not a cat, she's a tiger! Not a cat, a tiger! Not a tiger, a cat… bah! Not a cat, a tiger!

profile_detail.name: Ichi-daime's Badge
profile_detail.desc:
A carefully cut tiger-shaped bottle cap, topaz blue plastic wrap, plus one unbreakable little safety pin.
Anyone who dares to underestimate the badge on Nanally's chest better be ready for a flurry of punches!
Power, power keeps flowing endlessly… Heh heh, feel the bond of the Colucci Family!

profile_detail.name: "Nini's Adventures"
profile_detail.desc:
Nanally's favorite gang anime when she was a kid… and of course, it's still her favorite now.
She's especially obsessed with the pink muscle tiger that appears at 12:07 in Episode 3… absolutely unforgettable! That towering figure, standing unwavering amidst the sparks and lightning, mirrors Nanally's lifelong creed.
If only she could befriend it… they'd be an unbeatable team.

profile_detail.name: "Family Quotes Collection"
profile_detail.desc:
"Don't worry about my attitude, I'm tough as nails (snorts)." - Nanally
"Fist to flesh, thunder and lightning! This is the romance of gang life (throws punch)!" - Nanally
"Walking this path… it means constant encounters and farewells… I understand that (sighs)…" - Nanally

profile_detail.name: Justice From Above
profile_detail.desc:
At age 8, during the "Puka Crispy Stick Snatching Incident," Nanally defeated a greedy kid and helped him quit sweets. He later lost weight and became the school heartthrob.
At age 9, during the "Torchwood Basketball Court Invasion Incident," she drove off three middle school bullies and opened a hole in a third-floor window with a basketball to improve ventilation.
At age 10, during the "Helping Granny Cross the Street Incident," she achieved the impressive record of only taking 5 seconds from one side of the street to the other. Granny's legs even recovered instantly, and she walked away briskly. What a miracle!

profile_detail.name: World Flip
profile_detail.desc:
Ever seen a reversed spherical magnetic field?
The office building is like underwear that got flipped upside down, and the trees along the edge are tiger tails all frizzed up from static.
The sun gets stuck to the horizon… shadows overlap with magnetic fields… Welcome to a whole new world that's never been revealed.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Newcomer? I—no, ahem, I mean, I, Nanally Coluccis, am the Ichi-daime of the future greatest family in all of Hethereau—the Colucci family! I'll have your back from now on.

daily.name: Chat: Grand Plan
daily.desc: If you've got nothing to …do, want to hear my grand plan for the family?

daily.name: Chat: Keenness
daily.desc: Argh, I'm so bored… Hmm?! Something doesn't feel quite right. I should probably scram…

daily.name: Chat: Books
daily.desc: Family Management… huh… Prologue… first of all… Ugh!!!

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Clear skies! …Why are you looking at me like a pleased mother?

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Boy, the rain is crazy… Alright, let's surf our way back!

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: It's so cold! Hurry up. I'm turning into a popsicle!

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: I feel like a fish on the beach right now. If only I had a Blizzi ice cream…

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning! Any new commissions? The Coluccis are always good to go!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Lunchtime! Is my favorite cheesy eggroll on the menu today?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: It's still early. Let's go out for another round.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Huh? Is it this late already? One more game and I'm going to sleep!

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Snacks, manga, gaming, bug catching, parkour, beating up minions, and… argh, I've lost count.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Worry? Hmm… Uh… I know! Someone ate the pudding I left in the fridge. I was totally looking forward to enjoying it while reading the latest issue of "Monthly Fantasy".

daily.name: Topic: Family
daily.desc: A boss who doesn't stand by their family is not a real boss… We owe everything to the family business for who we are today. Betraying the family is betraying yourself! …How's that? Cool, right? I've always wanted to say these lines from "Sin City Chronicles"!

daily.name: Topic: Electromagnetic Attraction
daily.desc: First a crackle-POP, then a snap-ZAP, and bam—I'm upside down and clinging to the wall! Oh, oh! And when I go whoosh and drop in right in front of the bad guys? That's my signature entrance!

daily.name: Topic: Hair Care
daily.desc: First, rinse the fur with clean water. Then use the special cleanser, blow-dry with warm air until it's fluffy-but-damp, spritz on some conditioners, switch to cool air to finish drying, and trim off any split ends. That's how Adler taught me—after all, the Ichi-daime has to look the part!

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: To get back the family heirloom, I leapt onto the outer pipes of the building! But then—get this—some creep set up a broken live cable just waiting for me. I felt this ZZZZZT jolt and then I was falling! But I swear someone grabbed me! Next thing I know, my body's all spark-crackle, and we're just standing there—on the wall! As for the price… hmm… didn't feel anything weird. Maybe the cost was too small to notice? Is this what they call… plot armor?

daily.name: About Myself: Wounds
daily.desc: This wound's probably from an anomaly. This one is from bumping into a fire hydrant when I chased Danzaburou after it stole food from a grandma… Ah, and this is from teaching those robbers a good lesson. All minor injuries, doesn't hurt one bit! …Huh? Holes on my clothes?! Ahhh… guess I'm in trouble with the old man…

daily.name: About Myself: Street Fighter
daily.desc: Not trying to brag or anything, but before I joined Eibon, everyone on Bluebeard Road and Torchwood Avenue knew who I was! I didn't even need to fight them with my Esper Ability… Uh, what? Did you just say you wanted to learn more about me? Thanks but no thanks. I don't want no trouble around Eibon!

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: A mysterious antique shop owner with an enigmatic background sounds so cool! I really want to be like her. Should I start by learning to drink?

daily.name: About Adler
daily.desc: There is nothing old man can't do, can you believe it? I've tried to dig for secrets a few times when Boss was drunk, and all I got was all sorts of rumors… except Sakiri said none of those were true. Boy, is the guy some sort of trade secret?

daily.name: About Sakiri
daily.desc: It seems like Sakiri… keeps a whole lot of things to herself. But as the leader, I'm very tolerant of my family members. Sakiri can continue being herself. I mean, she might just open up to me someday when I'm as powerful as Master Daffodill!

daily.name: About Edgar
daily.desc: There seems to be a computer in Edgar's head. He can even answer bizarre questions like "Why are round pizzas put in square boxes and then cut into triangles?" or "Why is there more air than chips in a bag of chips?" Honestly, they should have designed Edgar's head the way they have Taygedo's.

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: I've never seen anyone with a more regular routine than Master Daffodill! She never slacks off! I mean, she even brushes her teeth and eats with her back straight! And when she trains, she never takes a break… Uh, I just happened to see it while passing by. I wasn't peeking! I swear!

daily.name: About Taygedo
daily.desc: Taygedo? He's still on probation, but if he does as I say, I just might consider giving him an important role in the family down the road. He really needs to consider himself lucky working for me!

daily.name: About Eibon Antique Shop
daily.desc: A mysterious shop in a quiet alley, an enigmatic shop owner, a high-combat-value cold bodyguard, a versatile robot-like butler, and… a mascot! It looks like a setting straight out of a hot-blooded manga! I mean, life at Eibon turned out different than I'd imagined… but I can already smell the plot brewing! People all over Hethereau are going to know Eibon and the Coluccis. No, people all over the world are going to know Eibon and the Coluccis!

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: This is Nanally Colucci for you.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: New move!

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: Time to show you my ultimate power!

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: I swear, nothing can ever—beat—this!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: A gift like this… Are you sure? I knew you wouldn't let me down!

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Where did you get spoils like this?

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Alright then, let this Ichi-daime know what you need.

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: Well well well… The Colucci Family is always looking for new members like you!

battle.name: Containment II
battle.desc: Get along with everyone from now on!

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Job done! …Uh, can the bill for damages be sent elsewhere?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: Very good, the family shall grow stronger.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: Can this be used to pay off the Boss's debt?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: Hold on, I'll look into this when we get back!

battle.name: Unexpected Gains VI
battle.desc: Oooh! I know this! It… it's…

battle.name: Low Health I
battle.desc: Tch, I've got even better moves!

battle.name: Low Health II
battle.desc: Ouch… hope no one saw that?

battle.name: Low Health III
battle.desc: Cough cough… before this hero's final moments…

battle.name: Takedown II
battle.desc: Beg for mercy earlier next time.

battle.name: Deploy II
battle.desc: It should've been my turn ages ago!

battle.name: Entry Attack II
battle.desc: You picked a fight with the wrong person!

battle.name: Glide II
battle.desc: Whoo! As free as the wind!

battle.name: Special Switch - Hotori
battle.desc: Leave this to me! I won't mess up this time!

battle.name: Special Switch - Adler
battle.desc: Take a break, old man! I'll handle this!

battle.name: Special Switch - Sakiri
battle.desc: Let them witness the bond of the Coluccis!

battle.name: Special Switch - Daffodill
battle.desc: I'm gonna show you how a great teacher makes a great student!

battle.name: Special Switch - Edgar
battle.desc: Why didn't you call your boss when you needed help?

battle.name: Special Switch - Mint
battle.desc: Move like wind, strike like thunder!

battle.name: Special Switch - Zero
battle.desc: Don't underestimate my wombo-combo with the Appraiser!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Hotori
battle.desc: What did you do to the Boss?!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Sakiri
battle.desc: Who gave you permission to lay hands on one of mine?

battle.name: Teammate Down - Edgar
battle.desc: It's not time to give up!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Zero
battle.desc: Who dares to hurt a core Colucci member!?

profile.title: Member of CSU-2
profile.description:
Mint believes everyone has a unique scent and prefers to call people by the scent she detects rather than their names. Her quirky nicknames, energetic personality, and top-notch performance in containment work earn her praise from even the strictest seniors. However—
"Hehe, I'm going to become a CSU Ace… Did I fail the containment regulation exam again…? Uwaa…"
Clearly, Mint needs a bit more luck to achieve her dreams.
profile.introduction: If there was such a ranking, I'd probably hold the record for "Most Times Tricked by Anomalies" in the Containment Units…

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
My dream is to become a CSU Ace! Player Mint, ready to go!
She probably loves field work the most among all the Containment Units members. She even loves it on scorching hot days. She can sneak a Blizzi Ice Cream during downtime, and won’t hesitate to apply for heat allowance when she gets back to the bureau.
The frequency of Mint's makeup exams at the bureau perfectly matches her field mission frequency.

Loyal user of Fluffy Tail Care Spray, she’s brave enough to try all the new scents. By try, she means sniffing them… Mint would never lick her own tail fur!
Her friendship with Nanally started when both their hands reached for the last bottle of care spray in the store! The partners at Nanally's Eibon Antique Shop are all so nice! Hotori Senpai… definitely has some stories to tell!

Ehhhhh! Found Lacrimosa Senpai again during field work! At times like this, I should definitely contact our reliable Lieutenant… User currently unavailable? Must be in a meeting. I'm doomed! Mint can't handle either Baicang Senpai or Fadia Senpai!

Ha! Another day working hard toward becoming a CSU Ace! Once I get this anomaly into Temporary Containment, I can probably clock out, right?

Sniff sniff, Lavender is here! And that unfamiliar but warm Coco scent next to her is…

profile_detail.name: Colucci Family, Honorary Member
profile_detail.desc:
Mint is actually a member of the great Colucci family too… well, to be exact, an honorary member.
After receiving Nanally Colucci's olive branch, Mint thought long and hard about joining, with the same seriousness she puts into preparing for makeup exams.
First! Mint totally respects this genius girl!
Second! A family sounds really cool! Mint loves hanging out with friends (family-members-to-be)!
Most importantly: Mint is worst at saying no to people!
However, Mint ultimately declined Nanally's proposal, promising that as an honorary member of the family, she'd drop by Eibon from time to time.
Because… Containment Units work is super, super busy, and if Nanally suddenly called a family meeting, Mint couldn't guarantee she'd be able to rush over right away. That would make Mint a tardy family member, and she'd be breaking the family rules!
The most important thing about a family is the rules. That's just how it is.

profile_detail.name: Kittens always grow up so fast
profile_detail.desc:
There is an inevitable pain that comes with becoming a teenager—its the most unforgettable memory of a child. Waking up in the middle of the night from an ache, growing taller with each stretch of the body…
But for Mint, this physical pain was never present.
Maybe she was too young when her growth spurts hit; she reached her current height before she was 10. Maybe her naturally carefree nature made her unusually slow to react to the changes that come with growing up. Whatever anguish that summer’s on-and-off joint pain might have brought got left behind along with her brand new, unopened summer homework.

profile_detail.name: Tiny and Big Kid
profile_detail.desc:
An awkward age, an awkward height. She towered so much over her peers that strangers would mistake her for a high school student several years older. It wasn't too surprising that Mint, as such a "big kid," couldn't really play with her little friends.
Mint liked climbing trees to nap in the sun, a blade of grass between her teeth as she secretly watched the neighbor kids play and fight. Then, casually… or at least trying to make it look casual, she'd help get their kites unstuck from the branches.
"Tiny" suddenly appeared during one of her half-asleep moments, and Mint still remembers how embarrassing she looked tumbling out of that tree.
The young-faced little guy called out to her: "Hey, kid."

profile_detail.name: Kitty Crossbody Bag
profile_detail.desc:
A candy-colored waist bag gifted by "Tiny," with a matching notebook inside. The pages are clean, smooth, and absolutely beautiful.
Hands in pockets, super cool "Tiny" gave Mint the childish, adorable gift before parting, stubbornly defending it as "perfect for a little brat like you."
She met someone who looked like a kid, but was actually a sharp-eyed, reliable adult working at the Bureau of Anomaly Control! Tiny and Big Kid had an unforgettable adventure that summer! Tiny helped Big Kid better control her Esper Ability! Tiny is Big Kid's most important friend! Tiny and Big Kid will meet again in the future!
Little Mint achieved her dream at summer's end: join BAC and reunite with "Tiny" (who'll be "Tiny Senpai" by then).
Like an ice-cold cola that instantly cools down a stuffy, sweltering summer… her scent awaits in the not-so-distant future.

profile_detail.name: Taste of Everything
profile_detail.desc:
The tempting beef tallow base of Panda Hotpot… The sweet and tangy Blizzi Berrie Ice Cream… The bitter yet rich aroma of coffee poured full by Ms. Fei…
Familiar, beloved daily moments write themselves in bold strokes engraved in memory through their scents.
Relax, take a deep breath… feel this moment, the flavors of life flowing gently on the breeze.

melee.name: Perfect Containment
desc: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Wields her weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

Triggers when using Perfect Containment after a Critical Dodge. Leaps up to dodge an attack, seizes the enemy's opening, and swiftly swings her weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
context: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.
<Italic>"First place in the Containment Simulation Exam: Mint, from CSU-2."</>

skill.name: Ultimate: Super Claws
skill.desc: Time to cool things down! Dashes forward, then returns to her original position, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of AoE <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies along the path.
skill.context: <Italic>"Ice cream is cool, mint is cool, so mint ice cream from Blizzi means double the happiness! Ooha… I'm already shivering just thinking about it!"</>

ultraskill.name: Ultimate: Thunderous Whirlwind Slash
ultraskill.desc: Are you ready! Channels the surrounding wind into her dual blades, transforming them into wind blades that deal multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area. Lands with a final hit that deals massive <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
ultraskill.desc_short: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
ultraskill.context: <Italic>The full name is "Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash", but I had to shorten it to what it is now because people wouldn't stop laughing about it.</>

qte.name: Ultimate: Invincible Tornado Slash
qte.desc: Perfect finishing work from an elite member! Charges and leaps into the air, performing a penetrating attack on enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.

passive.name: Transform! Super Mint!
passive.desc: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
passive.context: <Italic>"Watch closely now! I'm not the same as before! You're now face-to-face with an elite operative!"</>

passive.name: Bingo! We're Done Here!
passive.desc: While Mint is on the field, her DEF is increased by <NumGreen>20%</> and her resistance to Interruptions is increased by <NumGreen>30%</>.
passive.context:
<Italic>There's always that extra burst of energy when work's almost done, especially when putting out new arrivals…</>
<Italic>"Five minutes till close! Line up nicely and get nullified!"</>

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Hey there Coco, Mint's the name, and I'm your go-to gal from CSU-2. Need a hand? Just call!

daily.name: Chat: Report Card
daily.desc: Did I fail again? Waah… They told me I'd pass if I wore this amulet…

daily.name: Chat: Ice Cream
daily.desc: Blizzi rolled out a new ice cream! Can't wait to give it a whirl after the mission!

daily.name: Chat: Information
daily.desc: The briefing for this containment op has been sent via email… Uwa… so many pages…

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Mmm, what a day! Perfect for some fieldwork… I mean, a totally legit patrol. Not slacking, promise!

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Ugh… Rain makes my tail clumpy…

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: With this weather, I'm gonna be a walking, talking hand warmer for the senpai…

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: It's so hot… I'm filing for a heat bonus when I get back!

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning! Sss—great, Coco Power! Full charge!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: If you can't decide what to eat, join me for Budoriya's Dancing Takoyaki! But remind me to blow on them first.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Hethereau's nightlife is a whole new world! Hehe, I will be your tour guide!

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Eh, this late already? But I'm wide awake!

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: What do I like to do? Shopping! Well… that doesn't sound quite right. Eh, never mind! I love window shopping and discovering new places. It's even better if the shopkeeper and fellow shoppers chat with me! Hehe… wanna come along next time? You'll find lots of interesting things!

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Failed another exam… If this continues, my pay's at risk! I did memorize all the rules, but the exam's dense text always blanks my mind!

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies
daily.desc: Ever think about that frame we nullified together? Its Nexus still gives me the wows. It's like it just needed a little appreciation to leave it all behind… Makes you wonder if those quirky anomalies out there are just looking for something… surprisingly simple.

daily.name: Topic: Gourmet Food
daily.desc: Hungry and indecisive? You've hit the jackpot with me! I'm your ultimate guide to Hethereau's yummiest bites, from network-famous spots to secret street eats. Fancy places? Don't know much yet… but just you wait! I'm on my way up in the BAC, and soon, I'll be the foodie queen of the town!

daily.name: Topic: Luck Beyond Exams
daily.desc: Here, you can have this soda! Just got myself a bonus bottle! My luck's been off the charts lately—scored a Budoriya mega-deal meal voucher once! Why isn't my exam luck so hot? Well, the senpai swear by the Luck Conservation Law…

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: Caught my team chatting with Lavender, calling me "the summer breeze on a date"—messy hair but a smile-maker, a real paradox. What do you think, Coco? That's a compliment, right?

daily.name: About Myself: Nekojita
daily.desc: Whenever I get ramen or takoyaki, I always tell myself, "Cool it before you eat!" But then, someone strikes up a conversation, and poof! I forget and—ouch—burnt again! Waah… Even you get a giggle out of it, Coco…

daily.name: About Myself: Friends
daily.desc: When I'm with my buddies, their cozy vibes are like a power-up! No matter how wiped I am, one big whiff of that friend-fueled warmth like this… agh… and bam! I'm all zippy again—just like that!

daily.name: About Nelly
daily.desc: Lavender is AMAZING—keeping the director's agenda in perfect order. And she's always so warm when she sees me, even with her busy schedule! Of course, it would be better if she didn't always "happen to pass by" when I'm late!

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: Hotori Senpai? I… I don't know anything! Waah… It's not that I'm disloyal, I just don't want to be thrown out of Eibon by the ear next time… The hardest things in this world are passing exams and lying to her! She sees through everything!

daily.name: About Alphard
daily.desc: The director is really scary! Just a whiff of her scent, and my tail's fur stands on end! If our eyes meet… Oh! So scary! I'd rather do a week of fieldwork in the summer than go to her office!

daily.name: About Taygedo
daily.desc: Taygedo is my most reliable ally. We've promised to keep each other accountable on Superman Diary and race to the top of the leaderboard! Gotta keep working out if you want to get stronger, right? Oh, that reminds me of our epic fifty-lap night run last time… what emergency delayed us again?

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: Nanally took on a super tough commission, sneaking into an extremely dangerous Anomalous Realm with Sakiri and Edgar! She said it was a heart-stopping, perilous adventure! Thankfully, her Colucci Ultimate Death Shadow Nether Punch saved the day! Haven't seen her for a while after that. Heard Hotori senpai grounded her… Ah, it's hard for geniuses to be recognized in this world!

daily.name: About Adler
