profile.title: Sterry Express Staff
profile.description:
Flowing water has no form, drifting wind leaves no trace, and no detail of an Anomaly Commission should ever be overlooked. She looks like an ordinary high school girl, but in reality, she's an elite courier who traverses the shadows… and is the record holder for fastest delivery at Sterry Express.
"My name's Haniel! Hethereau’s goddess of headsets… Hehe, just call me whenever you need me!"
profile.introduction: My dream is to become a beautiful high school girl who saves the world!

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Haniel. Public Bagel Account: @Haniel_SterryExpress. Private Account: @genesectparanormaldeptace. Current main alt: @fancontentmaster. The public account is for plugging Sterry Express and managing the brand image of Sterry Express—"If the money's good, we deliver anything!" (Jiuyuan's words). The private account is Haniel's main social hub: fics, art, music, cosplay sets… In the scene, she's a god-tier creator with an endless output. Her only flaw? Her posting schedule is a disaster! Her fans live in permanent agony, screaming: "It's so good, I'll take whatever crumbs I can get!" As for the alt, on days she's too lazy to post, Haniel just surfs Bagel incognito on various throwaway accounts. The second her cover is blown, she jumps ship to the next. She's sworn to defend the sacred right to consume fan content in peace.

Ever delivered a package before? Every Sterry Express courier has their own delivery ritual. For Haniel, the moment she gets the delivery slip, it's like a quest notification has dropped straight into her hands——
Today's Quest: Deliver Package (0/1)
Package Integrity: 100%
Time Left: 00:59:59
3-Star Rating:
No-Damage Delivery (0/1)
On-Time Delivery (0/1)
Service with a Smile (0/1)

When Haniel was little, she had a ton of so-called "hobbies": violin, horseback riding, chess… Just like every other kid in her circle, she went through the usual "elite education" routine. She didn't hate any of it, but that didn't mean she liked it either. It all felt like a drizzly, soggy day where the world's colors are washed out and even birds feathers get stuck together.
Haniel likes sunny days better. So, before her nightly bedtime story, little Haniel sat down with her mother for a real conversation on equal footing. She laid out what she wanted and what confused her, asking the person closest to her for help. Her mom gently stroked her hair and apologized, saying she'd failed to notice Haniel's feelings in time.
Finding your true "hobby," the thing that's really yours, is hard. Luckily, Haniel was one of the fortunate ones.

profile_detail.name: "Gen Z" Anniversary Edition Headset
profile_detail.desc:
The path to becoming an Elite Courier isn't always smooth sailing.
During her 16th delivery quest, Haniel accidentally lost a package. Even though it was found three hours later and Owner Jiuyuan didn't blame her for anything, Haniel still felt really guilty. Not wanting to worry her family too much, Haniel acted normal at the dinner table, casually chatting about all sorts of topics she was interested in. Of course, brave Haniel wouldn't let negative feelings bother her for long. After a good night's sleep, she was back to her usual self… but before leaving the house, Haniel received a gift. The headset she had mentioned at dinner the night before was now sitting quietly by her bedroom door.
"Haniel will definitely become the best courier ever," read the note on the gift box.

profile_detail.name: Old Journal
profile_detail.desc:
Yellowed stickers and childish handwriting… this is the secret Haniel has hidden in the deepest part of her bookshelf.
"The royal hounds are nothing but my steeds. In ten minutes, your crimes will be exposed!"
"Only those who risk everything for victory have the right to stand on the battlefield!"
"You bastards without hope or dreams, I'll keep my back straight and live on until my body is destroyed!"
"The destination doesn't matter at all, as long as I keep moving forward, as long as I don't stop…"
"My revenge… this is where the curtain truly rises."
After all, who doesn't have a notebook stuffed full of childhood memories?

profile_detail.name: Custom Guitar Pick
profile_detail.desc:
After finishing binge-watching "Notes of the Future" at 3:43 AM, Haniel ordered a guitar while her eyes were still red from crying. This time, she would rewrite the band's ending herself.
Unfortunately, her elite education included violin, viola, and cello, but she had never been taught how to play guitar. None of that mattered though. Brave Haniel wasn't afraid of any challenge!
Picture this: After school, Haniel rides her bike alone to the park at sunset, a gentle breeze brushing the loose strands by her temples. By the fountain, the sentimental, shy girl finally finds a quiet corner where no one will notice. She takes a deep breath and pulls out a guitar she got from her father, the pick gently caressing the strings as beautiful melodies flow from the girl's fingertips. Leaves fall onto the water's surface, and when the performance ends, another girl jumps out from the nearby bushes with stars in her eyes, saying "Would you like to start a band with me?"
So Haniel sat in the park with her guitar for three whole months, with only cats as her audience… though cat audiences are pretty good too.

profile_detail.name: Sticky Note with Chili Oil Stains
profile_detail.desc:
How to Brew the Perfect Cup of Black Tea:
Materials needed: Tea leaves (select OP-grade loose leaf, not tea bags), soft water (no mineral water), fresh pasteurized milk, a bit of white sugar, and an elegant tea set.
Steps: 1. Boil water, bring the soft water to a boil
2. Warm the pot for one minute
3. Ration the tea leaves (one teaspoon of tea leaves per cup)
4. Steep the tea leaves for three minutes
5. It's best to drink tea from ceramic cups
6. Add the milk to the cup first, then slowly pour in the tea
7. Add sugar according to personal preference
8. The best drinking temperature is between 60–65 degrees Celsius
### Remember: Milk first, then tea
A line of messy handwriting: Tea first then milk tastes good too

profile_detail.name: Paw Bookmark
profile_detail.desc:
Haniel's books are always filled with bookmarks, each stamped with little animal paw prints. Whenever Haniel befriends small animals in the park, she makes a special bookmark for them, stamping their paws as keepsakes. These little travelers are always on the move. Who knows when they'll meet again?
There's always one slightly worn bookmark in Haniel's books. It’s stamped with a black, somewhat incomplete kitten paw print, and the markings match the black and white bookmark. Haniel never became friends with this one… the cat was far too cautious. While the other cats happily shared the snacks Haniel brought, this one would always watch quietly from a distance.
It still sleeps peacefully on the same little hillside. Haniel sometimes goes there to play guitar, even though she sounds terrible.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Hey there! I'm Haniel Cresswell, but you can just call me Haniel. If you need anything, shout my name! I swear on the name of "E.A.R"—if it's your voice, I'll always hear it!

daily.name: Chat: Limited Sales
daily.desc: Alarm—check! Wi-Fi—check! This time I'm definitely getting that limited drop!

daily.name: Chat: Spells
daily.desc: Hahuie! Shulahula! Supercharged Shockwave Ultra Blaster—by the name of Haniel, I summon you!

daily.name: Chat: Cat Food
daily.desc: Gotta bring some new flavors of cat food when I visit the kittens this weekend.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Such a nice sunny day. Perfect for a nap… or just about anything.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: How about some chill beats? Ugh, hope the headphones don't short again.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: It's freezing! Time for hotpot! Extra spicy, of course!

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Calm, calm, calm… Phew… Haniel's 72nd attempt at meditation… failed.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning! A brand new day starts now!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Afternoon! Got lunch plans? Want a rec?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Evening! I'm heading out for a stroll. Wanna come?

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Late night's the best time to catch up on anime. Don't worry, just one episode before bed! Probably…

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: My goal? Collect every limited-edition collab headset! The new ones I can snag at launch, but for vintage ones, it's all about patience. Sure, even the best-kept old headsets can't beat cheap modern ones in sound quality—but classic OSTs deserve that analog crackle. I'll show you my collection sometime.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Big worries? Not really. Small ones? Tough homework, noisy Illica, vague delivery addresses, picky customers… nothing a good meal and sleep can't fix. Haniel's always back at full power the next day!

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies
daily.desc: The elders said there was a time when humans, Espers, and anomalies were always at odds. But by the time I was born, anomalies felt more like family—pets, even. Sure, not everything's perfect, but most anomalies are super cute!

daily.name: Topic: Manners
daily.desc: Knives on the left, forks on the right, and no slurping your soup? If you can't enjoy food freely, what's the point? Like spicy sticks—put 'em on a gilded plate with violin music… still won't beat eating 'em straight from the bag.

daily.name: Topic: Fellow Enthusiasts
daily.desc: It's wild how people connect—just sharing love for a character can make two strangers close friends. There are things I can't even tell my real-life friends that I'll share with someone online in a heartbeat. I've got one really special online friend… I hope we meet offline someday.

daily.name: About Myself: Vest
daily.desc: The worst thing about following a series? Hiatus notices. You want to lock the author in a room till they finish! But then when it's my turn to write… heh. That's what alt accounts are for! I'm not skipping updates—I'm… looking for inspiration!

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: I used to envy Espers. Like the heroes in anime—chosen ones, saving the world. But when it was my turn, I realized: I don't want to be the protagonist. I want the power to protect others. If I'd been a little stronger back then… maybe it would've survived like the other kittens. But I'm not telling you this to make you sad. Let's go visit together sometime. It's a really pretty place.

daily.name: About Myself: Freedom
daily.desc: "Some birds are meant for cages—their feathers fluff up from fine feed and water. But some birds can't be caged. Their wings only shine in the open sky." Me? I want a warm home and freedom. Maybe that's greedy, but I'm happy with my life.

daily.name: About Jiuyuan
daily.desc: Working at Sterry Express doesn't get in the way of school, pays well, and comes with a world-saving mission! Jiuyuan's also super generous with bonuses—what's not to love? I, Haniel, will become Sterry's top courier! If only Jiuyuan wouldn't get so mad—stress causes wrinkles, y'know… cough.

daily.name: About Jenson
daily.desc: The first time I met Jenson, I thought—"Wow, this guy is so cool!" Like a dependable anime adult! Ask him anything, he's got an answer! No way he's just a normal shopkeep—bet he's hiding some secret identity. That's how it goes in shows!

daily.name: About Illica
daily.desc: Ugh, that noisy Silly! If I'd known we'd reunite at Sterry, I wouldn't have written so much in his yearbook… But hey, he wrote a bunch in mine too. Even gave me a headset I'd wanted for ages as a grad gift. So… I'll let it slide.

daily.name: About Hathor
daily.desc: I really wanna try Hathor's motorcycle. Must feel amazing to ride! People say she seems cold—but that's only 'cause they don't know her. With me around, even Esper Ability blowups are no big deal! Go Haniel! No fear!

daily.name: About Sterry Express
daily.desc: I saved Hathor when her Esper powers backfired. Jiuyuan brought me into Sterry after that. Then I met Jenson, and Illica showed up again… It's like the start of "The Haniel Chronicles"… no, wait, maybe "Courier X Stelry"? "Masked Courier"? We'll work on it.

daily.desc: Hidden relic shop on a shady street vs. undercover express company in plain sight—this arc needs a movie adaptation!

daily.desc: So THIS is… power?

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Ready to save the world?

daily.name: Gift Received II

daily.name: Gift Received III

battle.desc: Punch out! Another job smoothly… uhh… smoothly done!

battle.name: Containment II

profile.title: Eibon Staff
profile.description:
Edgar's quietness often stems from either being absorbed in an intriguing problem or not knowing how to express himself. In Eibon, a place full of oddballs, Edgar is neither criticized nor ignored for being quiet.
"Ahem, I've decided to draft a grand plan for the Coluccis' revitalization tonight."
"Leave me out of it."
"Overruled! Sakiri, you and Edgar both have to come."
"I…"
"Eh—no way."
Though, sometimes Edgar's silence is because he doesn't get a chance to speak…
profile.introduction: Thinks quick, looks like a kid. Is a kid, actually.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Of the "Eibon Anomaly Detectives," most say he looks the most befitting of the 'detective' mantle. Edgar neither denies nor confirms this… Probably because explaining it would be really, really troublesome.
After all, his other titles include "Eibon Ace Trio," "Hyelp's Most Promising Rising Star," "Bridge Crossings' Top 3 Anomaly Hunter," and countless other impressive-sounding nicknames that Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo (and sometimes Kiroumaru too) casually make up.

Despite still being a baby-faced boy, he's remarkably mature for his age; almost old-fashioned, likely because the other two are so impulsive that Edgar is always the one left bowing and thanking people. More often than not, he's the one apologizing and paying the bills.
Of course, Edgar's main responsibilities are gathering intel and planning operations. As for how many times those plans have been followed… well, as long as the results are good, who cares? Edgar has come to fully embrace this philosophy; though it doesn't stop him from carefully preparing each time and having a Plan B ready for any unexpected situations that might (or rather, definitely will) occur.
Taygedo often watches the three young Hunters head out and sighs with mock profundity: "Future Edgar will be just like Adler!"

profile_detail.name: Like mother, like son.
profile_detail.desc:
They say forgetting is part of growing up. Most adults only retain hazy fragments of their childhood memories, as if viewing them through some kind of fuzzy filter that makes everything impossible to see clearly.

Edgar is different. With enough effort, he can recall every single day with perfect clarity.

The day Edgar’s family discovered his esper ability went like this:

Edgar was three years old. It was an ordinary evening, no different from any other. His parents had just come home from work, and they were enjoying family time around the dinner table. Light, delicious dishes accompanied by Dad's interesting little anomaly stories made for the perfect cozy atmosphere.

Both of Edgar's parents were clerks at Yggash Court. They were responsible for writing and maintaining anomaly profiles, so Dad always had endless stories to tell. The stories were little tales adapted from the publicly available anomaly profiles he wrote during work hours.

But young Edgar didn't know any of this yet. Whenever Dad got carried away telling stories at the dinner table, he'd look down to see his precious son's bright, sparkling eyes gazing up at him…

Being worshipped by his son as the "Story King" made all those overtime hours worth it.

"That's strange? It seems different from what Dad wrote in the files? Which one is actually true?"

Something changed forever the moment Edgar asked this serious question. Edgar's dad would probably remember that instant for the rest of his life. But his dad quickly focused on something more crucial: how did Edgar know about the anomaly profiles he'd just filed?

Had his son snuck out through the window and run all the way to Yggash Court to read the files? Did such a small child even have clearance to access those documents?

Over the next half hour, Mom and Dad finally figured out what was happening: Edgar only needed to focus his imagination (both adults also had to stretch their own imaginations to picture this) to connect with various libraries around the world, including Yggash Court's archive. Edgar had probably been too curious about what Dad had written, and couldn't help thinking about his father's name… One by one, the anomaly profiles bearing Edgar's father's signature unfolded in Edgar's mind…

By the way, Edgar had discovered this ability long ago. It was probably innate, right? It's just that earlier on, he couldn't read very well, so he couldn't understand all those dense markings on the white papers…

Edgar had probably already read through his father's early work files, when his writing style was still immature. His dad’s "dark history" was now completely exposed to his son. With this realization, Edgar's dad decided to escape to the kitchen to wash dishes, planning to study his son's esper ability more carefully later.

"This child really takes after me. On the night of our first date, I also read through all your papers from cover to cover."

His wife wouldn’t let him off the hook either.

profile_detail.name: What does Edgar want to be?
profile_detail.desc:
A child prodigy; the "golden kid;" "the boy kissed by the god of wisdom."

The day Edgar came back from Lamplight Academy, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Pink Paws Bank's job offer was worth considering too. With Edgar's abilities, why would't he become a board member at PPB? Of course, when the time came, he shouldn't forget to give a helping hand to that kid living diagonally across from him whose grades barely scraped by in every subject…

The adults listing out and arranging all these bright futures for him had become completely lost in their own fantasies. It was as if Edgar were their own child, fulfilling all the dreams they, themselves, couldn't…

Edgar looked around helplessly, unable to join any conversation. He was so nervous he pulled his scarf up high, wishing he could hide completely inside it. Luckily, at that very moment, his father squeezed through the crowd and patted his shoulder: "What do you want to be when you grow up, Edgar?"

Encouraged by his father's gaze, Edgar said softly:
"I… I just want to be Edgar."

profile_detail.name: The World Beyond the Tree Hollow
profile_detail.desc:
- Point One: Edgar really likes Anomalies
- Point Two: Edgar's mind is reasonably sharp
- Point Three: Edgar can easily access Anomaly profiles

Therefore, Edgar is well-suited to work at Yggash Court's archives like his parents, organizing documents and studying Anomaly-related topics until the day he dies.

Edgar's mother had to work very hard to suppress her laughter at her son's reasoning; not because the conclusion was absurd or ridiculous—quite the opposite, actually. The logic was clear and the reasoning sound, leaving almost no room for refusal.
But having Edgar move into Yggash Court's tree hollow, put on thick beer-bottle glasses, and bury himself in stacks of files was still a bit… premature. Mom understood her son's wishes, but… Wouldn't it be better for Edgar to personally verify those details, rather than learning about Anomalies from other people's reports? Who knew what Anomalies might be waiting around the next corner? How many unknown Anomaly characteristics were still waiting for us to discover them?
Edgar listened very seriously.

He'd probably inherited his mother's adventurous spirit too. What seemed like a rather silly promise was sealed with a pinky promise. Mom took Edgar's hand and, blindfolded, threw a dart at a map. Luck—or perhaps fate—decided Edgar's adventure: his first journey after graduation would take him to Hethereau.

Forever curious, forever seeking knowledge, forever willing to try.

profile_detail.name: The Fateful Job Posting
profile_detail.desc:
Standing on the bustling street corner, Edgar had no idea where he was supposed to go. Though he thought for a long, long time, he remained just as lost, just as confused.
He gave up on route planning, maps, and navigation. Following his mother's advice, he was now "letting the wind guide him" through Hethereau. According to her, encounters with destiny often arrive when you least expect them.
With no destination and no clue which direction to take, could he really find his "destiny" this way? Edgar couldn't fathom such an unplanned approach; the indecision paralyzed him. Instead, he bought a small bag of feed from a street vendor and crouched by the fountain to feed the pigeons.

Later, when Edgar looked back on that day, he felt he'd begun to dimly understand what his mother meant by "fate."
As he felt the pigeons pecking at his palm, watching the sky gradually turn a warm orange as golden clouds drifted toward the still-blue horizon, a sudden gust of wind smacked him right in the face. Along with it came a recruitment poster with crooked handwriting and a drawing of some TV-headed creature.

"Eibon Antique Shop."
He stood up, looked around, and followed the street signs to Hankaku Street.

profile_detail.name: Hearts Will Find Their Way
profile_detail.desc:
They didn't share a language, but understanding Taygedo wasn't too difficult.
By combining the tone and frequency of Taygedo's "Tayge-tayge" sounds with his expressions and gestures, Edgar deciphered:
"Welcome, new friend!"

He began a new chapter in his Anomaly observation diary; it naturally featured the wonderful TV-headed otter. Of course, Edgar's observation records weren't as formal as his parents'; he simply wrote down Taygedo's little habits, quirks, goals… and the many everyday activities with him.
Still, this neat and tidy notebook ran out of space way sooner than Edgar had expected. An entire page was quickly covered with Taygedo's selfies, complete with a bonus paw print. One page had angry highlighter annotations: "So it WAS you, Taygedo! I knew you stole my pudding!" And several consecutive pages had suspicious water stains (best not to think too hard about what liquid that might be), right after the entry: "Should I write about Kiroumaru too? I already agreed on his behalf."

Admittedly, Edgar wasn't very good at expressing himself, but understanding each other didn't necessarily require words, Edgar realized as he lay on the rooftop while stargazing with Nanally, Sakiri, and Taygedo.

…Though language could speed up the process, Edgar added, after ages spent gesturing with Taygedo—that always ended in confusion.

profile.title: Captain of ETD-4
profile.description:
"The chillin' Captain Baicang" is known as the most easily encountered captain of ETD. They say you could run into him in any corner of Hethereau, almost like an NPC you encounter randomly. If you approach him, he'll likely say: "On duty. Do not disturb."
Captain Baicang will then promptly disappear, perhaps genuinely busy with official duties. Such a workaholic…
profile.introduction: The widely recognized "least captain-like captain" from ETD-4.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Captain of ETD-4 at the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Baicang—carefree, irreverant, blunt to a fault, master of dodging work, and a walking troublemaker.
In a certain hidden internal Bagel forum in the Bureau, a heated discussion unfolds: "Who's the least captain-like captain among ETD?"
"Am I the only one who thinks Captain Baicang from Squad 4 has a twisted sense of humor???"
"You're not alone. Every night, before I fall alseep, I realize the pranks he pulled on me at work. You have no idea how much that disrupts my sleep."
"Same here. And when you confront him about it, he just gives you this smiling face… ugh, makes me want to clench my fists even tighter."
…
It's actually pretty funny.
With zero remorse for his antics, Baicang swoops in to gleefully like and save every comment.

Rumors about Squad 4's captain are mixed.
For instance, "Watch out for that long silver-white braid, for it's the Reaper's banner." "He seems to like hiding behind his team members and playing weak, but he's actually analyzing his opponents' strength and countermeasures." "He's reliable when it counts, very capable, and doesn't abuse his power." "He loves all kinds of pasta, especially Italian, but when he cooks it himself he breaks the noodles in half before putting them in the pot (absolutely tasteless)." All these rumors are basically true, confirmed with love from his closest team members.

Beyond that, things lurk in his past that they cannot see.

From an unwanted branch family child to voluntarily entering the main house for Esper Ability development, the young man gradually slipped toward what he thought was a beautiful "abyss." He learned early the weight of life: Light as a feather. Something he could blow away just by speaking. For a long time he stopped saying anything at all, perhaps to atone, perhaps simply from fear. He was like a lone young leaf that had lost its way, spinning as it fell, until finally caught by someone important… that was when he found his home.

Are words curses or prayers? He can easily extinguish life, yet cannot preserve anything. Thus, he can only keep moving forward.
From summer to winter, from spring to fall, the veins of fall leaves turn yellow, still clinging to the branches before finally falling.
In the system of the Five Colors, white is associated with Gui Cang and the season of autumn, giving rise to the name White Cang or Baicang.

profile_detail.name: Branch Family Heir
profile_detail.desc:
Branch families aren't well-liked.
From childhood, Baicang learned to bow his head obediently and show weakness at just the right moments. But was that really enough? He didn't want to bend over anymore; he didn't want to be mocked by the main family's children. He could hear beneath the deathly silence in his relatives' laments and longing for power. His mother's health was poor, but whenever her joints ached, she would simply furrow her brow quietly. The only thing he could do was use his weak Esper Ability to change the topmost layer of skin around her joints, making it softer and warmer.
"If only I could become stronger. Then I could protect everyone."
After learning the only way to become stronger, the small boy made up his mind, quickly packed his belongings, and moved into the main house.

profile_detail.name: Curses and Prayers
profile_detail.desc:
Life fades away so lightly under his words, like a dream. Is he also a prisoner in that dream? Blindly clinging to the ideal of strength, he was once forced to take life, to repeat this agonizing behavior. He could see his own face reflected in their pupils… Why did that young man bear such a sad, confused expression?
For a long time after, he stopped speaking entirely. Words were curses—he was certain of that.
It wasn't until he met his teacher that he realized that even without Esper Abilities, words still held power. Sometimes, a single short sentence could untangle a person's lifelong demons and troubles.
"Where will the abyss lead? You only know by jumping in."
So he put away his fear and jumped into the chasm that exists between curses and prayers.

profile_detail.name: Rebirth
profile_detail.desc:
Like a newborn baby, at first he could only say a few words, then sentences.
Completely opposite to his gradual descent into silence from years before, he again began to cry, laugh, and shout. He reveled in feeling the vibrations in his throat as much as possible.
He would carve himself with sound. Words were his clinging curses, blessings, and power, as well as the destiny he had to bear.
When he finally regained mastery over words, he achieved true rebirth.

profile_detail.name: To This Moonlight
profile_detail.desc:
The Bureau's afternoon tea is pretty good overall, but the new rice dumplings could use some improvement. He can speak properly now; maybe he even talks too much. After giving it some thought, he blames his teacher for that. Things with his teammates seem different lately, and sometimes he gets the feeling that he's actually understood. He hasn't seen that hunter partner in a while, and wonders how he's doing. About that ring, he always knew it was just psychological suggestion…
But in the end, he couldn't say anything at all, just like when they first met.
Facing the grave, the "mute child" gently raised the drink in his hand.
To this moonlight, teacher.

profile_detail.name: Finish Line
profile_detail.desc:
Sometimes, he almost thinks he's living the same life as any ordinary office worker.
But the nightmares always wake him up at night.
Will he reach the end he's imagining for himself?
Until everything is uncovered, until tragedy stops repeating, until all mistakes are repaid… If only he could leave no regrets behind…

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: We've been through life and death together, so let's skip all the formalities, shall we? Hmm… but, come to think of it, I think I've never properly introduced myself… Captain, ETD-4—The name's Baicang. Let's continue getting along well, shall we?

daily.name: Chat: Relaxation
daily.desc: Being serious is a virtue, sure, but tensing up all the time is more exhausting than it ever needed to be! Here's some advice as a friend—you should loosen up once in a while!

daily.name: Chat: Pranks
daily.desc: Wondering why I'm out here? Uh… as you can see, I've been locked outside by Fadia and Mosa. Sigh… How could they be so heartless to their own Captain… Hm? "What did you do this time?" Hey, you're being a little unfair to me, don't you think? Even you assume it's my fault? I mean, I did draw a mustache on Mosa's face while she was sleeping… but! Fadia already made us even! Yet they still locked me outside after that! That can't be a fair trial and punishment…

daily.name: Chat: Invitation
daily.desc: Looks like you're having a good time in Eibon. Seems like she likes you enough. But… if you ever fancy a change of scenery, our doors at ETD are always open for you.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Why waste such a beautiful day cooped up in the office doing paperwork? Yup! I'll deal with that later.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: If you're looking to kill time, try watching roof tiles in the rain. It's quite fascinating. They shimmer differently than usual, with water droplets bouncing from different angles, creating sounds of different frequencies… almost like someone is trying to whisper something.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I proposed introducing "days off for cold weather" for my squad. Which passed unanimously… except for Skia's vote. Then, our dear Director rejected it. Ah well, if you've got any "cold weather days off" or "winter breaks" where you're from, do enjoy them on my behalf.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: To reward myself for my diligent effort working under this scorching heat! I'm planning to take a detour and buy some ice cream from Blizzi. Shh, don't tell Skia… Hm? Hey, this isn't slacking off! But, as thanks for keeping my secret, I'll grab one for you too! So, what flavor would you like?

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Morning! Such a lovely day, perfect for taking it easy… Ah, better not let them find me though. See ya.

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Perfect timing. I was just about to grab some tea during my lunch break. Care to join me?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Smooth sailing 'til meal time! …Unfortunately, I've got an assignment soon… so dinner better be quick and simple.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Getting sleepy? Oh… I suppose it is that time of night already. I got so caught up in our chat that I kept you here for too long without realizing. My bad, my bad.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Don't you ever wonder what kind of face people would make if they found me playing dead in the break room during lunch break? Hahaha! Actually, I'm gonna try it in a bit. Why don't you become the discoverer of my "body"?

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Care less, worry less! Hah, don't give me that look! I never said I had no worries. Let me keep some secrets to myself for now, alright?

daily.name: Topic: Communication
daily.desc: They say language is vessels of the mind, but when people want to convey something, people will always find ways to express themselves, Tower of Babel or not. Words, actions, expressions… Don't you find interpreting them fascinating? Say, look—Skia's expression right now is… uh, he found out I skipped work yesterday…

daily.name: Topic: Day Off
daily.desc: Vacations are all about following your whims and making spontaneous plans! For me—sipping tea, checking out that new cake shop, trading gardening tips with the florist, catching up with old friends… Oh, and there's this beautiful forest near the cemetery at the foot of the mountain. In the evening, when the breeze flows over your skin… It feels good.

daily.name: Topic: Regrets
daily.desc: Sometimes I wonder, if everything that's gone loses its history and name, what remains? The ideas they had, the emotions they experienced… Where do they go? Would a late sun apologize to a withered sunflower…?

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: Words hold far more power than people realize. Scary, isn't it? Haha… With desire, even the most ordinary words can easily bring suffering or happiness. But, I'm sure you know how to use this power wisely.

daily.name: About Myself: Past
daily.desc: The past? It's rare to meet someone as curious as you. Hmm… where should I begin? How about this: Long, long ago, a young man found a creature by the sea that should only have existed in myths… What later generations would consider the earliest anomaly in Hethereau… Hm? Not the past you were looking for?

daily.name: About Myself: Captain
daily.desc: Titles like "Captain" don't really mean much anyway. Me, I'm not one for putting on airs, and my team? They aren't going to respect me more just because I have some title. If you ask me, being captain is nothing but a hassle—speaking of which, I need to come up with an excuse to make Skia attend the Bureau's meeting tomorrow morning in my place…

daily.name: About Alphard
daily.desc: At the rate the Director's docking my pay… Sooner or later, I'll need a loan just to come to work. Ahh… Now I'm wondering when she will actually kick me out.

daily.name: About Skia
daily.desc: Don't let Skia's scary face fool you, he takes his work very seriously. Haha, having such a reliable Lieutenant makes my job as Captain much easier. Though, it would be nice if he wasn't so strict about my little slip-ups.

daily.name: About Fadia
daily.desc: Never mess with Fadia unless you're prepared, take it from someone who knows better. Though, if you're feeling confident, by all means! Try your luck, and promise you'd let me watch! Curious about what happened to me? Heh… let's not get into that.

daily.name: About Lacrimosa
daily.desc: Mosa's incredibly talented, but she's still just a kid who doesn't know much about the world. As an adult, I should look after her. Ugh, why does she hate me so much though? It really breaks my heart…

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: She sometimes reminds me of the Director—just as impossible to figure out… Though she seems different now compared to back then? Maybe she's been drinking too much?

daily.name: About Bureau of Anomaly Control
daily.desc: The Bureau wouldn't be half bad without all those fancy rules and stuffy traditionalists. Though, I guess there wouldn't be much left after removing all that, would there?

daily.name: About ETD
daily.desc: ETD is just a bunch of enigmatics doing whatever they want. They look good on the news, but working with them is nothing but headaches. Everyone showing off their special talents when they're together… it's more like a circus than a workplace. Though, I'll admit it is pretty entertaining… "You're part of it"? Ahaha, why, thank you!

daily.name: About ETD-4
daily.desc: Squad 4's Captain is being isolated by his team members…? Who said that? That's not true! We're known throughout the Bureau as a model team with unparalleled unity… Wait, you saw Mosa, Fadia, and Skia hanging out together near the plaza for shopping and dinner? Huh? When did that happen?

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Taking a step forward now and then isn't so bad.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Looks like my lazy days are coming to an end!

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: Here's to another day of hard work.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: Aha, seems like we have the same refined taste in things!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: A gift from a friend is a treasure… I'll put it where everyone can see!

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: A gift for a gift. My gift for you is… let me think about it.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Psst! The Bureau won't allow its Captains to take bribes!

battle.desc: I'll write the mission report… later.

battle.name: Special Switch - Fadia
battle.desc: The cat and mouse game isn't over.

battle.desc: Hey! Pick on someone your own size.

battle.name: Special Switch - Mint
battle.desc: Gotta put on a good show for the rookies.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Skia
battle.desc: Lieutenant down, that's it for Squad 4? Pull it together!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Fadia
battle.desc: That's not the ending you wanted, right?

battle.name: Teammate Down - Lacrimosa
battle.desc: Mosa, you can sleep when we get home.

profile.title: Sterry Express Staff
profile.introduction: An efficient courier who enjoys creating comprehensive task schedules and strictly executing them to completion.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
After a busy day, Hathor returned to Sterry. The chatter and cheer inside was somewhat inviting. The Mentor warmly introduced two new members of Sterry: Haniel and Illica. Hathor didn't have any particular thoughts about their arrival and simply nodded in acknowledgment. Following the Mentor's arrangements was something she was used to. If Hathor were to recall her feelings from meeting with Haniel and Illica, she'd probably say: Very energetic, great couriers.

However, while interacting with them over the following few days, Hathor gradually realized that the relationships between the five of them weren't as smooth as expected. The Mentor and Jenson, who were familiar with her, could sense her true thoughts from her expressions and actions even when she said nothing, and knew she wasn't intentionally cold. The two new members didn't seem to understand, though. Perhaps due to her icy exterior, they always showed some instinctive wariness, completely different from how lively they were when facing the Mentor. Just as Hathor was repeatedly pondering how to explain to them that she simply wasn't good at socializing, a conversation with the Mentor changed everything. She was given a unique commission: spend time with Haniel and Illica, and understand the lives of modern youngsters. This was a task with a clear directive, so she didn't hesitate.

However, when actually facing the two, taking the initiative to speak proved much more difficult than expected. Hathor had mentally rehearsed scenarios for initial conversations many times and had even prepared several backup plans for dealing with awkward silences. So, during a rare chat session, she tentatively asked about their daily hobbies. The following responses completely deviated from her expectations:
"Of course it's watching the greatest manga of this century, 'Gen Z'!"
"Buying merch, going to events, analyzing the lore with fellow fans on Bagel, conventions, live events, and wotagei!"
"Seasonal anime previews, fan arts, weekly new episodes… we never miss a single one!"
Faced with Haniel's enthusiastic string of recommendations, Hathor showed visible confusion: What is wotagei? What is an "anime"?
Just as Hathor was about to interrupt and give her brain some time to process, she caught sight of Illica, who was eagerly waiting with excitement to join the conversation. She fell silent for a moment and held herself back from speaking. If they'd really like to talk about it… then listening for a while longer wouldn't hurt.

profile_detail.name: High-Efficiency Delivery Station
profile_detail.desc:
In Sterry's early days, there were only three people. Though few in number, they had clear divisions of labor. The Mentor, well-versed in human weaknesses, frequently moved in social circles, while Jenson, with his proper speech and meticulous attention to protocol and rules, could break through negotiation deadlocks with just a few words, making him better suited for business cooperation discussions. However, from beginning to end, Hathor always maintained some reservations toward Jenson. Her sharp instincts for danger, honed through long training, whispered warnings that this man wasn't as rule-abiding as he appeared, though the Mentor's good working relationship with him indicated that Jenson could currently be trusted. As for the heavy responsibility of package delivery, it naturally fell to Hathor, who joined last.
Sterry's Elite Courier, the tough biker chick of few words, first choice for urgent delivery quests. Regular items, fragile goods, anomaly packages—all reached their destinations accurately, safely, and intact to the roar of her motorcycle. Some statistics claimed that her single-day record was 200 regular deliveries and 11 anomaly containers, all completed while assisting as an Anomaly Hunter contain two Class III anomalies. She was truly a tireless delivery machine: cold, ruthless, efficient.
Hathor herself hadn't noticed that such a pace was too demanding and had gone on too long. It wasn't until she returned one day to the shop, seeing her Mentor smiling and introducing Sterry's new members, that Hathor truly realized how exhuasted from work she was.

profile_detail.name: Welcome Gift
profile_detail.desc:
Regalia's motorcycle key is crafted with a streamlined metal casing and delicately polished edges. The key's teeth are slightly worn, bright traces left behind from years of starting up. Such wear marks are only left when the holder is able to move with precision, cleanly, and without excess force. Hundreds, thousands of identical motions are required to achieve such perfect balance.
When alone, Hathor sometimes turns the key once. The turn is always accompanied by a soft click. She has never liked unnecessary noise, yet this sound is one she's never tried to eliminate. It was a calm yet restless night when a welcome gift was silently handed to her through her Mentor's quiet kindness—which later became a habit rooted deep in her heart.
What truly captivated her came later, when the engine sets the rhythm, marking missions received and quests completed.

profile_detail.name: Elite Courier's Delivery Advice
profile_detail.desc:
"Heavy rainfall ahead with flooding of unknown depth. In situations like this, it's best to take a detour and avoid the risk."
"Hethereau is in the middle of rush hour traffic, so there's a high probability of congestion at the next intersection. Fortunately, the target isn't far, so switching to delivery on foot would be more efficient."
"When the road surface is rough, I recommend switching to non-slip tires. When passing through gravel, you need to adjust your center of gravity promptly to maintain stability."
"Night deliveries require constant vigilance, so blind spots must be checked repeatedly. Only proceed once safety is confirmed."

profile_detail.name: "Diving into an Anime World"
profile_detail.desc:
To master anime culture, Hathor approached it with the spirit of tackling a difficult challenge: learning from Haniel and diving into "Gen Z."
Unlike the typical anime-watcher, Hathor wasn't a fantasy-type viewer who would arrange figurines and acrylic stands in magic circle formations, press "summon" on the latest Cubox Technologies tablet, then chant incantations to bless the spirit of binge-watching 24 episodes straight (none of which Haniel did).
Instead, during planned time periods, she pulled out a 1,000-page notebook to record various questions that arose while watching, and after finishing each episode, she wrote a review analyzing plot highlights, viewer comment dynamics, character relationships, and more. She never skipped episodes or watched in double speed, and she categorized and filed the personal styles of the main creative team's directors, scriptwriters, and animation staff.
After several days of study, during chats with Haniel, Hathor could accurately state which episode each character appeared in and how people on the internet reacted to the scene. When Haniel asked how she did this, Hathor explained what she meant by "diving into an anime." When Haniel seemed shocked, Hathor quietly wondered to herself: Perhaps I should've tried harder…?

profile_detail.name: Non-Mission
profile_detail.desc:
One day after finishing her delivery quests, Hathor was riding her motorcycle as usual, speeding away down the road. Perhaps because she'd been watching too much anime lately, the massive billboard advertisement for "Gen Z" unusually caught Hathor's attention. The limited venue merchandise shown in the promotional image was a term Hathor had been hearing frequently recently, and it looked familiar. The items could only be purchased through limited offline channels, like exclusive conventions, shops, or cafes. As it happened, there was a shop nearby that Haniel had been talking about for ages, and somehow, Hathor felt like trying her luck.
The phrase "trying her luck" shouldn't appear in the vocabulary of someone accustomed to precision operations. Since getting into anime culture, Hathor had gradually begun accepting things in life that carried "randomness": the randomness of gacha pulls, daily fragmented discussions about new anime with her two fellow fans, the randomness of new terms popping up unexpectedly, the "pseudo-randomness" of whether limited venue merchandise could be obtained, and so on…
Today also brought a random event: the spontaneous decision to detour to a limited merchandise shop after finishing deliveries. Next she would "try her luck" on limited goods, and then give an unexpected gift to the two little owls… Hathor habitually kept herself wound tight, perhaps due to muscle memory from early high-intensity deliveries, or the professional discipline of strictly following plans, plus the careful caution she'd always maintained toward her Esper after losing control.
But since she'd begun learning about "modern youngster life" from those two, something called "randomness" had started taking root in her body. Like noticing the billboard advertisement today, like suddenly detouring to a merchandise shop, like putting a gift that wasn't on her quest list into her pouch. She had never so clearly realized that she had been wound too tight for too long, so long that she'd forgotten she actually lived in a city full of human warmth and life.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Hello. I'm Hathor, elite courier of Sterry Express. As per request, please confirm the delivery and sign your name on the Proof of Receipt. The commission fee will be settled once the receipt is confirmed.

daily.name: Chat: Brake Pads
daily.desc: Ceramic brake pads maintain performance under high heat, ideal for rapid-response emergencies. Semi-metal pads cool faster and are cheaper, and are the best daily driver. Sintered metal pads handle long, high-intensity braking, perfect for mountain routes. Using the right type in the right scenario minimizes delivery delays and ensures tasks are completed on time.

daily.name: Chat: Elite Courier
daily.desc: Primarily responsible for Class III anomaly deliveries, intel reconnaissance for high-risk jobs, and emergency response. Explosions, car chases, aerial maneuvers…? That's just Haniel exaggerating. She enjoys those movie plots. The reality is, it's just racing against chaos.

daily.name: Chat: Cheek Pouches
daily.desc: Some anomaly containers require strict storage conditions—even slight temperature shifts can change their behavior. Keeping them in a Cheek Pouch stabilizes them. You could think of it like a picky pet pouch—moody and fussy, but it never fails a job.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Delivery note… no sun damage risks. The weather's good.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Wings and vehicles don't handle rain well. Today's deliveries must start 25 minutes earlier.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: Anti-slip tires… snow chains… all set.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Bike's overheating. Taking a short break.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Route confirmed. Let's go.

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Take a break. Stay sharp.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Evening. No time to slack off.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Get some rest. I'll take it from here.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Current top priority is completing the task assigned by my mentor.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Ever since my mentor told me to learn how younger generations live, Haniel's been sharing all kinds of content. Some of them are interesting, but some ideas… "Why be serious when you can be crazy?" or "Stand back! My power is about to go berserk!"… I don't get it. Having power you can't control is not a good thing.

daily.name: Topic: Delivery Routes
daily.desc: Priority is based on urgency and risk level, then route overlap. Weather, road conditions, and high level anomaly activity zones are all factored in before finalizing a route.

daily.name: Topic: Road Cycling
daily.desc: Outside delivery work, I sometimes ride mountain roads with no fixed plan… Just to wander. If you want scenic routes, I can send you a guide later… I'll send them in a file on Bagel.

daily.name: Topic: Food
daily.desc: I don't have strong preferences for food. To me, food's just fuel. But if I must choose… sandwiches. Plenty of calories, stable structure, perfect for work.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: Sometimes my ability spirals out of control and I lose consciousness. I'm considered a threat to city stability and should be restrained. My mentor was the only one who could stabilize me back then. She vouched for me and kept me close. After a lot of training, my control has improved. But if I ever lose it during a mission, and neither my mentor nor Haniel is nearby… end me. Don't hesitate.

daily.name: About Myself: Wings
daily.desc: After awakening my ability, it appeared on my back and I can feel it like a limb. Why only one wing…? It's not broken. Just undeveloped. Doctors said that if I learn to control it, it might just become whole at last.

daily.name: About Myself: Thorns
daily.desc: Based on mentor's records, each time my power flares, thorns begin to spread. I've compressed them to the smallest stable range possible—it's still not fully under control.

daily.name: About Jenson
daily.desc: Most of the time he just isn't there for the business. If you can't reach him, he's probably chatting in some bar.

daily.name: About Jiuyuan
daily.desc: Since founding Sterry, mentor's workload grew heavier. Her lights are often on deep into the night. I want to get stronger. Strong enough to lighten her burden.

daily.name: About Haniel
daily.desc: We met by chance. Back then, I couldn't control my powers. Haniel helped stabilize me. Later, she joined Sterry and taught me a lot about the modern youth life… Rather than teacher and student, she prefers to call us friends. Last time we met? Probably at the anime convention… She was… energetic.

daily.name: About Illica
daily.desc: Whatever he's doing, he's always fired up, spouting weird lines. If you know what he's been watching lately, you can kind of make sense of what he says.

daily.name: About Sterry Express
daily.desc: Early on, my only contact was with my mentor. She and Jenson founded Sterry. In the early days, even small delivery volumes were overwhelming. After Haniel and Illica joined, things ran smoother, and it all felt a little more… alive.

profile.title: Eibon Butler
profile.description:
The true pillar of the Eibon Antique Shop is a humble and reliable old-fashioned gentleman. Many Anomaly Hunter organizations in Hethereau have tried to poach him, but Mr. Adler steadfastly remains Eibon's butler.
"Hello, welcome to Eibon Antique Shop."
profile.introduction: The perfect butler who brings peace of mind to everyone at Eibon and the neighborhood.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Adler, full name Alois V. Adler. Although no one has ever called this clearly respectable butler by his full name. At Eibon, being a butler is an incredibly difficult job. Daily duties include but are not limited to: preparing seven completely different breakfasts and getting picky kids to eat their vegetables, keeping track of and restocking the store's alcohol and hangover remedy supplies, damage control plans for unavoidable losses during commissions, maintaining a positive attitude when facing the shop's account balance…
All in all, any one is lucky to have a butler like him.

Gold medal swordsman, ten-ring archery certificate, advanced tea ceremony instructor, and Bridge Crossings Paper Plane Competition champion. Hethereau's true certification master, "perfect" is never just talk. Nanally once started a challenge called "What can't the amazing Adler do?" with the winner receiving a "Lifetime Honorary Member" title from the Coluccis. Nanally herself won the competition: "Mr. Adler has definitely never caused trouble!" Though as the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, she probably didn't need that reward. As for whether Adler has ever caused any trouble… one would think not.

"Sorry, old man! I'll definitely watch where I put the flowerpots next time, I won't break the sixty-eighth one!"
"You said the same thing when the sixty-seventh one broke."
"Taygedo (Eibon's flowerpot destruction master).” 
"It's fine, it's just a pot. The roots weren't damaged. We'll just get a new one."
"Then I'll buy the new pot with my allowance!"
During the days when he first fell into darkness, Adler once accidentally broke a flowerpot too, one worth one year, four months, and thirteen days of "allowance." Thanks to that, Adler has never accidentally broken anything since.

profile_detail.name: An Old Story
profile_detail.desc:
"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.

profile_detail.name: Sunya - Rupa
profile_detail.desc: As the most frequently appearing Sunya, Rupa has its own special nickname at Eibon: "Little Thing." It's the fifth provisional member of The Coluccis, following Taygedo, Edgar, and Sakiri. Although Little Thing doesn't understand what this means, it still loves the name. Whether it's preparing meals or cleaning up, Little Thing is Mr. Adler's best helper. As for payment for its help… just pat its head and reward it with a slice of carrot cake.

profile_detail.name: Sunya - Vedana
profile_detail.desc: If you had to name the Sunya closest to Eibon, it would definitely be Vedana. Vedana is a sucker for tragic manga endings, a great teammate for co-op games, and the perfect partner for scarfing down midnight snacks. Compared to other Sunyas, Vedana seems to have particularly rich emotions, but actually, Sunyas don't have distinct feelings. Vedana is just good at sensing others' emotions and mimicking them. There was a time when Vedana was quite puzzled by this. Feeling joy because of others' happiness, feeling pain because of others' suffering… where did its own emotions come from? It asked this question to Enlightenment's master. Vedana can't remember how Adler answered anymore, but it remembers that the carrot cake that day was delicious, and that feeling of joy came from itself alone.

profile_detail.name: Sunya - Sanna
profile_detail.desc:
Most days at Eibon are pretty peaceful. Adler doesn't force the Sunyas to do anything. So on days without commissions, they have their own hobbies. Sanna loves to paint. Whenever Eibon receives antique paintings, Sanna is always the first to step forward, identifying authenticity and handling storage. One day, Adler gave Sanna a set of art supplies. From that day on, Sanna became Bagel's newest artist. They say that just one look at Sanna's paintings would make you hear sounds, smell scents, and taste flavors. Unfortunately, no Collection Hall has ever been able to own or even display one of Sanna's works.
Sanna gave its very first painting to Adler, even though it was just a piece of paper with a few hoof prints on it, imprinted like falling snow.

profile_detail.name: Sunya - Sankhara
profile_detail.desc:
Sankhara is the second Sunya to appear in "Enlightenment," and was born from the karma created by war and conflict. Each generation of Enlightenment's masters always had desires, and the fires of karma burned the armor scales day and night. The Sunya gradually fell into slumber, while Sankhara became increasingly awake, since this was the very meaning of its birth. Until the chaotic times passed and this armor became a symbol, eventually forgotten in a dim storage room. Sometimes servants or guests would pause before Enlightenment, speaking their desires to it, but after drinking such burning hatred, most wishes born in peaceful times seemed boring. Enlightenment remained silent. Sankhara sometimes wondered if it too should sleep like its "siblings."
Fortunately, Sankhara really liked snowy days, and fortunately, just as Sankhara was preparing to enjoy one last snowfall before sleeping, it heard a wish, one far more greedy than owning an entire city: "I have so many, many things I want to protect."
In any case, Enlightenment responded to that blind child, and Sankhara had no choice but to follow this new master's way of thinking. Now Sankhara's daily work is taking care of children and using its amazing speed to snag the day's discount items.

profile_detail.name: Sunya - Vinnana
profile_detail.desc:
Vinnana rarely appears before outsiders. Most of the time, it sleeps lazily inside Enlightenment. After all, it was the first Sunya to appear by Mr. Adler's side. "This old one doesn't have that much energy anymore," it always says. Whether it's truly tired from the passage of time or for some other unknown reason, only Vinnana itself knows. However, when it comes to talking about Adler, Vinnana is quite willing to say a few more words.
"Alois, ah… Just to see me, that child would sleep in the corridor every day without saying a word. It was this old one's kind heart, who couldn't bear to see a child suffer, that reluctantly responded to him. Who knew that child would later…"
What follows is Vinnana rambling on about hardships over the years, and those are about what it'd speak of Adler.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Welcome to Eibon. I'm Alois V. Adler, the butler. Please, call me Adler. If you need anything, let me know. I'm at your service.

daily.name: Chat: Business
daily.desc: This month's revenue… is not looking too promising.

daily.name: Chat: Lists
daily.desc: Booze, candy, manga, game cartridges, anti-rust oil… yup, that's everything.

daily.name: Chat: Sunya
daily.desc: Thank you all for the help today.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: It's perfect weather for an outing. I should prepare some bento boxes for Nanally and the others.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: It seems weather forecasts aren't always reliable. Let's find somewhere to wait out the rain.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I should remind everyone to dress more warmly, and I'll prepare some cold medicine just in case.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: One shouldn't indulge in too much cooling off in hot weather—stomach aches are rather unpleasant, after all.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning. How's your rest? Come for breakfast when you're ready.

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Anything you'd like to eat? I'll get cooking.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Hey, relax. It's our free time now, customers usually don't come at these hours.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Getting enough sleep is essential for maintaining good health… Of course, if you'd like to chat more, I'm always here.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Cooking is a discipline—from selecting ingredients to receiving feedback, each meal is a journey. I love preparing meals for everyone at Eibon, though it would be better if Sakiri were less picky.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Troubles? The shop's running at a deficit, my lady bought another counterfeit antique, and Nanally's schemes bring the neighbors to our doorstep. These things give me a headache, but I worry more about everyone neglecting their well-being. As Eibon's butler, I pay extra attention to such concerns.

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies
daily.desc: Most Oddities are actually quite friendly—they just don't know how to express themselves, or perhaps their ways are different from what we're used to. If you get the chance, try communicating with them. You might just discover a completely different world.

daily.name: Topic: Etiquette
daily.desc: Neat attire leaves a good impression, but true etiquette is about considering others' feelings and not imposing our habits. Forcing others to follow our principles is the greatest breach of etiquette.

daily.name: Topic: Tips
daily.desc: The secret to handling everything quickly? For routine matters, I simply prepare lists in advance and follow the plan. Sometimes unexpected situations do arise—that's when patience and a bit of luck come in handy… I suppose with enough experience, you start to recognize patterns in how to handle things.

daily.name: About Myself: Armor
daily.desc: This armor is called Enlightenment. It's not mine; I'm just fortunate enough to use it. Sunya resides within it, making household chores easier.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: It would be difficult for me to have a truly neutral stance on Esper abilities or anomalies, as I undoubtedly have vested interests with them… Most people are puzzled when they first meet me, wondering how a blind man can perceive the world around him with such clarity. I was once just an ordinary blind person, dependent on others for many things. It was the Enlightenment that gifted me with this special ability to perceive the world, and with it, a duty to protect.

daily.name: About Myself: Glasses
daily.desc: These glasses? Nanally bought them for me with her first earnings from commissions after joining Eibon. She was absolutely beaming when she said, "This is how the gentleman thug dresses in movies!" Seeing her so excited, I couldn't help but accept this unique gesture. As for her own pair, she got them to embody more of a… "Ichi-daime boss" vibe? Such gifts are quite in style with Nanally.

daily.name: About Myself: Being Perfect
daily.desc: Perfect, huh? You're far too kind. I simply have a few more years behind me, having seen a bit more of the world. When I was their age, I dreamed of being as bright as they are now.

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: My lady carries many burdens… I'm ashamed to say I can only help with mundane matters, but it's my honor to shoulder even a small portion of her responsibilities.

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: Nanally is a simple kid. Thanks to her, Eibon has become much more lively. I wish when things happen, she would be more… But I'm not complaining about the noise. This is exactly the age when they should be playing around.

daily.name: About Sakiri
daily.desc: Sakiri isn't great at expressing her feelings directly. For someone as sensitive as her, actions speak louder than words. She often cares more than she shows. Giving her space helps her open up gradually.

daily.name: About Edgar
daily.desc: Being unsociable isn't necessarily a bad thing—everyone has their own way of living, and Edgar himself isn't troubled by his difficulty in communicating with others, which is perfectly fine. Besides, he has Sakiri and Nanally by his side who understand him best, and they'll always be his most attentive listeners.

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: Daffodill shows unwavering loyalty to my lady, handling all matters concerning her personally—she's someone we can truly rely on. Thanks to her support, I can focus on taking care of other tasks… Though sometimes, I wish she would take better care of herself too.

daily.name: About Taygedo
daily.desc: I'm grateful for Taygedo's regular help around the shop, especially those interesting little inventions of his. Though Sakiri, Nanally, and even my lady joke about selling him to settle debts, they can't help but ask about him when he hasn't been around for a while.

daily.name: About Eibon Antique Shop
daily.desc: Eibon wasn't always this lively. When we first settled on Hankaku Street, it was run-down. Sakiri barely spoke, and both my lady and Daffodill were busy. Things changed when we found Taygedo, and even more when Nanally and Edgar joined. The shop was filled with warmth and laughter. Now, with Appraiser here, Eibon feels like a true home.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Learning knows no bounds.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Could never stop improving.

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: A moment worth remembering.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: What a wonderful gift. Thank you, Appraiser.

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: I was just reminded of some things in the past… I like the gift a lot. Thanks.

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Appraiser, I've always known you had great taste.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: I'll treasure the gift and the effort you put in.

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: I'll take care of the cleanup work.

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Need something to recharge your energy?

battle.name: Nullification II
battle.desc: Go take a break. I'll handle the rest.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: What a pleasant surprise—today is turning out to be quite a good day.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: An unfamiliar collectible— should take it back for a closer look.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains IV
battle.desc: Looks like we might turn a profit this month.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: How about we have something special for dinner tonight?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains VI
battle.desc: Quite good quality. Let's keep it.

battle.name: Deploy II
battle.desc: How may I be of service.

battle.name: Special Switch - Hotori
battle.desc: Miss, allow me to handle this.

battle.name: Special Switch - Edgar
battle.desc: Need me to service your computer parts?

battle.name: Teammate Down - Sakiri
battle.desc: Even Kiroumaru needs time to digest.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Daffodill
battle.desc: Daffodill, thank you for your hard work.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Zero
battle.desc: You did well, Appraiser. Leave the rest to me.
