fashion.name: Moonlit Courtyard
fashion.desc:
Zankou's loungewear. A loose robe and wooden clogs, perfect for drifting into a long, uninterrupted dream.
"The night's still young… I wonder what it has in store."

fashion.name: Fleeting Moment
fashion.desc:
Zankou's usual attire. Now that The Scarlet Letter is gone, where will fate lead Zankou next?
"One moment, forever."

fashion.name: Red Nightshade
fashion.desc: Zankou's attire from her days with The Scarlet Letter. When a job gets messy, she prefers something bold enough to turn every head. After all, getting noticed is part of the hunt.

fashion.name: Searing Lavender
fashion.desc: As fireworks bloom across the sky, the dazzling display can make reality feel like a dream. Is this moment real, or a beautiful illusion you never want to wake from?

fashion.name: Twilight Noir
fashion.desc: Light shifts, and something stirs beneath the surface. When night overtakes reality, even the sweetest dreams may be quietly rewritten.

fashion.name: Autumn Vignette
fashion.desc: Zankou's custom casualwear, created after studying modern fashion. It helps her blend into the city crowd, though whether it actually looks fashionable is still up for debate.

profile.description:
As a former member of "The Scarlet Letter" and the most uncanny and dangerous Esper under Inanna's command, Zankou possesses powers that terrify ordinary people, with a brutal way of going about her business. In elite social circles, the name "Red Nightshade" once struck terror into many a celebrity and magnate.
Whether facing enemies or allies, Zankou is always akin to a predator lying in wait, using her right eye to read emotions and weave illusions, and gaze upon your soul with hunger…
profile.introduction: A former member of the secret organization "The Scarlet Letter," code-named "Red Nightshade," now a prisoner on Ghroth Island.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
Zankou rarely speaks of the days that came before she joined The Scarlet Letter. To her, such dark times were not worth remembering.
It all began with a careless, secret experiment. A solitary, unknown girl was treated as a vessel for cultivating Esper Ability, and the researchers, along with those greedy, gluttonous elites, considered her a worthless sacrifice on the path to greatness. Unbelievable pain, solitude, mutilation, rebirth… these grotesque, repulsive torments were daily occurrences. Time and again, she would inch towards the edge of death, only to be dragged back to the world of the living.
Until, in a bitter irony, a miracle truly came to pass: her Esper Ability burst forth, turning that sinful dungeon into an ocean of blood. No one survived but her.
A noble, pure-hearted philanthropist was the first to discover her amidst the ruins. She brought that girl back to the gardens, as if transporting a feral wildflower. To her delight, that wildflower, born in the filth and muck, was already tempered completely—exactly to her liking.
Thus, the flower known as "Red Nightshade" took root in the soil of Scarlet Letter, and Inanna gained her loyal adopted daughter—her sharpest dagger.
Yet, Innana was unaware that the "leash" on her daughter frayed at the edges. Zankou kept quiet about her own Esper Ability, and only opened that uncanny eye of hers from the shadows, hoping to peer into her new family's hearts. Those who tried to bully her, curry favor, or befriend, were merely ignored—and instead swept into a sinking mire, where reality and illusion blurred. They began to doubt what was real or false, slowly transforming into soulless husks—playthings to be puppeteered by Zankou.
"Everyone has a flame burning in their heart."
To Zankou, people's faces were merely monochrome, but the bright red flames of their souls never ceased to burn.
Each person's fire was different—some fierce, some dim, some dark, some crimson… In her eyes, most were utterly mundane; the few that were worth a second glance could only serve as brief playthings. It was only when she watched those flames burn themselves out on the brink of collapse, exhaling flake after flake of hopeless ash, that she showed a hint of delight, as if at last admiring a masterpiece.
But in this cold, monotonous world, dotted with countless dreary flickers, there was always one different soul… At first, it was a blinding white; later, it became a hue she had yet to see anywhere else—an indescribable color.
"How beautiful… I'm unable to look away."

profile_detail.name: Blinding Scarlet
profile_detail.desc:
When it comes to the unknown, human beings have always shared the same curiosity and arrogance. From awe to fear, from scrutinizing to touching, until the spark of "conquest" fully ignited the fuse of greed… such was the attitude some held toward the existence known as "Espers".
Cults, circles, private research institutes, secret societies… those driven by greed and pride gathered like hyenas, desperate for a morsel of flesh. They would pay any price, ignore every restriction and taboo, and thirst for the miracles an Esper Ability could bring… or perhaps, for the ability itself.
On a remote island, there was a secret society deemed "Eyepecker." Its members believed in a heresy: Esper Abilities were a gift from a mysterious unknown, and that gift would bless the fortunate ones born with special "eyes". They went about collecting those who were described as such, regarding them as "vessels" for the awakening of Esper Abilities, imprisoning them in dark, dank dungeons and burning their eyes every day with a searing mixture. They firmly believed this would awaken abilities—and that by transplanting those eyes into themselves, they could seize that power for their own.
Zankou's earliest memory began in that cruel jail.
The girl had a pair of gem-like eyes. She could not understand why, her vision deprived of color, she could only see a gray-white blur. What she understood even less was how far a human's greed could push them to do the unspeakable. Ever since Eyepecker had abducted her, the meaning of her existence had been reduced to being completely bound every day, having her eyelids pried open, and trembling as the scalding, acrid, murky liquid dripped onto her eyeballs.
The voracious, intoxicated by their own delusions, carried out their devilish deeds day after day, heedless of its absurdity. Yet, ironically, Zankou really did awaken the Esper Ability dwelling in her eyes under that inhuman torture. When she was brought to the eye-extraction ritual, the society's members were already arguing over who the eyes would belong to, each one revealing the hidden identity they had been concealing all along: the powerful, the wealthy, or some illustrious family… Their voices grew into a raucous uproar, and in the haze of anesthesia, Zankou saw the first color beyond black and white. It was warm and blinding, burning brightly among the embers of countless souls, spraying from wounds opened in slaughter, weaving into a scarlet maelstrom that encircled her…
That day, the Eye of Delusion shrouded the entire island, and the lowlifes who competed with one another instead butchered each other to death, drowning within the hallucination, until no one was left alive.

profile_detail.name: Spider & Bloom
profile_detail.desc:
Zankou saw a shockingly pleasing red in the pool of blood.
The owner such red strut towards her, her high heels echoing throughout the empty dungeon's walls. Then the clacking stopped, giving way to velveteen words:
"Let me see your face, my poor little petal.
From today on, Scarlet Letter is your home."
Home… what was that?
The woman before her promised the girl something she couldn't comprehend: a "home." Though the girl couldn't understand the meaning of the woman's words, she could feel that her voice and touch were gentler than anything she had ever experienced.
"You may call me… Mother."
Zankou looked warily at the tall, thin woman before her. Beneath her gentle gaze lurked an indecipherable smile. The blaze of her soul was as vermilion and resplendent as the clothes she wore, and its greedy flames danced and flared before the girl's eyes, almost burning her alive.
Yet, she still willingly replied with one word only:
"Mother."

profile_detail.name: Chasing Blooms
profile_detail.desc:
The Scarlet Letter Garden nurtured many flowers. The loving Inanna tended to them, raining down sweet dew and pruning their branches. The flowers that pleased her most were even granted new names—"Red Nightshade" was one of the many.
Yet, Zankou knew that Mother did not love her flowers; she simply enjoyed standing at the center of the garden and admiring her hard work.
Within the Scarlet Letter's estate walls, Inanna no longer needed to hide her true nature. The generous, sentimental philanthropist was merely a public performance. In the confines of her heart, there was only a businesswoman's austere coldness and greed, along with the arrogance that developed unceasingly once she had entered "high society". Like a towering crimson spire, she cast a chilling shadow, looming endlessly over her Garden.
She always mixed rewards with punishment when dealing with her daughters. Zankou was subjected to the harshest training. Zankou didn't care; her time in the dungeon had long since numbed her to pain. Even after enduring such torment at the hands of Mother, Zankou still dedicated complete loyalty to her, and carried out every task she was given. As she watched her other sisters have their emotions and fates toyed with, however, Zankou found that she, too, could find a little amusement in the Garden.
The Eye of Delusion could perceive emotions—and taste them, too. The rotten sweetness of fear, the bitterness of despair, and the sharp bite of hatred… her fellow flowers' feelings became nourishment for Zankou… And Zankou came to fully understand Mother's hobby.
Her aberrant eye was always on the prowl for vivid colors, as if admiring a field for its beautiful blooms, only to pluck the finest flowers. Whenever a lovely sobbing rang out through the estate at night, and the tiny glows of the soul twinkled, Zankou would gladly bring comfort to that fragile bud, then later control it, toy with it, to then ultimately cast it aside. Under her words and gaze, those unsettled little buds bloomed.
Such pleasure never lasted long. The girls' minds were rapidly frayed from gazing into the Eye of Delusion, becoming husks at Zankou's mercy, and the color of their souls faded, withering and unwatered.
It never mattered, though. The Scarlet Letter's Garden was vast; even if one blossom withered, there would always be another waiting to sprout.

profile_detail.name: 姐姐，姐姐
profile_detail.desc:
Among all her sisters, only one made Zankou limit her abilities when they locked eyes.
Her soul was a pure, translucent flame, as clear as the first light of dawn. As if beholding a wondrous sight, she blurted out at their very first meeting…
"What a beautiful color…"
But the white-clad girl named Daffodill didn't understand. She simply obeyed her adoptive mother's orders, walked to the car door, bowed, and reached out to welcome her new little sister.
"Welcome home, little sister."
Zankou reached out toward her, obsession and curiosity gathering in her eyes. Unknowingly, a feral smile nearly surfaced on the girl's face. As if snatching something away, she suddenly clutched that girl's hand tightly, pulling her closer, as if wanting to bathe herself in that hallowed flame…
After that unconventional greeting, they were eventually ordered to become partners, sisters—family.
Zankou knew she and her sister were not the same, but so what? Two complete opposites—conjoined in their fate. In the Scarlet Letter Garden, countless vines would wind around and bind them, till death did them part. They would step into the same mire, share the same flower bed, walk onto the same battlefield, and return to the same grave. They were as close as family could be.
Day after day, she watched Daffodill through her "special" eye. As the first daughter adopted by Inanna, Daffodill was steadfast and immovable, rigid—no matter how harsh the mission, she would always surpass Mother's expectations. When it came to eliminating a target, she was even unfeeling… Yet that very same sister would tenderly heal her wounds after every mission or punishment.
…But later, for some undiscernable reason, Daffodill changed. That decisiveness and indifference became hesitation, along with growing melancholy and confusion. From then on, that white, steady flame would occasionally flutter.
"So she has a side like that too, then."
Zankou continued to observe Daffodill, as though watching a bud begin to blossom. If her sister became weak, before Mother destroyed and discarded her, she would transform her into her most prized possession. With a heavy heart, Zankou looked forward to that day.

profile_detail.name: A Rabbit
profile_detail.desc:
"…There's a rabbit in the corner of the backyard."
"I fed it some cabbage leaves. It ate them all, and it didn't bite me…"
Zankou listened to Daffodill speak, smiling, while her thoughts strangled her heart.
She didn't understand what was so appealing about a rabbit—it was just a gray vermin with red eyes. Nor did she understand how a mere rabbit could make her sister look that… happy.
But for the next few months, whenever it was time to go to the backyard for punishment, Daffodill would sneak glances at that rabbit, and Zankou would watch her. Even while enduring such unimaginable pain, her sister's gaze would soften considerably, directed towards that one corner of the garden. Sometimes, Zankou considered that, perhaps, such a gentle look was not something Mother would allow to appear in her eyes.
One day, Daffodill found only the rabbit's corpse in that familiar corner. She remained silent for the rest of the day. Before night had even fallen, she locked herself in her room.
Zankou knocked for a long while before the door finally opened. Her sister's hollow gaze hung low over the floor, her soul flickering wildly. Zankou caught a trace of bitterness in her sister's expression, something she had never seen before.
She tentatively reached out and slowly drew her sister closer. She felt Daffodill hesitate for a moment, then, as if shedding all her burdens at once, leaned her face against her shoulder without resistance. When their warmth met, Zankou sighed. Deep down, she was relieved that the rabbit had died.
"She might, perhaps, suspect that I was the one who did it."
On many nights after her sister fled, Zankou often thought of that dead rabbit.
But Daffodill never brought the matter up again.
Zankou never felt regret. She knew that the end of their road could only end in one way: death. When either one of them reached their final moments, using their final breath as a farewell might not… be so bad.
"Sister, I really didn't kill that rabbit."

profile_detail.name: Deadly Gaze
profile_detail.desc:
Zankou and Daffodill were once Scarlet Letter's sharpest daggers. The sins that stained them were as dark as the hollowness in their heart.
Trial after trial, mission after mission, they enacted Mother's bidding. Zankou didn't care for her life as a blade; rather, she only desired to watch Daffodill.
As an assassin, she knew of every obstacle Mother needed removed. But as a person, she knew only Daffodill
Daffodill always stood before the mirror after finishing a mission, contemplating in silence as she bandaged her wounds. And every time, Zankou would quietly savor that weary, melancholic back—beautiful even when riddled with scars—and, as always, use her Esper Ability and a tender hug to dispel her sister's doubts.
Finally, those doubts bore fruit.
On one mission, when it was time to bring the blade down on a target, Daffodill listened to the target's pleas for mercy—and stilled her hand. Zankou witnessed her hand trembling, yet also noticed the bloodthirstiness shrouded in those cries for mercy. At that moment, a treacherous idea took root in her mind.
In the blink of an eye, the cold gleam of a hidden weapon flashed toward her sister. Zankou deliberately stepped in front of the blade, taking the blow. In this moment, Zankou also struck back against the assailant, killing them.
Blood poured from her wound—pain she would willingly endure. Breathing hard, Zankou gazed upwards. She saw Daffodill's trembling hand loosen around the knife, and heard hurried footsteps and an apology laden with fright.
"At last, you've become as weak as they are."
Zankou watched, enraptured by the violently wavering flame before her.
She had imagined it countless times: no longer restraining her Esper Ability, Zankou using her eyes to see through everything, then pulling her into an illusion meant only for the two of them. Twisting her likes and dislikes, manipulating her memories—until, before she could completely devolve into a sentimental, uninteresting commoner, she would become Zankou's plaything.
However, in those final moments, Zankou had relented.
Even softened and shaken, that white flame still fascinated her. She no longer desired to snuff it out.

profile_detail.name: A New Hue
profile_detail.desc:
Zankou could recall when her sister changed, and how trusting, careless, and foolish she had been before.
It was at one of Inanna's auction events. Daffodill, who was in charge of security, had acted out of turn and returned after a brief disappearance looking a bit haggard. She covered her left eye and brushed the whole incident off, referring to it as an "accident." Seeing her sister's face wounded to such an extent caused Zankou to fly into a rage, so much so that in the next few missions, her methods were far more brutal than usual. For months after, Daffodill wore an eye patch. To comfort her sister, Zankou even had one made for herself—completely useless, of course—and when she took it out to show off, her sister could only respond with a startled laugh.
Zankou never once wondered what exactly that eye patch of Daffodill's was hiding.
On one rainy night, she witnessed Inanna lying in a pool of blood, and Daffodill—the Esper who had taken off her eye patch and was holding a blade. Mother's blood had stained her sister's collar a glaring crimson. And that flame… that pure white flame was entirely extinguished. It had become something utterly unlike anything before, unlike anyone else—a color of sublime purity Zankou had never perceived in her life.
Zankou attempted to make sense of the chaos before her. Too many questions crashed together in her mind. She didn't understand why her sister had betrayed them, didn't understand where her sister's Esper Ability had come from, and didn't understand what that odd flame even meant. As for Daffodill… she merely stood there, unmoving, like a child frozen in fear, strangled by shame.
Her sister fled in silence, that streak of light vanishing beyond the hedges of the Scarlet Letter Garden.
Zankou struggled to call out for her, their mother still lying off to the wayside, forgotten in a pool of blood. All Zankou's thoughts—and her gaze—incessantly followed her sister's departing figure. An unknown amount of time had passed before she finally uttered a few words, those same words she had said to her sister countless times before:
"What a beautiful color…"

profile_detail.name: Fated Reunion
profile_detail.desc:
Mother survived Daffodill's attempt on her life. She woke, recovered from her injuries, and maintained her usual image as if nothing had occurred. Zankou was unsurprised. Daffodill had mastered the art of assassination, but someone like Mother was not to be trifled with. She still performed her role as that poised, luxurious philanthropist—as if entirely unphased by Daffodill's betrayal.
Zankou could see the subtle change, however.
In the past, Mother's emotions had always been stable and cold, even going so far as to be utterly arrogant. Following the assassination attempt, though, she became distrustful, constantly carrying the unease often found in those in positions of power…
The scarlet tower in her memory had already collapsed, but Zankou no longer cared about such frivolous things.
Right now, her only desire was to drag that woman who had slipped through her fingers back by the neck…
Mother brought another "Little Sister" back home, eventually. She had begun to favor the children whose vulnerability made her feel powerful in turn—and the girl named Poinsette was one of them. At first, Zankou only considered her another flower among the field. Unexpectedly, though, she discovered an interesting side to the newly introduced bud. Precocious and gifted, that little bud wouldn't let Mother's favoritism or torment transform her into a wilting flower. Instead, she became a resilient weed, seeking any way of escape from Scarlet Letter's garden. Seeing through her act, Zankou became even more curious and took the initiative to entice Mother into promoting Poinsette, so that she would serve at Inanna's side from then on. That little bud, now a weed, noticed Zankou's intentions, and could only obediently play along…
Though the song and dance between the two amused Zankou for a while, it couldn't fill the void left by Daffodill's absence. Zankou never encountered anyone whose soul could compare to hers, and thus her longing grew day by day…
At last, after a long and thorough investigation, she caught wind of Daffodil's trail—a rundown antique shop in Hethereau, a shanty utterly unfit for her.
Fortunately, Inanna's next target was also in Hethereau, so Zankou gladly undertook the mission and went to investigate. Daily, she disguised herself as various passersby, passing by Eibon's door countless times, until she had finally come upon the face she had waited so long to see.
Suppressing a smile, she slipped into a dark alley, pressed a hand to her chest, and felt her heartbeat pounding wildly like a drum.
"This time, you'll never escape from me again, Sister."

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: I'm a skeleton in your closet, an illusion in your reflections, a nightmare in your dreams… Embrace me, and sink.

daily.name: Chat: Lone Stride
daily.desc: At this point, I don't care where I am anymore…

daily.name: Chat: Infamy
daily.desc: When you run into big shots, try telling them about the "Red Nightshade." You might see some faces twitch.

daily.name: Chat: Sightings
daily.desc: I've seen my fair share of dignified, well-mannered people at Mother's auctions. I glimpsed into their hidden desires. They covet wealth, long for immortality, hunger for power, or want to witness a miracle… Those are all but hollow delusions and tired clichés. But when they finally run out of road, with the dead end of having them by the throat, that raw despair… now that, that has some flavor to it.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Flowers will grow well in this weather.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: No rain can ever wash away old blood stains from years ago.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: Here. Gaze into my eyes. You won't feel cold anymore…

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Such heat…

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning, Appraiser… What? Still getting used to this?

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: How cozy… Take a nap if you want to. I won't bother you.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: It's getting late… You're having a good time.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: People only reveal their true selves late at night… Appraiser, want to have a heartfelt conversation?

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Sure. Let me indulge your curiosity. My hobbies are… tea, wine, and floristry. I dabble. But if I had to pick a favorite, it would be hunting. I love toying with my prey, watching them struggle in their illusions, running and hiding in corners they deem safe, until they realize they have nowhere to go and lose their last shred of will to survive… Care to give it a try? Hunt with me… or perhaps, be my prey?

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: …Those are things of the past. They don't matter anymore.

daily.name: Topic: Family
daily.desc: When Mother was in a bad mood, she loved to use "training" as an excuse to punish us physically. After she punished us, she'd start crying those fake tears while saying things like "Mother forgives you." That was her way of raising us. But for the four of us… Daffodill was made of iron. The whip could come down on her and she wouldn't even blink. I could see straight through Mother's intentions, so of course I wasn't affected. As for Poinsette… her fake tears were more convincing than Inanna's. Watching the two of them put on their mother-and-daughter act was one of my favorite ways to pass the time.

daily.name: Topic: An Old Story
daily.desc: The world isn't all sunshine and rainbows. In its dark corners, plenty make their living off the edge of a blade, preying on the weak and endlessly fighting each other for treasure, anomalies, or some Esper. As for Inanna… before arrogance clouded her judgment, she was shrewd, calculating, and ambitious. She accrued all the wealth of infamy for the Scarlet Letter. Daffodill and I were responsible for dealing with her rivals… who, of course, were mostly the same type of person she was.

daily.name: Topic: Weapons
daily.desc: This blade is called Fatebinder. It's another one of Mother's collections. It creates those living, cloth-like drapes. Back then, I picked this blade because it caught my eye out of a pile of dull weapons. At that time, Daffodill loved maintaining weapons. The first time she saw mine, she thought the blade was stained with blood and offered to teach me how to polish and care for it… Shame, the blade was bloodred to begin with. No amount of scrubbing could ever change that.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: This eye is called "The Eye of Delusion." It can detect emotions, confuse minds, and erode one's reason, making them impulsive, fragile, and fall in a whirlpool of feelings. With a little preparation, it can also create illusions and even trap people inside. As for the price… every time I use my Esper Ability, the eye grows restless, with a hunger to feed on negative emotions from others. Oh, and if you meet my gaze for too long, your mind might get worn down, until you end up a plaything I can command however I please… Alright, don't turn away. That's just a joke.

daily.name: About Myself: Color Vision
daily.desc: In my earliest memories, the world only ever had two colors: black and white. When my powers awoke, a third color filled the void. It hid beneath gray skins. It was sometimes blinding, sometimes murky, but always vivid, always warm… You're frowning again. Do you think I'll ever be able to see the color on that flawless face of yours, Appraiser…?

daily.name: About Myself: Observation
daily.desc: Sometimes I disguise myself as someone else, then I walk through the crowds to observe this city… It's so accepting, so unfocused, that almost everyone who settles here convinces themselves they've found where they belong. Some even end up throwing away their own truth, forgetting it, just to protect that sense of belonging… Appraiser, are you one of them?

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: She has a pure soul, like a steady white flame that never burns out even in the midst of blood and violence. We were partners for years, and I never tasted a negative emotion from her. Then one day, standing over an enemy who was pleading, she hesitated. That night, the girl who never spoke about anything came to me for a talk. I thought she was growing weak, and while I was concerned for her change, another part of me wanted her to rely on me more… Then came the betrayal. I'll never forget the storm that day, the look on her face as she escaped, and the color burning in her soul… A color I'd never seen before.

daily.name: About Inanna
daily.desc: Inanna adopted many children, but she never cared for us. She simply sorted us into tools, collectibles, or bargaining chips depending on her needs. Me? I was a tool for removing obstacles, the one she trusted most at that… Her arrogance was laughable, but after all those years, she gave me a place to belong, and she let me have a real family… I still miss her, especially the way she looked before she gave up her last breath.

daily.name: About Hotori
daily.desc: I didn't expect a shabby, run-down antique shop to harbor such a big shot—the Witch of Time… Heh, no wonder the Scarlet Letter's top assassin became a softie. That witch can't be an ordinary person… But don't worry, I have no interest in your dear shopkeeper, and I'm not going to interrupt you playing house with my sister.

daily.name: About Poinsette
daily.desc: Pointy is interesting. She doesn't have any powers to read emotions, yet she could always play along with Mother's shifting moods. No wonder Mother kept her close at all times. She was afraid of me. Sometimes I would intentionally scare her, just to watch her put on that fawning smile while her little mind was panicking, scrambling to respond, like a tiny mouse running through a maze… According to Inanna's plan, she was supposed to die by your hand, but you ended up saving her. Knowing her, she must firmly believe that she owes you her life.

daily.name: About Zero
daily.desc: You have many secrets, and I can taste your scrumptious emotions. Yet, I can't see through your soul. It's like a smoldering fire, no visible flame, yet burning like nothing else… Even among Espers, you stand out as an exception. This also means you don't actually need to obey the Bureau's rules. They've never been able to accept things they can't control. One day, they'll fear you, guard against you, try to limit you… But I'll always be willing to loosen your bonds, and I'll always accept everything about you. Your true nature, your loves and hates, even the anger burning in you right now… all of it is sweet to me.

daily.name: About The Scarlet Letter
daily.desc: When I was in the Scarlet Letter, Inanna would select children with the best potential and put them through "trials" that were nothing but torture. Only a handful of kids survived. Of the few standouts, she would give them important tasks as well as flower names… Such as "Daffodil" and "Red Nightshade." In Inanna's operations, those two code names once struck fear into the hearts of many. Oh, Poinsette had a flower name too, "Poinsettia." But she didn't seem like the type who could survive the trials. I guess she pulled some clever tricks to get through.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: This surge of excitement… It's been a while.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: It hungers for more and cannot be satiated…

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: You made a dangerous decision, and I'm all for it.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: Hmph… Appraiser, what are your intentions?

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: I can't figure you out anymore… Still, thank you for the gift.

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Instead of a gift, I'd rather you tell me a secret. That's what I really want.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: If you need me to solve a problem, just ask.

battle.name: Ultimate II
battle.desc: I bestow upon you this blessing.

battle.name: Ultimate IV
battle.desc: Bloom for me! Wither for me!

battle.name: Ultimate VIII
battle.desc: The party has come. Dance with me!

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: I'm more used to humanoid targets.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: Take this. I don't need it.

profile.title: ETD-4, Member
profile.description:
"Do you think we'll get to see Miss Fadia today?"
"Dream on. They wouldn't send ETD agents for a mere Class II Anomaly."
"F-Fadia… Miss Fadia…?!"
"Quit obsessing and let's wrap up—Miss Fadia!"
…
"That day, Miss Fadia appeared before me like a savior."
Love letters like these fly into the ETD-4 office like snowflakes, and the so-called "savior" herself finds them quite entertaining, often using them as reading material to pass the time at work.
profile.introduction: A dangerous yet captivating ETD member who represents the director's unpredictable hiring standards.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
One of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's ETD-4 members, and once a criminal.
As for what crime got her thrown onto the legendary Ghroth Island… nothing too serious. It was just an innocent little gesture that put some people to sleep forever.
"Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead back to the black hole of nothingness."
Twirling her hair around her finger, she smiled with sparkling eyes.
"I simply followed their wishes, sending those party people to the paradise they'd been craving their whole lives."

As a pardoned prisoner, she isn't treated any differently than any other Squad 4 member.
Except by that dog-faced guy with calm but wary eyes. Maybe because a few months ago they were escort officer and wanted criminal?
Well, overall, she thinks her new job is pretty good. Fighting to her heart's content, letting danger excite her mind, letting pain make her body tremble… violence comes from life's excess. How could anyone not be addicted to tasting it?
She doesn't know why that strange woman brought her back from the island, but whatever. She had nowhere else to go anyway. The place where she once knelt and prayed devoutly, entrusting her faith, has long been sealed off. Anyone who sees that ruined wasteland would laugh! Only a pair of familiar silver eyes still gaze at her, merciful, generous, full of desire… she can feel it.

"Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting."
A pretender, a dog, and a brat?
Fadia narrowed her eyes.
Well then… let's find that "something interesting."

profile_detail.name: Lirnia
profile_detail.desc:
Fadia Lirnia was the only daughter of a political family, a precocious rich girl, a bird caged behind golden bars.
From birth, the first thing she learned under everyone's watchful eyes was to hide her desires.
Until her parents, family, everything was destroyed in that unconscious rampage… She was no longer a Lirnia, and didn't need to be.
So… she gave herself a new name: Fadia DD. Desire and Death.

profile_detail.name: Spiral Path
profile_detail.desc:
Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead to the black hole of nothingness.
Life follows a spiral path, perfectly balanced, circling inward ring by ring, until it finally reaches… the ancient gods' paradise?
Shh. Good child, don't think too hard about it.

profile_detail.name: Pain Addiction
profile_detail.desc:
Fadia taught herself to manipulate pain as easily as dealing with those money and power-obsessed fools.
She scratches herself, then spreads the pain throughout her body, seeking some kind of balance… the force controlled just right. In this, she has found an addictive calm.
Most people lack the ability to connect emotionally, throwing themselves into things that are easy to focus on and get addicted to. Alternating between extreme pain and pleasure… that's the secret that makes it impossible to stop.
She pities those people, just like she pities herself.
"Poor children, desire is the only thing they can rely on. Go ahead, vent, cry, succumb. Take what you desire, like babies craving their mother's milk."

profile_detail.name: Desire
profile_detail.desc:
Human survival is contradictory. For example: taboo and transgression, reproduction and death, murder and sacrifice, sacred and profane.
In this chaotic, vulgar materialist world, only lust accepts everything about people. It embraces all their selfless, ugly, stupid, joyful faces.
Take her hand, embrace her.
Feel what grateful devotion hides behind that meaningless proud facade…
Feel how the endless, itching desire writhes within that devotion.

profile_detail.name: Robin
profile_detail.desc:
A robin, silently staring into the distance.
The twelve-year-old girl, mesmerized by the orange-red feathers on the bird's chest, followed the fork in the path and straying off course for the first time.
Later, she saw it again in her painful, hazy consciousness.
Struggling, reaching forward with such painstaking effort…
If only she could touch but a single feather tip…
A robin, silently staring into the distance.

melee.name: Wordless Rejection
desc: Swings her cross shield and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

When Fadia's current HP is greater than <NumGreen>1</>, she redirects a portion of damage taken by her teammates to herself before any shield mitigation is applied. Redirected damage cannot be further redistributed.
Once Fadia's current HP drops to <NumGreen>1</>, she ceases to redirect damage. At this point, if Fadia receives damage, she will share it with surviving teammates before any shield mitigation, and will absorb the remaining damage herself.
Swings her cross shield in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Triggers when casting Wordless Rejection after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at high speed and deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area, reducing Break.
desc_short: Shares damage with allies while Fadia's HP is above 1. Distributes incoming damage among surviving allies when Fadia's HP equals 1.
melee.context: <Italic>The most laughable thing about being alive is how you bow to self-evident meanings and submit to the power of orders. So why not laugh at you pitiful worms?</>

skill.name: Existence
skill.desc:
Come, have a taste of this. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP in the area for a period.
During the duration, when Fadia takes damage, the target shares a percentage of the damage taken.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> ends when the duration expires, when the Redirection DMG taken by the target reaches its cap, or when the target and Fadia leave combat.
skill.desc_short: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP.
skill.context: <Italic>"Oh hey—just a friendly tip from her teammate: attacking her right now might not be the smartest move…"</>

additional_desc.name: Destructive Experience
additional_desc.desc: A special effect that Fadia attaches to the target. Causes the target to share a percentage of the damage Fadia takes during the duration.

ultraskill.name: Agony to Euphoria
ultraskill.desc:
Without pain, life closes in on itself. Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Recasts Wordless Rejection while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> follow-up attacks, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the energy of Agony to Euphoria when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored by Agony to Euphoria when it is cast with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
Exits <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state when the duration ends, all 5 follow-up attacks are performed, characters are switched, or other skills of Fadia are used.
ultraskill.desc_short:
Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing 6 instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Performs up to 5 follow-up attacks while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the Ultimate's energy when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored when casting the Ultimate with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
ultraskill.context: <Italic>"Since the Director chose to exploit this instability, my duty is to observe and restrict it—to ensure such dangerous volatility stays within controllable bounds."</>

peculiarity.context:

<Italic>In the end, all she got was a reward that Skia bought right there and then.</>

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Fadia here. As you can see, I'm currently under… probation… in this place full of rules and regulations. My intuition tells me we'll be seeing a lot of each other. Better remember me from now, or you will know…

daily.name: Chat: Work
daily.desc: Missions? Investigations? …How delightful. ETD might as well work under the resident association.

daily.name: Chat: Passerby
daily.desc: I wonder what desires lurk beneath these mundane shells?

daily.name: Chat: Surveillance
daily.desc: Heh, those Fraxinus fools… Having to pretend I don't notice them every time is quite the hassle.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: What a blinding sun… like being watched with scorching eyes…

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: How funny it is to see those usually prim and proper dolls all messed up, with rain dripping down their faces.

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I'm always fired up and ready to go!

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: My clothes… are sticking to me.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Lookin' so messy, so eager to see me?

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Care to buy me a drink? What better way to liven up the afternoon than with a little fun?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Since night's falling, why don't we go somewhere better suited for the dark?

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Hey, the night's still young, sleepy head.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: As long as it brings pleasure, I like it.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: If it wasn't for that watchdog, I'd be having way more fun in my missions.

daily.name: Topic: Hypervortex
daily.desc: Gazing face-to-face, beneath skies as beautiful as death itself… Opening everything to the infinite void, even if it means being torn apart, consumed, and cast down into that emptiness right here and now… How could anyone complain?

daily.name: Topic: Ghroth Island
daily.desc: You're no stranger to that place too, aren't you? So tell me—is it a wretched prison of despair, or a sacred paradise of madness?

daily.name: Topic: Desires
daily.desc:
An abyss lies between all human existence, and desire is the perfect tool to shatter such isolation. Death casts shadows of fear and temptation between us—listen closely to their whispers, luring us to take risk after risk.
The pit of desire can never be filled, never satisfied—this affliction plagues not just you and me, but all of humanity. So tell me, what desires are you suppressing right now? Go on, show me… just a bit.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: For this frail, decaying flesh of ours, pain is the finest feast. It lives, it thrives, and in our dizzying cruelty and trembling, it brings us ever closer to death.

daily.name: About Myself: Popularity
daily.desc: Well, there's no restraining their obsession!

daily.name: About Myself: Patience
daily.desc: Patience from a hunter can be quite the dangerous sign… Good hunters only invest their patience in hunting… just like I do with you—Tsk tsk, got you there.

daily.name: About Baicang
daily.desc: Always acting like a slacker, but that guy… deep down he's a true saint.

daily.name: About Alphard
daily.desc: What's that snake of a woman thinking, fishing out dangerous Espers from Ghroth Island for her own use? For all we know, she might be just as dangerous as the monsters on that island.

daily.name: About Skia
daily.desc: When I don't want to hear him ramble, a little… trick… should just divert his attention enough. That dog prioritizes controlling the situation over his own thoughts and feelings.

daily.name: About Lacrimosa
daily.desc: Not having a care in the world must be nice… Stay innocent while you can, my sweet little Mosa.

daily.name: About Bureau of Anomaly Control
daily.desc: To some extent, I don't really hate this place. Compared to that chaotic grave, the so-called unshakeable rationality here merely legitimizes all transgressions and taboos under noble pretenses and facades.

daily.name: About ETD
daily.desc: One side faces a world that can be defined and understood, while the other faces what's denied and cursed—perhaps that's why she brought us together in the ETD-4.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: This… this pain!

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: I can see… I…

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: Clawing your way up without dignity…? Heh, what are you after?

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: What's more precious than the gift… is you! ♥

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: Did you give it to me because you liked it? How adorable.

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Gifts symbolize affection. That means you…

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Your L-O-V-E for me. I'll take it.

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Give me a show next time.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: Looks like I'll have to make my own fun.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: I'm not so easily won over.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: A little something to fill the gaps.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains VI
battle.desc: Who left it behind? How pitiful.

battle.name: Low Health III
battle.desc: Life… is better when it's blazing to ashes!

battle.name: Heal II
battle.desc: Haven't had my fill of this agony yet…

battle.name: Down I
battle.desc: Such a violent display of love…

battle.name: Deploy II
battle.desc: I have no interest in weaklings.

battle.name: Glide I
battle.desc: Let's take a breather before we land.

battle.name: Switch III
battle.desc: Where would you like me to start hurting you?

battle.name: Special Switch - Baicang
battle.desc: That was fast. Can't say I'm surprised.

battle.name: Special Switch - Lacrimosa
battle.desc: Releasing… that's what I do best.

battle.name: Special Switch - Mint
battle.desc: The best treats should be enjoyed while they're warm.

battle.desc: Just a reminder… cats have nine lives.

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success I
battle.desc: Look at you, always in a rush.

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success II
battle.desc: Just charging forward… losing your pace.

profile.introduction: The Boss of Eibon, who doesn't seem to be very sober.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
The most unreliable adult (whose job, according to Sakiri, is to get completely wasted every day), the mysterious boss that Nanally admires, and the enigmatic boss for everyone else in Eibon.
Right now, she's examining a frog-shaped cosmetic device.

"What excellent taste you have, dear customer! You picked the most valuable treasure from my entire collection straight away! Surely you've heard the legend of the 'Angel's Kiss'? That's right! The holy grail of skincare that makes you radiant and supple, the 'Pale Sacred Dew' long-sought after by elite nobles for centuries, is now resting in your very hands! If it weren't for… my urgent need for funds, forcing me to part with this treasure… Well, 50,000 Fons! And this treasure could be yours!"
Hotori gave a dramatic gesture in a bold stance, suggesting she won't budge on the price. The merchant, who was speaking in flattering tones, made a pained expression and hesitated.
"Customer, you really don't hold back! In that case, 5,000 Fons. Let's be friends!"

Whenever she thinks she's getting a bargain, or whenever she believes she's found some treasure, she can never hide the smile appearing on her face as she slams the table and shouts "Deal!"
Perhaps within half a day she'll discover she's been scammed, then become furious and drown her sorrows in alcohol.
Or perhaps when she receives the bill at the end of the month, she'll furrow her brow with bitter regret.

But at least the moment of owning a brand new "treasure" is undoubtedly worth celebrating.
"As for the future… well, we'll deal with that when the future comes!"

profile_detail.name: Live for Today
profile_detail.desc:
"'All-you-can-drink' means you pay a fixed price based on the number of people in your group, and until you leave and settle the bill, you can take unlimited beverages from the drink area… that's what their menu says."
"Including alcohol? That's pretty generous! Everyone should really enjoy themselves today, and you kids better go grab the most expensive juice they have!"
"…Restaurants definitely lose money when they run into shameless customers like Hotori who can really hold their liquor, right?"
Of course, this business model has countermeasures for dealing with customers who go overboard: besides the inventory limits for each type of beverage, there's also the time restriction… but when it comes to Hotori, that just happens to not be a problem.
However, based on what happened later, when Hotori kept ordering table after table of appetizers to maximize the value of the all-you-can-drink deal… This rare dining-out experience still ended up with expenses far exceeding the budget.

profile_detail.name: Fated Old Treasures
profile_detail.desc:
There are currently no late-night chat sessions happening between antiques in Eibon… probably. After all, not many of them can talk. This doesn't stop the Temporal Globe from rolling around when bored, surveying the other items in the shop and letting its imagination run wild.
(Hey, newcomer, where are you from?)
(I used to sleep in a dirty street until someone took a liking to me and bought me. The cost of my freedom was 998 Fons. Does that put me at the bottom of the hierarchy in this shop?)
(There are plenty who don't even know their own worth. Like me, I stayed in a dark, cramped place for ages and ages… so long that the little crack I had grew bigger and successfully merged with the original carved patterns… until… light came in. That woman appeared, gently lifted me out, and smiled.)
(Was it one of those scheming, triumphant smirks?)
(No. It was a completely confident smile, like she was certain I'd be there. But for some reason, that smile made her seem somewhat… regretful?)
(Haha, I bet she dusted off the dirt only to discover you weren't in as good condition as she imagined!)
The discussion that never happened and never will happen grows more animated, accompanied by the blinking sounds of the Temporal Globe. The Mirror of Anam simply reflects peacefully, capturing all the stillness and the passage of time across its surface.

profile_detail.name: Enamel Pocket Watch
profile_detail.desc:
An exquisite pocket watch crafted with cloisonné enamel technique.
Above the ghost orchid pattern, an orange-red gemstone is set, like eyes that have grown gentle after fading through long years… Yet the watch face still retains bright and delicate colors, showing no signs of age.
It's neither an Anomaly nor an Esper creation. Though beautifully crafted, it's truly just an ordinary pocket watch without any special powers.
Hotori never discusses its actual value. Perhaps it's some precious treasure she keeps hidden away? Something she wouldn't sell for money unless Eibon was on the verge of bankruptcy… her ultimate backup insurance, maybe?

profile_detail.name: Best Time for Snow Viewing
profile_detail.desc:
The Tsukinoki family's courtyard pairs perfectly with fallen snow. The snow gives it an added sense of historical elegance, like covering displayed antiques with a blanket of dust—except this dust is pure white and pristine.
Unfortunately, year after year, such scenery passes by in the blink of an eye. Hotori has always felt this way.
Even at a young age, she was already deeply melancholic about the changing seasons and passing years. This was because she feared that the ever-changing outside world would bring unwanted changes to this reclusive family. How wonderful it would be if everything could freeze like a still life at its most perfect moment.
"The best time to appreciate snow is when it's melting. For that… you need to be in motion, don't you?"
Many years later, when she truly could make snowy scenes stand still, one early spring she encountered—not by chance—an old guest who had once stayed at their family estate for a time. Now an elderly man in his twilight years, he took a sip from his wine cup after every sentence during their casual conversation.
Hotori realized this would be their final meeting. She poured the wine and waited with rare solemnity to hear his next heartfelt words.
"What's most precious isn't what remains unchanged and eternal. It's the things that break… the things that are breaking right now."

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: A new face… A guest…? …Wait… isn't that my Precious?! Ugh… I'm so dizzy I can't even tell… I need a hangover cure…

daily.name: Chat: Reputation
daily.desc: When you're out on a job, make sure to protect our shop's rep. Cough… And for the record, I couldn't care less about the low ratings for Eibon on Hyelp. Numbers on a screen, nothing more! Real gratitude from real customers is what matters!

daily.name: Chat: Fons
daily.desc: Fons, Fons, Fons… Who came up with that name? The more I say it, the better it sounds… "Fons"… what a lovely word.

daily.name: Chat: Treasure Hunt
daily.desc: Look after the shop for me, I'm heading to the flea market at Bridge Crossings… What for? Heh, treasure hunting, of course.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: I'm not like those kids with endless energy to burn, running around every day. I'll wait for a nice, shady day before I go out again.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Listening to this rain outside… I just had a great idea… Our yard feels a bit empty, doesn't it? What about a koi pond?

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: In this city, even the coldest season doesn't feel too bad… and snow's rare. Honestly, I kinda miss home sometimes.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Ugh, it's boiling out here… Let me know before you grab the chilled sake, okay? Otherwise it'll warm up in no time.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Who is it?! That brat or Taygedo?! Clattering around downstairs at night… They're in for a lesson today.

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Ugh… this is the drowsiest time of day. I'm gonna rest somewhere cool.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Today's revenue is… how is it in the red again?

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Great drink… Hmph, "The glass is already empty"? Yeah, I noticed. Just look at this moonlight. It's free. And hey, it offers unlimited refill, right? Fill it up again, to the brim.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: These days, what hobby doesn't cost money? Honestly, chatting with Daff is more fun. Sip a little, tease her a bit, enjoy the reaction… now that's good entertainment.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Why's the utility bill this high… Edgar, use that clever little brain of yours and double-check this number… What!? Commercial rates?! Tch… all these years and I'm only finding this out now…

daily.name: Topic: Anomaly - "Melancholic Dandy"
daily.desc: If you're bored, go chat with that painting. Try to be natural and say something nice. I'm tired of hearing it moan about how its face is cracking. Last time I passed by, it even asked for skincare cream to dab between the brushstrokes! Absurd!

daily.name: Topic: Transaction Guidelines
daily.desc: There are a few lines in Eibon's terms of trading service that aren't exactly the best things to let customers know… Yeah, I know. When I first wrote them, I just jotted down what I felt… Still, trade's all about honesty, right? If anything sounds off, just cross it out before showing the client. No need to reprint. Printing shops these days are daylight robbery… Shops honest as Eibon aren't very likely to survive in this evil world…

daily.name: Topic: Commission Agreement
daily.desc: Hey, Precious, come help me out. I'm thinking of adding a line to our commission form… something like, "A 50% service fee applies if you request anomaly appraisal by our in-house Appraiser." What do you think?… What's with that head shake? Fine—80%! Deal!

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: "Time" isn't just a path. It's also… a point of view.

daily.name: About Myself: Judgment
daily.desc: Through the lens of "Time," I've appraised countless rare artifacts. You gotta have that kind of eye to run an antique shop… What? My judgments have been off lately? Hmm… Maybe it's 'cause Precious here is just too dependable and I've been letting my guard down too much…

daily.name: About Myself: Proprietress
daily.desc: What do you mean I'm a hands-off boss? Which brat told you that? I've always handled Eibon's inventory. And besides, Adler's managing the operations. My job is to make decisions for the business! That's where leadership is.

daily.name: About Adler
daily.desc: Look, look, look—see those fine lines around Adler's eyes? Popped up like mushrooms after rain since we opened. The little troublemakers have no idea how much we adults stress over them.

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: Daff doesn't drink much on her own, but if you say cheers and invite her to a toast, she'll down one after another. I told her, after toasting, you'll have to drink at least half a glass—it's basic etiquette. Heh heh… and then… who knows what fun you'll see? Her tolerance isn't what she thinks it is.

daily.name: About Sakiri
daily.desc: Sakiri's a clever one. She's got potential to be a great little shopkeeper. But this habit of undercutting me? I'll need to straighten that out properly someday…

daily.name: About Taygedo
daily.desc: When I first found Taygedo, I was thrilled. Thought I could save on buying a TV. But now the kids hog it every day, watching anime and what not… Sigh. One day, when I strike it rich, I'm getting a screen as big as a wall…

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: Nanally! What did you break this time?! Why'd the compensation notice show up at our door without warning?! …Where'd that little rascal go… Tch, Adler! Listen, one month—argh, maybe one week! No eggrolls for her. Make her remember this time… and don't sneak her any!

daily.name: About Edgar
daily.desc: Edgar's such a quiet, well-behaved kid. Loves books, doesn't ask for much. How did his parents raise him so well? I need to take notes…

daily.name: About Alphard
daily.desc: Keep an eye on our dear Director. Don't let her catch you slipping. I don't want to get dragged into another "parent-teacher meeting." Every time she pulls that cold face, even the premium guest couch starts feeling stiff… Honestly, it's probably less comfy than the ratty old one at home.

daily.name: About Eibon Antique Shop
daily.desc: I should've knew this location was no good. Cheap rent led me into a dead end—business is a bust! So why still choose to open Eibon here? Heh, because there's no such thing as "should've known." It's fate.

daily.name: Character Ascension I

daily.name: Character Ascension II

daily.name: Character Ascension III

profile.introduction: A ruthless bodyguard of few words, working exclusively for Eibon.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop does not say much, always standing quietly beside everyone else. She seems to have a nickname, "Daff," which Hotori occasionally calls her. Whenever Hotori calls her that, Daffodill looks away, her ears turning completely red. As for the others… if they want to be cut to pieces, they are welcome to try using that name.

Daffodill owns many eyepatches. Though she wears them less now, she still keeps up her collecting habit. Nobody can tell the difference between those eyepatches, but she firmly believes in her taste. Leather ones, patterned ones, ones with especially neat stitching… she carefully sorts them by category and places them in her small collection box.

Daffodill was not born with poor vision; rather, it was the price of her Esper Ability. At nineteen, cruel truth burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope, and since then she could see through anomalies to perceive layers of essence across time and space. Sometimes, glimpsing the truth is not a good thing. She learned about her parents' cause of death, about her own wishful emotional attachments, about needing and being needed… and lost the faith she had relied on for survival. The red-cloaked hero in the picture book silently turned her blade toward Mother, toward that hateful, beating heart that had once falsely given her warmth. If the goddess of vengeance wanted to punish her for this… then so be it.

Daff longed for a happy, beautiful place, and so accidentally embarked on a journey full of metaphors.
So then, what about the ending of the story?
Her life until now was one monopolized by lies. It was a life in which no one needed her… there was no point in continuing. That was what Daffodill had been thinking when she met that slightly tipsy woman. The woman talked about a daffodil growing in the center of the lake, proud and aloof, seemingly impossible for anyone to pick. She naturally needed that flower too, but would not pick it.
A strange woman and a strange flower. What reason did that daffodil have for growing alone there? It must depend on something. Surely it grew that way because it was rooted in others' need for it. When the wind rose, Daffodill heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.

Why not follow the woman and seek answers in the life ahead?

profile_detail.name: The Woman in Red Gloves
profile_detail.desc:
She pushed the door open and went inside. The rust-red sea climbed up to her feet and dizziness soon followed, like staring into a kaleidoscope.
At that moment, a pair of hands wearing red gloves covered her eyes.
Ms. T, who happened to be visiting, witnessed the tragedy of her parents alongside her. In her heartbreak, she offered to adopt Daffodill as her daughter. The beautiful girl had lost both parents, and no other relatives would risk being implicated by taking in a child of misfortune… She had always been the one who was not needed. Only Ms. T reached out her hand to her, so she gratefully took her place by Ms. T's side.

profile_detail.name: Mechanical March - I
profile_detail.desc:
The trials were cruel. Even though Daffodill was an exceptionally talented child, she still ended up covered in wounds.
Madam T said that, compared to other children, Daffodill could feel pain closer to death itself, and on some level that brought her closer to her parents. The injuries she suffered were more valuable than anyone else's.
Besides, Madam T needed her.
Daffodill did not like pain, but Madam T's words gave her a reason to suffer. She forced herself to believe in Madam T and held her words as truth, devoutly throwing herself into the trials. Once she was ready, she became Madam T's blade, moving through various gray area missions.

profile_detail.name: Mechanical March - II
profile_detail.desc:
"Mother, are all charities like this? Like wolves in sheep's clothing from the stories?"
"People have many sides. The brighter the light shines, the darker the shadow becomes. That is the real world."
"They… they cry so often. They wish Mother would not make them hurt so much."
"My flowers have no one to depend on except me. I am willing to provide nourishment, and all I ask in return is to select the one that survives longest and blooms most beautifully… it's only reasonable."
"Besides… crying is only temporary. Look at them, silly child. Are they not smiling now?"
Daffodill looked up and saw the girls laughing together, clustering around Madam T and herself, as if they were embracing a mother they truly loved.

profile_detail.name: Sisters
profile_detail.desc:
They would rest together on Madam T's lap, one on each side.
Before sleep, they would clean each other's wounds from the day's trials or quests, like two small animals grooming one another.
But sometimes she would wonder… was she the same as Zankou? Did not resisting the trials and quests mean she was enjoying them?
No. What she enjoyed was the feeling of being needed, and from that lingering warmth, her thoughts drifted towards parental dependence…

profile_detail.name: Perfect Garden's Truth - I
profile_detail.desc:
Inconsistent patterns, wall marks with slightly broken lines, a subtle 3-millimeter gap from the bookshelf, a tilt angle differing by about 3 degrees… there was surely a hidden door here. Her eyesight had always been sharp, so she could perceive the truth more easily than most. She could see massive, spectacular, densely packed information files, including personal records of Daffodill and her parents.
They were detailed enough to make one's hair stand on end.
She saw scribbled notes beside her own photo: "beautiful collectible," "important tool for missions."

profile_detail.name: Perfect Garden's Truth - II
profile_detail.desc:
Using newborn Daffodill as leverage, Madam T forced Daffodill's parents to spend years away treasure hunting.
Finally, one day, they could no longer bear it.
"Even if we're forced to wander with our daughter, we must tell her the truth… a family must stay together."
However, the controller was watching everything. Daffodill had reached the right age to bloom, and the hunter couple had done all that she wanted. Rebellious pawns were useless. Better eliminate them.

profile_detail.name: Daff
profile_detail.desc:
She had never known that a daffodil grew in the center of the lake. She had never seen it as a child. Had it grown after Ms. T took her away?
The woman smiled and raised her wine bottle, inviting her to toast. Daffodill looked at her swaying, carefree manner and felt inexplicably angry.
"I have already lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"
"Do toasts need reasons? Well… then… to the despair of having nothing, to skies never witnessed. And to the one and only daffodil in the center of this lake."
"…Do you want to pick that flower too?"
"Mmm… I need that flower. But I will not pick it."
Meeting Daffodill's look that clearly said this was contradictory, the woman tapped her forehead with the wet tip of her umbrella.
"Who decided that needing something means you must take it? I only need it to exist, so I can drink something fine while admiring it like this. That is enough for me."
When the wind rose, she heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.
Perhaps… there really was a daffodil growing in the center of the lake.

melee.name: Still Waters
desc: Her heart is as calm as still waters, long accustomed to battle. Wields her twin blades to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Light and shadow exist in separate realms. Daffodill's Break Damage contribution is increased by 20%.
I am here. Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Dashes forward, performing a whirlwind slash and leaving behind marks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
Press dodge to trigger the special dodge action Displaced Edge during Still Waters. Grants invincibility during the action and does not interrupt the current combo.
Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

Triggers when using Still Waters after performing a Critical Dodge. Instantly lifts her foot, pulling the rope to swing her blade toward the target, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> and reducing Break.

Increases Resonance's DMG and Break per Support Skill cast, up to 2 stacks. Enhances Resonance and replaces it with Echoes when stacks reach the maximum.
Resonance carries sound, echo responds in kind. Swiftly shifts her stance, swinging her blade with the rope to deal <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.
desc_short: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>. Grants Resonance stacks and increases damage when any team member casts a Support Skill, up to 2 stacks. Enhances Resonance and replaces it with Echoes when stacks reach the maximum.
skill.context: <Italic>A girl trapped in a beautiful garden was no more than a prisoner in a cave. Only after gaining kaleidoscope eyes that could see through all things did she feel her way along the walls and stumble into a new world.</>

Unseals her left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.
ultraskill.desc_short: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> and unseals the left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Hello, I'm Daffodill, Hotori's bodyguard… Too simple? Sorry, small talk isn't my strong suit. If you need anything, just reach out to Eibon, the antique shop.

daily.name: Chat: Rest
daily.desc: You need to do something. Sitting idle won't do your body any good.

daily.name: Chat: Weapons
daily.desc: Even the best weapons need regular maintenance to stay sharp, and so do people.

daily.name: Chat: Greetings
daily.desc: Dear customer… wel… welcome… Tch.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: Good weather. Time for some outdoor training.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: It's raining? I can use rain to mask my presence…

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: The cold stiffens the body and numbs the senses… In such a moment, perhaps it's best for the roles of prey and hunter to be reversed.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: Argh… this temperature is annoying.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning, what's the plan for today?

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: If you're tired, you can take a nap. I'll wake you up.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: We can train a bit more. Want to join?

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Rest well, Eibon is safe at night.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: I can't say I have any particular preferences, just survival needs. Compressed sweets are easy to carry and provide a lot of energy, so I bring some just in case. How they taste doesn't really matter.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Some customers are harder to deal with than anomalies, but Hotori says we should always smile for Eibon's business… Huh? You think our commission success rate has been dropping lately? Ahem… that's absolutely not true.

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies
daily.desc: Truth often hides among lies. Both humans and anomalies are not what they seem on the surface. Merely "seeing" does not suffice. You must understand, perceive, and analyze. Only when you adopt a kaleidoscope of perspectives… can you fathom truth itself.

daily.name: Topic: Training
daily.desc: I don't find all the daily training tedious. No pain, no gain, right? The only way to avoid screwing up again is by getting stronger.

daily.name: Topic: Fishing
daily.desc: I've observed those anglers who sit by the shore all day with nothing to show for it. The weather, water temperature, conditions of the fish—so many uncontrollable factors can lead to failure. But patience is always a quality a good hunter should have. Your bucket is going to end up full eventually.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: Just a trade with some of my vision, doesn't affect my daily life too much. Sometimes you hear more than you see.

daily.name: About Myself: Dark Colors
daily.desc: Wondering why I wear dark clothes all the time…? It's not because I like them, but because they do a better job at hiding my injuries and deceiving my enemies.

daily.name: About Myself: Name
daily.desc: It seems to mean "narcissus." Only one flower blooms on each stem. Hotori told me there's one in the lake near my place, though I've never seen it. If possible, I'd prefer you to call me Daffodill instead of…ahem.

daily.name: About Hotori: Concerns
daily.desc: I know Hotori will do whatever it takes to get what she wants, putting herself at risk along the way. But sometimes the way she goes about it is a bit over-the-top… Well, I guess I do have some catching up to do.

daily.name: About Hotori: First Meeting
daily.desc: She was already drunk the first time we met. I thought she was just another strange woman. But somehow… there was a sense of calm, a strange… trust. Maybe that's why I stayed.

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: That kid's always peeking at me when I train. I've caught her a few times, but she just finds another spot and keeps at it… Well, as long as she doesn't get in my way, I guess.

daily.name: About Zankou
daily.desc: She's very dangerous. Avoid any contact with her unless necessary.

daily.name: About Adler
daily.desc: Adler is a very respectable person. Before I met Hotori, he was always by her side. I have a lot to learn from him.

daily.name: About Eibon Antique Shop
daily.desc: Eibon is completely different from where I used to be. Here, you have to deal with difficult customers for a living, and your friends here are noisy all the time… but I can sleep here without worrying about anything at least.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Hard work pays off.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: I can be stronger.

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: This way, your safety is guaranteed.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: I don't think I've told you, but I… like it a lot. Thank you.

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: This is precious for me. Many thanks.

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Thanks for the effort.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Hotori told me I should gladly receive gifts from a friend. I shall receive it… gladly.

battle.name: Ultimate II
battle.desc: What you see is an illusion!

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: Need an escort to the Bureau?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains I
battle.desc: Let's take it back to Eibon.

battle.name: Down II
battle.desc: If I can be of any value…

battle.name: Teammate Down - Sakiri
battle.desc: I'm going to take you back.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Nanally
battle.desc: You did your best, leave the rest to me.

battle.name: Teammate Down - Zankou
battle.desc: Looks like you still need me.

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success II
battle.desc: You don't know how to give up.
