daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Greetings, I'm Chiz. I work at Pink Paws Bank, employee ID 018888, and I live at Kyllene Promenade, Camelot Avenue, in New Herland District… Oh, too much information? S-Sorry!

daily.name: Chat: Bubble Tea
daily.desc: Ah, I want a large black sugar milk tea with crème brûlée, coconut jelly, pudding, and a boba base, no ice, full sugar… no, wait, um…!

daily.name: Chat: Weekend
daily.desc: Do you want to go to Caltrop Lake this weekend? It's been a while since I went out… N-Nevermind. I'm better off staying in.

daily.name: Chat: Salary
daily.desc: Oh, the latest style…? I'll consider when I get my next paycheck.

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: The sun is so cozy… I could close my eyes and fall asleep right now.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Oh no, it's raining… You could catch a cold. Please, um, stay warm, okay?

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: Whoo… it's so cold. This is the perfect time to snuggle up with family, nothing warms you up faster.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: I miss the AC at Pink Paws Bank. It's like they're blasting cold air for free.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: G-Good morning! Do you, um, want something to eat? Maybe a sandwich? Or coffee? Or, umm, anything really… A-Anyway, let me make breakfast!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Good afternoon. Do you need a break? We got… two whole hours for lunch.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: Just a sec, I'm almost done! Hey… do you wanna get dinner together?

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: In my village, they always say, "A night of peaceful, dreamless sleep means a day of good fortune ahead." Goodnight, I hope tomorrow is your lucky day.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: I like Fons… hmm, I do. Fons are essential, you know? Food, medicine, clothes… none of that appears out of thin air. They all cost money. But sometimes, I wonder if Fons are really that important… I mean, once I save up enough to move back home, maybe they won't matter so much. Still, that's an enormous amount of Fons. I'd probably have to work at Pink Paws Bank until I retire.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Problems, huh… When I first started at Pink Paws Bank, I couldn't do anything right… I'm not being modest, I mean it. I used to stand in that gorgeous lobby in my new uniform, but I couldn't speak to anyone. I was scared of screwing things up, I even considered quitting. But then…  Klingsna stepped in. She's… incredible, like the sun breaking through a storm. If only I could shine half as bright as her… I know I'm nowhere near her level, but honestly, I'm happy with my life as it is.

daily.name: Topic: Anomalies
daily.desc: Hethereau… is a great city. Ordinary people, anomalies, and Espers all live together as equals. It's safe and peaceful. Things aren't like this where I come from. Most anomalies are dangerous and you have to avoid them. Though… some of them can be used as food… Oh, sorry, that's probably not very interesting. But if you're curious… we can talk about it sometime later.

daily.name: Topic: Movies
daily.desc: When I'm off work, I watch movies at home. Most movies are interesting, because they take me to places I've never been to. I… I haven't traveled a lot, so every time I watch a movie, I can't help but think I'd love to visit those places if I could. One documentary even featured my hometown… Umm, I probably spoke too much. Just… forget what I said. Maybe… we can watch a movie together? If it's with you, even a horror movie would… would be okay!

daily.name: Topic: Convenience Store
daily.desc: If you visit 2-Fours at night, they sometimes sell rice balls at a discounted price. They taste just as good as the ones sold in the morning, but they're way cheaper. Perfect for a late-night snack. The only downside is you have to eat them the same day, since they expire soon. Umm… I-I'm good at making rice balls too. Would you… ever want to try some?

daily.name: About Myself: Hoarding
daily.desc: When I find things I like, I end up… collecting a lot of them. Like, a lot. But I promise, I… I keep everything neat and organized. It's just… a habit. It's like, I feel more secure when I have a huge pile of stuff all together.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Ability
daily.desc: E-Esper abilities… They're… r-really handy. Super con-convenient, ex-extremely useful. I-I'm an Esper, so… so thanks to… to these powers, I was able to move to Hethereau. I was also able to fi-find work easily, because of my abilities. Being an Esper here is… is really great. I like it here.

daily.name: About Myself: Bandages
daily.desc: Does it… look bad? I used to be… bad at everything, always getting myself hurt… B-but I'm better now! I don't get hurt as much anymore. It's just… my old scars aren't pretty, so I covered them. A coworker recommended these bandages. They're soft and breathable, so they don't feel icky. Please don't worry about me. The wounds have all healed up. They don't hurt anymore.

daily.name: About Dvořák
daily.desc: The Dvořák family, they're rather… unusual, I guess? No, no, I swear I don't mean that in a bad way! When I first got to Hethereau, I was taken in by their shelter. Thanks to their foundation, I was able to get an education. After that, I started working at Pink Paws Bank. Pretty much everyone in Hethereau—locals or outsiders alike—has benefited from them at some point. It's like the Dvořáks are always… giving money away? They don't even ask for anything in return. Maybe that's what makes them good people.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Woah, such a strange feeling…

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Will I… be more useful?

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: I could do this after all.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: I… I love it! I r-really do!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: Th-Thanks! I'm s-sorry… I m-mean… I don't know what to say… I'll keep it and treasure it for a long, long time!

daily.name: Gift Received III

daily.name: Gift Received IV

profile.title: Member of CSU-2
profile.description:
Warm and approachable, she instinctively puts people at ease, making them trust her from the very first meeting.
Every pattern of her behavior aligns perfectly with what people expect from a "normal girl."
No problem. This is just fine.
profile.introduction: Oneiroi is a well-behaved kid who ticks all the boxes.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
"Iroi called in sick again? Her paid time off and sick days ran out ages ago. Feels like her paycheck's been getting docked."
"She doesn't seem to care about her paycheck… She once said she wouldn't mind paying to work. It didn't sound like she was joking about it."
"That's so nice. She works pretty hard. I didn't know she was just working to experience the world…"

Iroi has been prone to sickness since childhood. She couldn't attend regular schools. Luckily, her family was well-off, so she had a private tutor all the time, and she became as educated as someone who has done general university coursework.
After finishing her studies, her parents wanted her to integrate into society, but her health couldn't handle the demands of a regular job. Iroi wanted to work at a social welfare organization, so her parents sent her to the Sunward, an anomaly charity house, to volunteer, where she also helped with the simpler anomaly intake work.
Iroi's current personality is deeply shaped by the vibes of the charity house. Before going there, she hadn't had much contact with others. Her tutor and butler were cold and rigid, always overly cautious, while her parents doted on her too much. Iroi understood that not all human beings were like them, so she instinctively chose to blend in with "everyone else."
Life on the island wasn't exactly smooth sailing. Things were a lot tougher than they were back home. Nevertheless, Iroi enjoyed that kind of environment much more, because she felt more alive.
During the Teehee Bear incident at the charity house, Iroi the volunteer provided significant help to the Bureau, and the Bureau staff took notice of this talented Esper. At the same time, Iroi found herself drawn to the Bureau's work. They came to an agreement and Iroi joined the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Given her strong control over her powers, she was recommended to join CSU-2.
Life has a way of moving on.

profile_detail.name: Unbroken Dream
profile_detail.desc:
For most people, dreams are unstable and ephemeral. Iroi's Esper Ability stabalizes dreams, making them constants that do not cease to exist when impacted by external factors.
Iroi can send her dreams into the consciousness of other living beings. The number of beings she can affect at the same time varies, depending on the targets' mental strengths. If the target's mental strength is too high, she may not be able to break in at all. She also can't affect beings without sentience.

Two gates exist at the entrance of Iroi's dream world, a Horned Gate and an Ivory Gate. Sometimes she conceals one of them when necessary.
If one enters the Ivory Gate, they are forced to experience a long and bizarre dream of creatures fighting and devouring each other. No one knows why this is the case.
If one enters the Horned Gate, they reach Iroi's true dream world and can have a nice dream. The real Iroi is hiding somewhere in the corner of this world.

In other words, the "Iroi" people see on the outside is not her true self.
The Iroi people see is nothing but an illusion created by her powers. The external Iroi, after taking over the original, is in essence a non-human consciousness that mimics human beings.
Don't be afraid. The external Iroi has posed as a human for about twenty years. She's not that different from a genuine human. She won't bite.
No need to panic.

profile_detail.name: In CSU-2
profile_detail.desc:
The Bureau of Anomaly Control and the charity house have entirely different vibes. Still, Iroi was able to get used to the different pace, and she got along with her new teammates, Mint and Shinku.
While Shinku's powers could drive her berserk, Iroi can use her powers to calm Shinku down in the dream world. As a result, Shinku frequently enters Iroi's dream world, and they got along.
However, after a certain mission, things changed. Shinku's attitude towards Iroi shifted for the worse, almost harboring animosity. Iroi didn't know what caused this change, but she responded with the same attitude. The two of them were friendly no more.
Mint noticed the awkward tension between the two. After some poking around between missions, she finally figured it out. Shinku had seen "the other Iroi" in her dream world. Shinku mistakenly assumed that the external Iroi had taken over the real one, and disgusted by what she thought was happening, she held a grudge against the external Iroi.
After that, Mint worked hard to convince Shinku and Iroi to clear up the misunderstanding. Once Shinku learned the truth about the Iroi in the dream world, she realized she assumed wrongly and apologized to Iroi.

"You saw that pitiful being in a dream and threw out everything to stand up for her—what a hotheaded dragon who doesn't think things through!"
"Arrgh, why are you still so mean after I said sorry? You… Ramtenna!"
"Okie-dokie, problem solved! Let's get along with each other like this!"

That's how Mint earned a lavish meal from Shinku and Iroi.

profile_detail.name: Sleeping
profile_detail.desc:
Iroi's powers create a stable dream for her, but a dream needs someone to be dreaming, and that person is the real Iroi within. The dreams created by her powers belong to her. The real Iroi always remains inside the dream world, always dreaming, and thus always sleeping.
The Iroi outside doesn't need to rest. In theory, she could stay awake forever. That said, sleep is something humans need, so she still goes to bed on time, pulls up the blanket, and shuts her eyes like everyone else.
She doesn't fall asleep, but she enjoys the cozy feeling of being wrapped in soft and fluffy blankets.

profile_detail.name: Three Kids
profile_detail.desc:
At first, Iroi's dream world was just a hazy, chaotic mess. As she grew up and experienced more of the world, three little kids, Morpheus, Icelos, and Phantasos, started trying to fill her dream world with color and life. The three kids worked together. Morpheus created passers by, Icelos created birds and beasts, and Phantasos created scenery that weren't based on living beings. Through their collective efforts, Iroi's dream world became a tiny world that rivaled reality itself.
As for when the three kids first appeared, neither Iroi remembers clearly—did they show up when her powers awakened? The real Iroi claims to have seen them since the moment she was born.
Morpheus likes to act cool and calls himself the boss, but he's actually the one who usually gets picked on. Icelos is cute and shy, but has a bit of a mischievous streak. Phantasos is a total airhead, always flying around aimlessly while blowing a little trumpet. For young Iroi, who spent so much of her time alone in hospitals and at home, they were her best friends.

"Iroi has new friends now. Is it time for us to leave?"
"No way, I don't want to leave her!"
"She's there… we're there… must not part…"

profile_detail.name: Price
profile_detail.desc:
Iroi's health had been a serious concern as soon as she was born. Things only started to improve until her Esper Abilities awakened when she was one. Even now, she still wears a life monitor as a precaution.
The real Iroi, however, does not want to live.
Even so, her parents were determined to save her. No matter how much money it took, they kept sending her into surgery after surgery, refusing to let her go.
The thing is, when Iroi woke up in her mother's womb, still floating in water, she already knew she didn't want to be born.

Iroi's powers kept her alive. It shaped a new consciousness for her—one that took over from the Iroi who never wanted to live—and kept her going.
Her Esper Abilities may have saved her by keeping her alive, but in truth, they've been exacting a price from her all along.
The price of her powers is to live.

Neither Iroi believes they were meant to be born. Both see themselves as something that should have been weeded out by natural selection.
However—
"You're alive. That already proves you weren't supposed to be eliminated. Is that so hard to understand? There's no such thing as "should be" in this world. What's already happened cannot change. The fact that you're alive embodies more truth than any theory, isn't it?"

profile_detail.name: First Dream
profile_detail.desc:
What makes a human human?

Before waking up, Iroi had a long, strange dream. It started in the pitch-black depths of the sea, slowly rising up, then stepping onto land, running like mad through a barren jungle just to avoid being eaten.
I heard everyone has a dream like this while they're still in the womb. You watch yourself crawl from the water onto land, slowly evolving into a human, and finally wake up naturally, right as you're being born.
But in that dream, Iroi wasn't born as a primate. Instead, she was sent on a different evolutionary path, becoming one of the Caprinae.
This should never have happened, and her human nature forced her to wake up from that dream. And so, she woke up in her mother's womb way too early.
Fetuses wake up, but Iroi's case was different. She woke up with complete consciousness. She touched around, felt the warmth around her, and caught the occasional glimpse of faint light. It was dim, warm, comfortable, with a pulse beating in rhythm with her own. So this is the "world," so this was what it felt like to be "alive."
She was taken away as her world opened up.
After living in the womb, the real world overflowed with light and empty space. It was terrifying. Her mind was shocked, and she no longer wanted to live. As a result, Iroi lost consciousness, and her body shut down. That's the beginning of her sicknesses.

At first, the Iroi created from her powers only knew that she must live.
When she was hungry or was in pain, she voiced her needs to attract attention.
Then she noticed that people made all kinds of sounds to express their thoughts. She slowly started to understand the sounds, then tried making them herself—and that, is how she learned to speak.
Just saying something out loud isn't always enough to make people believe it, so she learned all the right expressions.
Knowing what to say, to whom, and in what context, that's something she also had to pick up, however slowly…

Having grown up this way, how exactly is she any different from any authentic human being?

—Humans usually do not question whether they are humans or not. She does. That's about it.

additional_desc.desc:
Regression: A state where allied characters are replaced in battle by the lambs Morpheus, Icelos, or Phantasos. Characters in this state are invincible, inherit Iroi's stats, and attack automatically. Characters in this state cannot use Revive Items.
Each lamb has 3 attack methods:
Morpheus
Sweet Dreams: Fires an anesthetic needle at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Deep Slumber: Fires multiple anesthetic needles at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Fires a powerful anesthetic bomb at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Morpheus's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Icelos
Little Prick: Strikes the target with a syringe slash, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Double Dose: Strikes the target with a whirling syringe dance, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Launches a syringe-blast attack at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Icelos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

Phantasos
Lullaby Time: Plays a burst of sound waves at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Off-Key: Plays a beautiful melody at the target, dealing DMG on hit. Cooldown applies. Counts as Redirect Skill DMG.
Support Skill: Performs a flock concert at the target, dealing AoE DMG on hit and triggering the Esper Cycle effect of the corresponding character's attribute. Press Phantasos's avatar to cast. Consumes Iroi's Cycle Energy. Counts as Support Skill DMG.

ultraskill.name: 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage
ultraskill.desc:
Return to the first dream. Opens the gate to a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> built up.
If Imagination has not reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Horned Gate, continuously healing all allies.
If Imagination has reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Ivory Gate, continuously healing all allies and dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies inside the dream. During this time, press and hold the avatar of a team member in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state to temporarily revive them and restore a portion of their HP. This effect can revive up to 1 character during each dream.
The dream continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>. When Imagination is depleted, the dream ends, and the revived character returns to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.
While the dream is active, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.
ultraskill.desc_short:
Opens a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of Imagination built up.
Below threshold: Continuously heals all allies.
At threshold: Deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Switching to a character in Regression state during the dream revives that character and restores some portion of their HP.
The dream ends when Imagination is depleted. The revived character then returns to Regression.
While the dream is active, Imagination cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume Imagination.
ultraskill.context: <Italic>I heard the bell at both ends of the dream: once at the beginning, once at the end. But the bell only rang once. From hydrothermal vents in the deep sea to skyscrapers on land, that awful chime has followed everything. Oh my, it's been ringing for 3.8 billion years.</>

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Hi there! My name is Oneiroi. It's hard to pronounce, so just call me Iroi! Let me know if you ever need anything. Cya!

daily.name: Chat: Kicking Pebbles
daily.desc: I can't help but feel like kicking pebbles whenever I see them… I kick it further and further, until it disappears into somewhere I can't see. Do you do that too?

daily.name: Chat: School
daily.desc: My friends always have interesting things to say about school. I was home-schooled and didn't have any classmates. It's a shame that I never had a real school life.

daily.name: Chat: Evolutionary Theory
daily.desc: Natural selection is the survival of the fittest… That's the only thing my teacher said about the theory of evolution. She didn't have to explain, since that was the first dream "I" ever had…

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: The sun is shining, the flowers blooming…

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: My tail got soaked…

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: I can't feel my limbs anymore.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: I want to get out of this scorching place.

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: (Yawn) Good morning!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: It's time for a nap.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: There goes Mr. Sun.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: The night. Has come.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: What do I like? I like anything other people like! Wait, you're saying some people like the things other people hate? Then they can fight each other and I'll side with the winner!

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: My kiddo friends, Morpheus, Icelos, and Phantasos, always get themselves into trouble. I wonder if there's a way to get them under control…

daily.name: Topic: Sheep
daily.desc: I heard some cultures think goats are evil… Kiddos, do you think you're baddies? Oh, you don't? Kiddos, lying only makes our image worse!

daily.name: Topic: Room
daily.desc: When I was a kid, I spent a lot of time in the hospital because I got sick a lot. Back then, I thought everyone slept in white beds with those beeping and ticking machines. When I told colleagues at the charity house about this, they thought I slept in a haunted room!

daily.name: Topic: Dreamscapes
daily.desc: Do you like dreaming? Wanna take a look at my dreams? Just make sure you go through the gate with the bull horns. If you walk through the ivory gate, I won't be able to get you out. You'd have to watch yourself grow from an embryo back into yourself!

daily.name: About Myself: Family
daily.desc: My parents love me very much and have done a lot for me. They just want me to be happy. I'm grateful for them, yet I sometimes can't help but think…  if only a healthier kid was born instead…

daily.name: About Myself: Sleep
daily.desc: I guess I've always been sleeping. Even when I'm live and kicking, I'm still dream-walking!

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Ability
daily.desc: The shell known as Oneiroi gained a new life after her Esper ability awakened. That's not the real me. Do you get it? The real me is the one who's dreaming. The one talking to you is but a counterfeit role-playing a good kid!

daily.name: About? Myself?
daily.desc: My body was deteriorating, but my powers allowed me to live. She is not me. She lives in place of me. Am I still alive? I… don't know.

daily.name: About Mint
daily.desc: Mint senpai has limitless energy and passion. I want to be like her too! I'm lying? No, no, no, why would you say that? I mean it!

daily.name: About Shinku I
daily.desc: After I took Shinku into my dreams, she started hating on me. Did she not like what I showed her? Or… did she figure something out?

daily.name: About Shinku II
daily.desc: We're on good terms now. That skeptical dragon misunderstood me. At least according to Mint, Shinku and I "take good care" of each other now!

daily.name: About Nanally
daily.desc: Nanally is a little younger than I am, right? I'm a bit jealous of her, because she already knows what she wants to do at her age!

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: I'll keep trying!

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: Hmm… how much further can I go?

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: This should be as far as I level up… Thanks for helping me.

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: Oh, woah! I like this! Thanks a lot!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: Is this for me? I'll gladly accept it, thanks!

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Appreciate it!

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: What a great gift!

battle.name: Ultimate I
battle.desc: Everyone, let's all crawl back into Mommy's belly!

battle.name: Ultimate II
battle.desc: It's super scary inside my dreams!

battle.name: Ultimate III
battle.desc: Have fun in your dreams… I mean nightmares!

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: Listen up! Stay here and don't run away!

battle.name: Nullification I
battle.desc: Those who can't learn will have to be nullified… Sorry!

battle.name: Unexpected Gains VI
battle.desc: Woah, can I bring this into a dream?

battle.name: Takedown I
battle.desc: Oh my, I forgot to say goodbye.

battle.name: Switch II
battle.desc: Kiddos, it's our turn to shine!

battle.name: Special Switch - Shinku
battle.desc: Oh my, Shinku, you can't handle this alone?

battle.name: Teammate Down - Mint
battle.desc: Did Mint senpai pass out? Leave this to me!

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success I
battle.desc: Heh, how did you miss those?

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success II
battle.desc: Phew! I got away with that.

profile.title: ETD-6 Member
profile.description:
"Wait, where did today’s missions go? I was ready to head out!"
"That guy from ETD-6 already took care of them for us."
"How much has he taken care of this month? I barely feel like I work here anymore!"
"Yeah… Maybe he could be a little less helpful sometimes…"
profile.abilityName: "In the beginning, none could tell heaven from earth."
profile.introduction: Current member of ETD-6. Your most righteous and reliable friend.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
The core strikeforce of ETD-6, the one who gets things done, the blade that swings at every anomaly crime.
"Can I really say that? Isn't that exaggerating a bit?"
"It's cooler than 'Your friendly ETD-6 member' for sure."

Most people's first impression of Chaos is "that weirdo with the mask." At first, they find Chaos unapproachable, but as long as they spend some time with him, they'd realize that he's joyful, cheerful, and easy-going. The moment you start talking to him, the conversation flows like a tide, until he catches himself talking too much, or the listener becomes impatient, or a new mission notification rings.
In combat, however, he transforms into a battle junkie. His willpower is as strong as iron; he never runs out of stamina, and he refuses to let go of his targets. Sometimes, he's so eager to catch a criminal, that he ignores everything else, such as the Bureau's rules and regulations. If you ask him about the rules, he'll likely admit that he's never figured out the Bureau's red tape or hierarchies. In fact, sometimes, he even forgets he works for the Bureau. Fortunately, he works for one of the most flexible units in the organization.
His teammates in Unit 6 don't mind his quirks. It helps that their all-capable captain can always handle the fallout, so Chaos's habit of ignoring processes has arguably improved the team's performance. The captain, who handles cleanups personally, has made no comment on the matter.

Chaos's Esper ability is summoning a mass of smoke that can be shaped into solid forms. The amount of smoke isn't fixed, but it never drops below a certain level. Chaos believes the output of his smoke corresponds to the past crimes of those around him, as he'd always generated more smoke in places with a criminal history. Still, that's only his theory. The actual mechanism remains unknown.
"Is that how my powers work?"
"Hey, why would you think I know your powers better than you?"

profile_detail.name: Graveyard Keeper
profile_detail.desc:
Before working for the Bureau of Anomaly Control, Chaos was once the graveyard keeper for Ghroth Island. He was responsible for overseeing criminals, not knowing that he would be catching criminals in the future.

Eventually, a major incident—the jailbreaking of a dangerous Esper criminal—would push him to join the Bureau. Though it was not his fault, Chaos blamed himself for not monitoring the inmates more effectively. To make up for his mistake, he swore that he'd put in Ghroth Islalnd every criminal who deserves to be there. Only after that, would he return to meet the warden.
Since no one could hold back Chaos once he made up his mind, the warden, who didn't want to overstep and cause trouble to the BAC, entrusted him to the Bureau and transferred him to ETD to deal with anomaly crimes.

profile_detail.name: Boulder
profile_detail.desc:
Before entering Ghroth Island, Chaos was an Anomaly Hunter on a small island, where he went by his old name, Conrak. Eventually, he would abandon the name he received from his parents like a sunken boat in the sea.

Conrak once got into a shipwreck with another 11 crewmates. They found themselves in an ocean isolated from the world
There was an archipelago in the ocean, which didn't even have internet access. Conrak and his crewmates settled on one of the islands but never stopped wanting to go back. Unfortunately, no islander was willing to leave their home to ferry them across unknown waters, and no outside vessels passed through the islands. The group decided to build a ship and sail home by themselves. They named the ship "the Boulder."
Once they built the Boulder, the group began to save up supplies for their return trip. For two years, the group navigated the Boulder around the islands to transport goods for funds. Since the group members were also Anomaly Hunters, they often took commissions, solving many issues that plagued the islanders. Gradually the "Boulder Hunters" became known local heroes.
In the end, because the group lived peacefully on the islands and was praised as heroes, some of them no longer wished to risk another adventure to return. Only five of them decided to go back.

However, on its return journey, the Boulder went through a storm. Conrak fell into the sea, and his companions weren't able to find him.
Luckily, Conrak fell into the sea near Ghroth Island and was saved by a staff member.
Once he formally joined Ghroth Island, Conrak changed his name to Chaos.

profile_detail.name: Starting Point
profile_detail.desc:
Long before the Boulder went on its adventures, Conrak was an ordinary boy living in a small seaside town. The sea was calm, and he would often stand at the shore gazing at the water, with no way of seeing the storms that would occupy the second half of his life.

When Conrak was 13, his parents put him on a boat to travel far. They said they were preparing Conrak for the life of a sailor.
Conrak didn't know that his parents didn't love him, nor did he know that he was seen as a burden to their struggling family. He merely believed that he would become a sailor, make a great deal of money, then take his parents somewhere far away for a happier life. He even brought home a dog, feeding it out of his own pocket money, hoping that when he was away, the dog would look after his parents.
Conrak opened the last bag of dog food and kissed the dog on the cheek, then waved at his family and boarded the ship, not knowing it would never return.
In fact, the ship was a smuggler's ship, and its destination was an uninhabited island, though it never got there.
Midway through the voyage, the ship sank in a storm. Conrak awakened his Esper Ability, and black smoke took shape in the form of a ship. He and the other survivors miraculously made it through, carried by their abilities—only to find themselves in an ocean isolated from the rest of the world.
From here unfolds the story of the 17-year-old Conrak and his companions.

profile_detail.name: Fortelling
profile_detail.desc:
"You will die with infamy."
Chaos found himself on the receiving end of such foretelling. When they were still building the Boulder, a mysterious old person stopped him suddenly and left him with these words.
Somehow, Chaos never forgot them. At times, he would tell himself that unfounded words aren't worth dwelling on, but whenever a mission goes wrong, the words would come back to haunt him. Every omen from that island has come true. Even in doubt of his own fate, he brought countless wrongdoers to justice.
That doesn't mean he pursues justice to defy the omens. He's had a passion for fighting evil and upholding good since he was young. The fortelling simply stirred a hidden, rebellious streak in him, making him more driven, until he became the relentless force against evil he is today.

profile_detail.name: Bird
profile_detail.desc:
There was an Esper who went by the name of Icaria on the Boulder. She was short and had a pair of wings, which saved her when the smuggler's ship sank. She usually enjoys zipping around, often joking that she never grew taller because her feet never touched the ground. Conrak called her "Shorty."
Icaria didn't have any parents. She just had an older brother, who liked to make a big deal about working hard to raise her. The brother, however, never cared about her. That's why Icaria decided to stay on the island, though she was capable of flying home herself.
Icaria died when the crew fought an anomaly known as the Kraken. Her wings were not made from feathers, but from some material that melted in high heat. During the fight, she tried to make the anomaly focus on her, but her wings melted when she flew too high and fell right into the Kraken.

After that, Conrak was frustrated about the limitations of his abilities. He tried to experiment with what kind of shapes his smoke could form. Just before a battle, a bird flew past him. He thought that if he could shape his smoke into a bird, he could take to the sky.
This idea didn't come at a good time: he couldn't apply it to the battle at hand, but it was enough to make him regretful… If only he had thought of it sooner, he could have saved Icaria.
Nonetheless, the idea wouldn't have helped even if he had it earlier. 

Chaos is still trying to create flying birds with his smoke. Even after years of practice, he is still only able to create a few small birds that could fly a few meters, unable to even carry the tiniest speck of dust.

profile_detail.name: Torn Page
profile_detail.desc:
"In the 600th year, rain fell for forty days and forty nights. Waters rose upon the face of the earth, swallowing every hill and filling every valley until all was made plain."
…
…
He said his name was "Plain," but that didn't sound like a real name. He's a mysterious guy. It's like he knows everything, but I've never seen him in a fight. He likes to claim that he's omniscient and omnipotent, and although he's never been wrong… I just can't help but find him annoying.
Our boat is built. Plain said we needed to give it a name and proposed to call it "the Boulder." Hello??? Wouldn't a boulder sink in the sea? What an unlucky name! The others, however, seemed to like the name, especially that crazy woman with the vines, who said she'll write a heroic epic from the adventures of the Boulder. Is she serious? Plain even gave her his approval, saying that we'll all become heroes. Where did thIs confidence come from?
…
We're actually getting more and more commissions and we're getting more famous. Everyone thinks we're heroes.
Plain has yet to be wrong. I do respect that. By the way, the boat is operational, and we can now call him "Captain." I don't like to call him "Plain," so that's a win for me. Anyway, if he truly knew about everything, why would he ever be sent on that smuggler's ship in the first place?
…
There've been sightings of a monster that resembles an octopus. Many people got hurt. We need to take it down. The captain hesitated for a long time before deciding to accept the commission. I'm not sure what's on his mind. I just know that it has to be us.
During our strategic meeting, the captain kept telling Shorty to not fly too high. It's not like she can fly that high, right?
…
It's over. We won. Shorty died. I can't believe the crazy woman with vines drank too much and didn't show up. This was such an important fight… Had she been there, Shorty might have survived. But thoughts like this won't help…
…
We have enough supplies to go back, but some don't want to leave. They want to be "heroes" here… I get it. We don't know what kind of dangers lies ahead on our way back… but still, I need to return.
I must return.
…
…
Now I realize, my parents knew it was a smuggler's ship.
I don't have to go back now… Ghroth Island is not that bad anyway.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: Greetings. This is Chaos from ETD-6. Pleasure to meet you. I'm looking forward to… Hey, I'm just trying to be formal, stop laughing!

daily.name: Chat: Mask
daily.desc: Why am I wearing a mask? I tell people I want to be more efficient in combat. But the real reason… are you sure you want to know? Well, I think it looks cool. Okay, stop staring at me like that. I really think it's cool…

daily.name: Chat: Troubling thing
daily.desc: Is the mission a lot of trouble? No need to be concerned. As long as you sort things out one at a time, you'll be able to succeed. This belief helped me do many things that seemed impossible at first, except for… well, never mind.

daily.name: Chat: Hound
daily.desc: I don't have a pet dog, but if you mean a "hound," then that's my Esper Ability. Hmm, maybe having a real dog as a pet would be nice…

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: My mood is as sunny as the sunshine!

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: Got an umbrella? Do you need my coat?

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: Is it cold? You're shaking.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: I'm evaporating!

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Good morning! A brand new day begins!

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: It's time for a decision. What should I get for lunch?

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: (Yawn)… I'm sleepy.

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: Good night. Sleep early, grow taller.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: Tetrominoes is so fun! I love it when the lines all vanish!

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: Phones these days are too complicated. I just need a phone that can call, text, and… oh, play Tetrominoes!

daily.name: Topic: Scar
daily.desc: The body's self-healing powers are limited. It won't heal when it suffers too much damage. Such a shame.

daily.name: Topic: Weapon
daily.desc: I can use my abilities to create weapons with simple structures like swords and blades, but guns are tricky. It's not like I can't, but I'll have to remember all the components… Fine, I can't.

daily.name: Topic: Fortelling
daily.desc: I spent a few years in a place far from the city, where people lived by the "will of God." The will of God was always right, because people could always find a way to interpret it as right. Prophecies are much the same. If you find a good interpretation, then believe in it.

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Abilities
daily.desc: My ability? It's shaping a mass of smoke from who knows where into all kinds of forms. Pretty pathetic compared to those that can change the course of nature, right? But because of that, I learned to rely on myself to get things done. That's not so bad!

daily.name: About Myself: Origins
daily.desc: In a small seaside town far away, a baby was born. He didn't know it then, but 27 years later, he'd grow into a 27-year-old fellow… What? I didn't say anything wrong, did I?

daily.name: About Myself: Farewell
daily.desc: Not to brag, but I've probably said my goodbyes more times than you've said good morning. Drifting out at sea, I'd always think the world has no real limits, so maybe the people I said goodbye to… I'll meet again.

daily.name: About Linko
daily.desc: I don't know what's going on in Linko's brain. Well, that's not important. If you're looking for a person or an anomaly, you can simply trust her intuitions. The only problem is, she often finds herself in strange places. It's the same problem a little friend of mine had. Though frankly speaking, my friend is not as bright as Linko…

daily.name: About Daffodill
daily.desc: Daffodill blames herself too much, even for things out of her own control… She's impressive. She grew up in a less-than-ideal environment, but managed to stay kindhearted. The owner of Eibon… must be a great influence for her.

daily.name: About Zankou
daily.desc: She's strange. Almost as strange as criminals on Ghroth Island. To be precise, she belongs there.

daily.name: About Ghroth Island
daily.desc: At Ghroth Island… I worked, trained, honed my intuition into a technique, and learned how to tell good from evil. I appreciate them letting me stay there. Other than that, I don't have much personal feelings.

daily.name: About ETD-6
daily.desc: I can feel that ETD-6 isn't that unified of a team. Everyone has their own issues. Well, this isn't something I can ask of them. I just need them to do their jobs.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Aha! My body is feeling stronger!

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: My spirits are high! Well, I can do even better.

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: Haha, I can finally give it my all!

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: Woah, this is for me? Are you sure? You're too kind!

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: Oooh! I've always wanted this. Thanks a bunch!

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Thanks a lot!

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Is this for me? Thanks!

battle.name: Ultimate III
battle.desc: I'll… take care of the damage done.

battle.name: Low Health I
battle.desc: Hmm… this is harder than I expected.

battle.name: Down II
battle.desc: Is this the end of the journey…?

battle.name: Heavily Damaged I
battle.desc: I can't get hit for nothing…

battle.name: Deploy I
battle.desc: My opponents usually don't end up well.

battle.name: Special Switch - Linko
battle.desc: Little one, you can rely on others a little!

battle.name: Consecutive Critical Dodge Success II
battle.desc: Hey hey, aim before you move!

fashion.name: Labyrinth Lily
fashion.desc:
Shinku's loungewear for quiet days spent idling undisturbed among her treasures. Once a dragon has made up her mind, no force can shake her resolve.
"…No. I've already decided. I'm not going out today, no matter what."

fashion.name: Crimson Solstice
fashion.desc:
Shinku rarely concerns herself with what she wears, but this outfit suits midsummer perfectly.
"…It's easy to move in. Is there a problem?"

fashion.name: Dragonhunter
fashion.desc: Countless storms gather in her heart, and the dragonhunter sets forth on her quest.

fashion.name: Dawn Patrol
fashion.desc:
A pro-grade racing swimsuit that reveals her competitive spirit. The beach has a way of drawing out one's true self—or perhaps that is simply the thrill of cutting through the waves.
"Go all out—even when you’re enjoying summer."

fashion.name: Student of Terrasea
fashion.desc:
A neat, preppy outfit with the fresh charm of campus life. They say youth is spent either fleeing from one's inner shadow or chasing after it… and even those without a shadow will find a way to cast one.
"Don't read something that ridiculous into it… Ugh, whatever."

fashion.name: Normie Heroine
fashion.desc: Shinku kept her head lowered, trying to vanish into the crowd. After all, if no one came close, then no one would get hurt… right?

profile.title: Member of CSU-2
profile.description:
"This one's tough. Leave it to me."
Far removed from her everyday self, Shinku proves reliable beyond her years whenever she takes on a mission. She ventures alone into the most dangerous zones, trusting her companions to guard her back. That is how this clumsy dragon girl protects all she holds dear. As for matters of the heart… perhaps she still needs a little more time.

profile_detail.name: Intel
profile_detail.desc:
There's a distance in Shinku's politeness. As a new CSU member transferred to the BAC's HQ at Hethereau, Shinku didn't exactly make a great first impression on colleagues. Shinku maintained a deliberate distance and kept people at their "right places"—with the exception of that star employee who is known for lacking common sense.
It's not just at work, Shinku practices the same thing in her daily life too. She'll show up in the crowd rushing towards DSD to grab the latest Mystery Box or sit in the packed stands at the finals of the anomaly trading card championship, chatting with fellow fans about her collection. But once the crowds clear out, it's always Shinku going home by herself. Living in a bustling city, she's never refused to contact anyone, but she's also never let anyone into her "territory" either.
Shinku's definitely sparked some criticism and caused misunderstandings, but she firmly believes she's making the right calls. Ever since that heavy rain, she's grown used to being on her own.

There was a time when Shinku believed she wasn't different from kids her age, until that heavy rain made her understand what the power she'd been born with actually implied. Since then, her life has been completely different.
When Shinku first left Hethereau to train under her mentor at CSU-9, she wondered what would've happened if the incident had never ever occurred. But soon, she set that unanswerable question aside and found what she thought was the best way to keep the same tragedy from happening again—she just kept everyone at a distance.
And so, the determined dragonling began to grow.
She started bearing every burden on her own. With the help of her senior colleagues, she grew capable enough to handle things solo and even protect others. Her lone-wolf style meant that even if she lost control, the impact could be kept to a minimum. Everything seemed to be falling into place, until the day her mentor handed her the transfer papers, and the chance to see whether she'd truly moved past that rainy night finally arrived.

The past is the sharpest hunter, striking its killing blow the moment its prey lets its guard down.
But apparently, a maturing dragon isn't that kind of prey.

profile_detail.name: Helmet with two holes
profile_detail.desc:
Shinku's powers boost her reaction speed and physical strength. In the early days at the Bureau, her combat prowess helped her quickly adapt to her responsibilities. But her lack of control meant she'd often go berserk, and that was something she urgently needed to fix. It wasn't uncommon to see Shinku fall into a dark mood right after coming to, staring at the mess she made. Still, biased to action, she was quick to find a solution. After a safety officer kicked her off a construction site for not wearing a hard hat for the third time, she made herself a helmet with holes on both sides for her horns.
"Do you really have to… go to the construction site?"
"Mhm."
"And you have to wear this… pointless helmet?"
"That's a requirement. I can't enter the site if I don't wear one."
At least the helmet hasn't been needed for a while.

profile_detail.name: CSU-9
profile_detail.desc:
Tempus, who used to frown and call her a rude brat, would later happily bring her out for ice cream during field assignments; Ray, who'd look for her and crack jokes when Shinku was holed up in the room blaming herself for losing control; her senior sister, who always kept a straight face during training and never held back her anger when Shinku messed up, but would nevertheless stand before her on missions; and her mentor, who usually kept quiet about her birthdays but never forgot to celebrate… without them, Shinku probably would've been stuck in her room feeling sorry for herself forever.
As for how she should respond to their concerns and goodwill, Shinku couldn't think of any other answer aside from becoming someone who could stand on her own.
Her mentor must be worried only because she's still not independent and strong enough.

profile_detail.name: Dragon's Treasure
profile_detail.desc:
Walking alone along the beach, kicking away pebbles that got in her way now and then. Even as her vision started to blur, she held back the tears welling up in her eyes.
"It's just a cake. It's not like I care about it!"
No, that's not what was on her mind.
The more often she started waking up at night with a pain from the top of her head, the more often she'd say things in class that she'd end up regretting. Deep down, she really didn't mean those things, but by the time she came to her senses, she'd either made her classmates angry or made them cry.
She didn't like that.
The truth is, she wanted to play dodgeball with them, wanted to help prepare the school festival performance, wanted to eat cake, blow out the candles, and sing happy birthday at her classmates' birthday parties. But somehow, she always ended up ruining everything…
"Shinku!"
"Found ya! I knew you'd be here!"
"Look what I found! Tada! Here! Doesn't this remind you of someone who's curled up into a ball crying?"
"That's… not true."
"It is! Anyway, take it."
"Huh…？"
"Doesn't every evil dragon in a story have their own stash of treasures? That dragon who loves picking fights with everyone should have some too! So from now on, every time you get into a fight with someone, collect something fun. That way, once you finally defeat the evil dragon, you can share its stash with everyone!"
Starting with that shell with the sad little face on it, Shinku began her "treasure hunt."

profile_detail.name: CSU-2
profile_detail.desc:
For Shinku, the challenge of transferring to CSU-2 was more about getting along with the two new teammates than about getting used to a new place.
Mint. A one-of-a-kind character who somehow invalidates Shinku's tricks to keep her distance. Whether Shinku puts on a resting drake face or makes up an excuse, Mint just brushes it off and keeps approaching her. "Resting drake face? Aww, why so grumpy, who made Taya angry this time? Or did you fail an exam?" "Busy? Sure, let's do it another time then! How about after work tomorrow?"
Mint does not know when to back off. She's just there because she wants to be. It's a hassle, really… but Shinku doesn't hate it—who hates a friendly kitty anyway?
As for the other teammate…
Oneiroi. After Shinku's first mission with her, she understood exactly why she'd been transferred to Unit 2. This one had the ability to prevent her from going berserk. This should have been good news for Shinku, because she'd finally stop worrying about hurting teammates. But she couldn't bring herself to accept Oneiroi the way she accepted Mint.
Iroi was hiding herself. She wasn't showing her true self…
And that was what Shinku was exactly doing.

profile_detail.name: Never-ending Rain
profile_detail.desc:
Even now, Shinku still finds herself thinking back to that rainy night.
The world turned upside down, figures in black suits rising up out of puddles, and her friend's terrified cries for help. After that, her memory becomes a blur. She managed to fight off those anomalies, but the rampage that followed caused no small amount of damage, and even swept up the friend she was trying to protect.
"At least that's better than being stuck with regret over doing nothing."
Though she'd never quite made it out of that rain, Shinku had never once doubted the choice she made that night. There had been plenty of times she'd wished she didn't have her Esper Abilities, but never in a moment like that one.

profile_detail.name: After the Rain
profile_detail.desc:
"Alright, I'm heading home!"
"Bye, Teana! I didn't think Taya would invite us to play! Call us next time, bye!"
She's not exactly good at this, but they probably had a good time, didn't they? With that thought, Shinku pulled out her phone and typed in the number she worked so hard to find but couldn't bring herself to call.
She made up her mind to do this after that gaming session Mint had put together, so why was she hesitating now?
Wanting to protect a friend but ending up hurting them, deciding on her own that they must hate her and ghosting them, then using "this is for the best" as an excuse to make herself better…
That's not who she is, and it's not who she can ever let herself become.
Taking a deep breath, Shinku pressed the call button.
*Phone rings*
What should she even say? That thought just hit her. Shinku's breathing shortened as she became nervous.
"Hello?"
The voice on the other end was both familiar and unfamiliar. Shinku still held her breath.
It's okay, because we're friends.
"…Hello…? Yeah, it's me."
"I'm back."
The girl who had been trapped in that rainy night for so long finally saw the bright, warm sunlight of the day.

daily.name: First Meet
daily.desc: I'm Shinku from CSU-2. You're Coco, the one Mint mentions a lot, right? Nice to meet you. I hope I won't give you as much trouble as the dumcat.

daily.name: Chat: Dragon Horns
daily.desc: They're not as useful in battle as my tail, but the horns don't bother me as much as my tail does, except when measuring my height.

daily.name: Chat: Vintage Shop
daily.desc: On Bagel, I noticed a few vintage shops just opened in Hethereau. Let's take a look when we can.

daily.name: Chat: Rumors
daily.desc: I don't have wings, I don't spit fire, and I don't grab my enemies and circle around in the sky before body-slamming them. Seriously, who made this up…?

daily.name: Sunny
daily.desc: The weather is so good, we might run into Mint at a square.

daily.name: Rainy
daily.desc: It's raining again. Tch, trouble…

daily.name: Cold
daily.desc: It's not like I'm cold… but let's get this over with.

daily.name: Hot
daily.desc: I could use an ice pop now…

daily.name: Morning Greeting
daily.desc: Morning. You look like you're motivated. Wanna take my patrolling shift?

daily.name: Noon Greeting
daily.desc: Do you want to get ramen? There's this old ramen store I used to go to when I was still in school. It tastes great.

daily.name: Evening Greeting
daily.desc: I hope there isn't a sudden report to turn in tonight…

daily.name: Good Night
daily.desc: It's getting late. You don't have to send me home, do you? See you tomorrow. Good night.

daily.name: Hobbies
daily.desc: I collect anything that catches my eye: from the ultra-secret editions of DSD's collab Mystery Boxes with Duke K, to misprinted issues of Weekly Fantasy—even simply cool rocks I come across by the beach. Wanna see? Maybe next time.

daily.name: Worries
daily.desc: My funds are running a bit low. I really don't want to touch my savings…

daily.name: Topic: CSU
daily.desc: The "New Containment Safety Protocol" is bothersome. There are so many rules, and whenever I'm on a mission, I'm forced to think twice before I act. Still, training myself to follow those annoying restrictions when my powers are affecting me is the reason I'm here.

daily.name: Topic: Wandering
daily.desc: When I don't have plans, I like walking around without a destination in mind. I'll roam into random places, and when I see things that interest me, I collect them. When I was little, I called this "treasure hunting." It's still accurate, right?

daily.name: Topic: Nacupeda
daily.desc: Nacupeda is an expert at keeping coins: just stash them in the pool and keep them within eyesight. No wonder that anomaly is always happy. Maybe I should do something similar?

daily.name: About Myself: Esper Ability
daily.desc: My former captain told me that my power is a curse. Though it makes me strong, it could also destroy the things I love. I was once depressed because I injured a friend by mistake… But now I understand: I'll embrace my power as long as I don't have to hate myself for being weak when I need to be strong.

daily.name: About Myself: Relationships
daily.desc: "I always go solo in the Bureau?" That dumcat just blabbers around… Well, I can't really be alone if she always drags me and Iroi around, can I?

daily.name: About Myself: Urge
daily.desc: My Esper Abilities affect me beyond fights. Even in everyday situations, I might suddenly do something out of line. It wouldn't be as dangerous as during a fight, but I don't know what I might end up doing—that could mean trouble.

daily.name: About Mint I
daily.desc: Mint "senpai" has absolutely no talent in reading the room. Even if you want to keep your distance, she still comes over to talk to you. Sigh, I still can't leave that dumcat alone.

daily.name: About Mint II
daily.desc: That dumcat, she never shies away from expressing her true thoughts and feelings. I don't know if I should praise her for that or just call her thick-skinned… Still, if everyone was as straightforward as Mint, things would be a lot easier.

daily.name: About Iroi I
daily.desc: As far as colleagues go, Iroi is pretty much perfect. I was probably paired with her because when I lose control, she can calm me down with her dreams, which was where I saw… never mind. Anyway, I don't see her as a normal person, but it doesn't affect our work.

daily.name: About Iroi II
daily.desc: Everyone has a story they don't want to tell. I was like that before. It's the same for Ramtenna. I'm not exactly sure what she's been through, but the least I can do is be by her side—like my teammates were by my side when we faced the Crimson Dragon. The bickering? I prefer to not bicker with her, but maybe that's what companions do.

daily.name: About CSU-2
daily.desc: I thought I was going to go through some troubles when I first transferred to CSU-2, but thanks to Mint, colleagues accepted me quickly. In contrast, I almost made a big blunder on my first mission. Good thing that Iroi was there to help… Ahem, I should buy my colleagues some drinks from Crazy Cat.

daily.name: About Bureau of Anomaly Control
daily.desc: For the record, I'm not dissing my colleagues. I just wanted to say that the BAC is made up of a bunch of weirdos, especially the CSUs and ETDs, which require fieldwork and dealing with dangerous anomalies. Now that I think about it, I was able to blend into the Bureau and learn from my former captain because there weren't many "normal people" around to begin with.

daily.name: Character Ascension I
daily.desc: Now I can fight stronger enemies on my own.

daily.name: Character Ascension II
daily.desc: This might mean trouble, but getting stronger is a good thing.

daily.name: Character Ascension III
daily.desc: Not enough… I need more…!

daily.name: Gift Received I
daily.desc: …! Don't regret giving me this.

daily.name: Gift Received II
daily.desc: You know what I like.

daily.name: Gift Received III
daily.desc: Thank you. I'll add it to my stash.

daily.name: Gift Received IV
daily.desc: Is there anything I can help with?

battle.name: Ultimate II
battle.desc: Get out! Don't get dragged into this!

battle.name: Ultimate VI
battle.desc: Plotting your escape? Don't even think about it!

battle.name: Containment I
battle.desc: Stay still and let me do my job.

battle.name: Nullification II
battle.desc: You just had to choose the hard way.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains I
battle.desc: Pretty lucky day. I should visit DSD.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains II
battle.desc: I found some useful stuff. Not bad at all.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains III
battle.desc: What good stuff will I get?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains IV
battle.desc: I hope I'm not using up my good luck.

battle.name: Unexpected Gains V
battle.desc: Is this a blessing from Nacupeda?

battle.name: Unexpected Gains VI
battle.desc: Do I need to turn this in to the Security Office?

battle.name: Low Health II
battle.desc: It's okay. I can still fight.

battle.name: Heal I
battle.desc: I feel so good I can solo the Headless Rider.

battle.name: Heal II
battle.desc: I'm in top condition. Are there more enemies to fight?

battle.name: Deploy I
battle.desc: Leave the strongest one to me.

battle.name: Entry Attack II
battle.desc: I'll make sure you quiet down!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Iroi
battle.desc: Take a break. I'll make them pay…!

battle.name: Teammate Down - Zero
battle.desc: Appraiser, don't you fall on me!
